talkContent: The heavens are in calamity, time and space are collapsing, the multiverse descends into chaos!
talkContent_ma: Langit dan bumi hancur, ruang masa runtuh, multiverse menjadi kacau-bilau!
talkContent_en: The heavens are in calamity, time and space are collapsing, the multiverse descends into chaos!
talkContent_th: ท้องฟ้าเกิดหายนะ มิติเวลาถูกทำลาย พหุจักรวาลตกอยู่ในความโกลาหล!
talkContent_ph: Kalagitnaan ng kaguluhan ng mga diyos at panahon, ang oras at espasyo ay gumuho, ang multiverse ay naging isang kaguluhang walang katulad!
talkContent_in: Langit runtuh, ruang-waktu hancur, multisemesta berada dalam kekacauan!
talkContent_vn: Chư thiên hạo kiếp, thời không băng hoại, đa nguyên vũ trụ một mảnh hỗn loạn!
roleName: Will of the Stars - The Star
roleName_vn: Ý chí quần tinh - Tinh Tể

talkContent: Countless space portals link to the Shinobi Realm, and endless heroes have crossed dimensions to arrive!
talkContent_ma: Tak terhitung pintu ruang angkasa menghubungkan Dunia Shinobi, para wira tanpa henti menyeberangi dunia dan datang!
talkContent_en: Countless space portals link to the Shinobi Realm, and endless heroes have crossed dimensions to arrive!
talkContent_th: ประตูมิติจำนวนมากเชื่อมต่อกับโลกนินจา เหล่าฮีโร่มากมายจากต่างโลกได้เดินทางข้ามมิติ!
talkContent_ph: Walang katapusang mga espasyo portal ang nag-uugnay sa Mundo ng mga Ninja, at walang katapusang mga bayani ang tumawid mula sa iba't ibang mundo!
talkContent_in: Tak terhitung gerbang ruang yang terhubung ke Dunia Ninja, para pahlawan tak berujung telah melintasi dunia dan tiba!
talkContent_vn: Vô số cổng không gian kết nối Nhẫn Giới, vô tận anh hùng đã vượt giới mà đến!
roleName: Will of the Stars - The Star
roleName_vn: Ý Chí Ngôi Sao - Tinh Tể

talkContent: They're causing havoc everywhere—what the heck is going on?!
talkContent_ma: Mereka mengacau di mana-mana, sebenarnya apa yang sedang berlaku ini?!
talkContent_en: They're causing havoc everywhere—what the heck is going on?!
talkContent_th: พวกมันก่อความวุ่นวายไปทั่ว เกิดอะไรขึ้นกันแน่เนี่ย!
talkContent_ph: Nagwawala sila kahit saan, ano ba talaga ang nangyayari?
talkContent_in: Mereka buat kacau merata-rata, sebenarnya ada apa ni!
talkContent_vn: Bọn này phá phách khắp nơi, rốt cuộc là chuyện gì vậy!

talkContent: Damn it, those green-skinned monsters… are they heroes from another world?
talkContent_ma: Menjengkelkan betul, makhluk hijau ini... adakah mereka wira dari dunia lain?
talkContent_en: Damn it, those green-skinned monsters… are they heroes from another world?
talkContent_th: น่ารังเกียจจริง ๆ ไอ้พวกสัตว์ประหลาดสีเขียวพวกนี้ พวกมันเป็นฮีโร่จากต่างโลกเหรอ?
talkContent_ph: Nakakainis! Ang mga berdeng halimaw na ito—sila ba ang tinatawag na mga bayani mula sa ibang mundo?
talkContent_in: Menjengkelkan! Monster hijau menjijikkan ini... apakah mereka pahlawan dari dunia lain?
talkContent_vn: Đáng ghét, lũ quái vật xanh lè này, chúng là anh hùng của dị giới sao?

talkContent: No! They're just pitiful souls who lost their minds after failed dimensional travel. Be careful, they're coming!
talkContent_ma: Tidak! Mereka hanyalah makhluk malang yang hilang ingatan akibat kegagalan menyeberangi ruang! Hati-hati, mereka datang!
talkContent_en: No! They're just pitiful souls who lost their minds after failed dimensional travel. Be careful, they're coming!
talkContent_th: ไม่ใช่! พวกมันเป็นแค่พวกโชคร้ายที่เสียสติจากการข้ามมิติที่ล้มเหลว ระวังนะ พวกมันมาแล้ว!
talkContent_ph: Hindi! Sila’y mga kaawa-awang nilalang na nawalan ng katinuan dahil nabigo sa paglalakbay sa ibang dimensyon. Mag-ingat, papalapit na sila!
talkContent_in: Tidak! Mereka hanyalah makhluk malang yang kehilangan akal karena gagal menembus dimensi!
talkContent_vn: Không! Đây chỉ là những kẻ đáng thương bị mất trí do xuyên không thất bại, cẩn thận, chúng đến rồi!

talkContent: Hungry... hungry... hungry!!!
talkContent_ma: Lapar... lapar... LAPAR!!!
talkContent_en: Hungry... hungry... hungry!!!
talkContent_ph: Gutom... gutom... gutom!!!
talkContent_in: Hati-hati, mereka datang!
talkContent_vn: Đói... đói... đói!!!

talkContent: Take them down quickly—the whole village is still waiting for us!
talkContent_ma: Cepat habisi mereka, seluruh kampung masih menunggu kita!
talkContent_en: Take them down quickly—the whole village is still waiting for us!
talkContent_th: รีบจัดการให้เร็วเข้า ทั้งหมู่บ้านยังรอเราอยู่!
talkContent_ph: Labanan natin sila agad! Ang buong nayon ay naghihintay sa atin!
talkContent_in: Serang cepat, menang cepat, seluruh desa masih menunggu kita!
talkContent_vn: Đánh nhanh thắng nhanh, cả làng còn đang đợi chúng ta!

talkContent: The attacks of these monsters are so strange… but incredibly strong!
talkContent_ma: Serangan makhluk ini aneh sekali... tapi sangat kuat!
talkContent_en: The attacks of these monsters are so strange… but incredibly strong!
talkContent_th: ท่าไม้ตายของพวกสัตว์ประหลาดนี่แปลกชะมัด... แต่ก็รุนแรงมาก!
talkContent_ph: Ang mga galaw ng mga halimaw na ito ay kakaiba... pero napakalakas nila!
talkContent_in: Gerakan monster-monster ini aneh sekali... tapi sangat kuat!
talkContent_vn: Những chiêu thức của đám quái vật này kỳ lạ thật... nhưng mạnh quá!

talkContent: Since they’re from the multiverse, having strange powers isn’t surprising at all.
talkContent_ma: Mereka berasal dari multiverse, jadi memiliki kuasa pelik bukanlah sesuatu yang pelik.
talkContent_en: Since they’re from the multiverse, having strange powers isn’t surprising at all.
talkContent_th: พวกเขามาจากพหุจักรวาล จะมีวิธีแปลก ๆ ก็ไม่แปลกหรอก
talkContent_ph: Kung sila’y mula sa multiverse, kahit anong kakaibang pamamaraan ay hindi na nakagugulat.
talkContent_in: Mereka datang dari multisemesta, jadi tidak heran kalau mereka punya teknik luar biasa.
talkContent_vn: Việc họ đến từ đa vũ trụ, thì có thủ đoạn gì cũng không có gì đáng ngạc nhiên.

talkContent: Master Kakashi is trapped—what should we do?!
talkContent_ma: Guru Kakashi terperangkap! Apa yang harus kita lakukan?
talkContent_en: Master Kakashi is trapped—what should we do?!
talkContent_th: อาจารย์คาคาชิติดกับแล้ว เราจะทำยังไงดี?
talkContent_ph: Naipit si Guro Kakashi, anong gagawin natin?!
talkContent_in: Guru Kakashi terjebak, kita harus bagaimana?
talkContent_vn: Thầy Kakashi bị mắc kẹt rồi, chúng ta phải làm sao?

talkContent: Flesh… bones… destroy!
talkContent_ma: Daging dan tulang... dimusnahkan!
talkContent_en: Flesh… bones… destroy!
talkContent_th: เนื้อ... กระดูก... ทำลาย!
talkContent_ph: Laman... buto... pagwasak!
talkContent_in: Daging dan tulang... hancurkan!
talkContent_vn: Thịt xương... hủy diệt!

talkContent: Don’t hold back—give it everything you’ve got!
talkContent_ma: Jangan berlembut, gunakan segala kekuatan untuk hancurkan mereka!
talkContent_en: Don’t hold back—give it everything you’ve got!
talkContent_th: อย่าออมมือ! ใส่พลังให้สุดแล้วจัดการพวกมันเลย!
talkContent_ph: Walang awa! Ibigay ang buong lakas para durugin sila!
talkContent_in: Jangan menahan diri, keluarkan semua kekuatan untuk mengalahkan mereka!
talkContent_vn: Đừng nương tay, dốc toàn lực đánh tan bọn chúng!

talkContent: Ah! Master Kakashi is in danger!
talkContent_ma: Ah! Guru Kakashi dalam bahaya!
talkContent_en: Ah! Master Kakashi is in danger!
talkContent_th: อ๊าก! อาจารย์คาคาชิกำลังตกอยู่ในอันตราย!
talkContent_ph: Aah! Nasa panganib si Guro Kakashi!
talkContent_in: A! Guru Kakashi dalam bahaya!
talkContent_vn: Á! Thầy Kakashi gặp nguy hiểm!

talkContent: Hmph! You’ve really pissed me off! Watch this—do you think I’m not the Medical Sage of the ninja world?!
talkContent_ma: Hmph! Kalian telah membuat aku marah! Ingat aku bukan Saint Perubatan di dunia ninja ini?!
talkContent_en: Hmph! You’ve really pissed me off! Watch this—do you think I’m not the Medical Sage of the ninja world?!
talkContent_th: หึ! พวกแกทำให้ฉันโกรธแล้วนะ! ดูซิ คิดว่าฉันไม่ใช่เซียนแพทย์แห่งโลกนินจาหรือไง?!
talkContent_ph: Hmph! Pina-init niyo ako ha! Akala niyo hindi ako ang Mediko Santo ng mundo ng ninja?!
talkContent_in: Hmph! Kalian sudah membuatku marah! Kalian pikir aku bukan Sage Medis di dunia ninja ini?!
talkContent_vn: Hừ! Các ngươi chọc giận ta rồi! Xem ta đây không phải là Y Thánh của giới ninja chắc?!

talkContent: D*mn it, you guys are having fun fighting, huh? Now it’s my turn!
talkContent_ma: S*la**, korang berlawan seronok sangat ya? Sekarang giliran aku!
talkContent_en: D*mn it, you guys are having fun fighting, huh? Now it’s my turn!
talkContent_th: ไอ้พวกบ้า พวกแกสู้กันมันส์แล้วใช่มั้ย? ถึงตาฉันบ้างแล้ว!
talkContent_ph: P*t*, kayo na lang ba ang masaya sa laban? Ako naman!
talkContent_in: S**l, kalian bertarung seru banget ya? Sekarang giliran gue!
talkContent_vn: Đ* m*, chúng mày đánh nhau đã sướng rồi chứ gì? Đến lượt tao!

talkContent: With the world in such turmoil, the village won’t be safe. We must return quickly! Use that move now!
talkContent_ma: Dunia sedang bergolak begini, kampung tidak akan aman, kita harus segera pulang! Gunakan jurus itu sekarang juga!
talkContent_en: With the world in such turmoil, the village won’t be safe. We must return quickly! Use that move now!
talkContent_th: โลกปั่นป่วนขนาดนี้ หมู่บ้านจะไม่ปลอดภัย เราต้องรีบกลับแล้ว! ใช้ท่านั้นเลย!
talkContent_ph: Sa ganitong kaguluhan sa mundo, hindi na mapapanatag ang nayon. Kailangan na nating bumalik agad! Gamitin ang ultimate move!
talkContent_in: Dunia kacau seperti ini, desa tidak akan tenang, kita harus segera pulang! Gunakan jurus itu!
talkContent_vn: Thế giới biến động thế này, làng không yên được, chúng ta phải mau về thôi! Dùng chiêu đó luôn!

talkContent: Welcome to the live broadcast of the World Championship organized by the Pocket Baby League! I’m your host, Super Ampharos! Before the match begins, let us welcome our sacred torch ambassador—Charizard!
talkContent_ma: Selamat datang ke siaran langsung Kejohanan Dunia anjuran Persekutuan Pocket Baby, saya ialah hos anda - Super Ampharos! Sebelum pertarungan bermula, seperti biasa, mari kita sambut duta obor suci kita - Charizard!
talkContent_en: Welcome to the live broadcast of the World Championship organized by the Pocket Baby League! I’m your host, Super Ampharos! Before the match begins, let us welcome our sacred torch ambassador—Charizard!
talkContent_th: ขอต้อนรับเข้าสู่การถ่ายทอดสดการแข่งขันชิงแชมป์โลก จัดโดยสมาคม Pocket Baby! ฉันคือพิธีกร Super Ampharos! ก่อนการแข่งขันจะเริ่ม เรามาต้อนรับทูตคบเพลิงศักดิ์สิทธิ์ของเรา - ลิซาโดงะกันเถอะ!
talkContent_ph: Maligayang pagdating sa live broadcast ng World Championship na inorganisa ng Pocket Baby Alliance, ako ang host na si Super Ampharos! Bago magsimula ang laban, ayon sa tradisyon, salubungin natin ang ating Banal na Torch Ambassador — si Charizard!
talkContent_in: Selamat datang di siaran langsung Kejuaraan Dunia yang diselenggarakan oleh Aliansi Pocket Baby, saya adalah pembawa acara Super Ampharos! Sebelum pertandingan dimulai, sesuai tradisi, mari kita sambut duta api suci kita – Charizard!
talkContent_vn: Chào mừng đến với buổi phát sóng trực tiếp Giải vô địch thế giới do Liên minh Pocket Baby tổ chức, tôi là người dẫn chương trình Super Ampharos! Trước khi trận đấu bắt đầu, theo thông lệ, chúng ta hãy cùng chào đón đại sứ ngọn đuốc thiêng của chúng ta - Charizard!

talkContent: (A gigantic figure flies down from the sky, and the audience erupts in cheers. "Charizard!" "Charizard!" "Charizard!"...)
talkContent_ma: (Satu objek gergasi terbang turun dari langit, para penonton bersorak. "Charizard!" "Charizard!" "Charizard!"...)
talkContent_en: (A gigantic figure flies down from the sky, and the audience erupts in cheers. "Charizard!" "Charizard!" "Charizard!"...)
talkContent_th: (สิ่งมีชีวิตขนาดมหึมาบินลงมาจากฟากฟ้า ผู้ชมพากันโห่ร้อง "ลิซาโดงะ!" "ลิซาโดงะ!" "ลิซาโดงะ!"…)
talkContent_ph: (Isang napakalaking nilalang ang lumipad mula sa kalangitan, at ang mga manonood ay agad nagsigawan: “Charizard!” “Charizard!” “Charizard!”...)
talkContent_in: (Sebuah benda raksasa terbang dari langit, penonton langsung bersorak. "Charizard!" "Charizard!" "Charizard!")
talkContent_vn: (Một vật thể khổng lồ bay đến từ trên không, khán giả lập tức reo hò."Charizard!" "Charizard!" "Charizard!"...

talkContent: (Charizard lands on the sacred flame platform at the center of the arena, folds its wings, and bows to the contestants. Then, it turns toward the torch and breathes out a stream of flame.)
talkContent_ma: (Charizard mendarat di altar api suci di tengah arena, melipat sayap dan tunduk menyapa para peserta pertandingan. Kemudian, ia berpaling ke arah altar dan menyembur api.)
talkContent_en: (Charizard lands on the sacred flame platform at the center of the arena, folds its wings, and bows to the contestants. Then, it turns toward the torch and breathes out a stream of flame.)
talkContent_th: (ลิซาโดงะลงจอดบนแท่นคบเพลิงศักดิ์สิทธิ์กลางสนาม พับปีกลงและโค้งคำนับต่อเหล่าผู้เข้าแข่งขัน จากนั้นหันไปทางแท่นคบเพลิงแล้วพ่นไฟออกมา)
talkContent_ph: (Bumaba si Charizard sa sagradong plasa ng apoy sa gitna ng arena, inipon ang kanyang mga pakpak, at yumuko bilang pagbati sa mga kalahok. Pagkatapos, humarap ito sa altar ng apoy at bumuga ng isang liyab.)
talkContent_in: (Charizard mendarat di altar api suci di tengah arena, melipat sayapnya dan menunduk memberi hormat kepada para peserta. Lalu ia menghadap altar dan menyemburkan api.)
talkContent_vn: (Charizard hạ cánh xuống đài lửa thiêng ở trung tâm đấu trường, thu cánh lại và cúi đầu chào những thí sinh tham gia cuộc thi lần này. Sau đó, nó quay đầu về phía đài lửa thiêng và phun ra một ngọn lửa.)

talkContent: (The flame ignites atop the sacred flame platform… Under the light of the holy fire, the athletes begin their oath!)
talkContent_ma: (Api menyala di atas altar api suci... Di bawah cahaya nyalaan suci itu, para atlet bersumpah untuk memulakan!)
talkContent_en: (The flame ignites atop the sacred flame platform… Under the light of the holy fire, the athletes begin their oath!)
talkContent_th: (เปลวไฟลุกโชติช่วงบนแท่นคบเพลิงศักดิ์สิทธิ์… ภายใต้แสงศักดิ์สิทธิ์ของคบเพลิง เหล่านักกีฬากล่าวคำปฏิญาณเริ่มการแข่งขัน!)
talkContent_ph: (Nagliyab ang apoy sa sagradong altar… Sa liwanag ng sagradong apoy, nanumpa ang mga atleta at nagsimula na ang kumpetisyon!)
talkContent_in: (Api suci menyala menyala di altar... Di bawah cahaya api suci, para atlet mulai mengucapkan sumpah!)
talkContent_vn: (Ngọn lửa bùng cháy trên đài lửa thiêng… Dưới ánh sáng của ngọn lửa thiêng, các vận động viên tuyên thệ bắt đầu!)

topTalk_en: I swear, we will uphold the spirit of the Pokémon League, fighting with honor and integrity...!

topTalk_in: Saya bersumpah, kami akan mematuhi semangat Liga Pokémon, bertarung dengan kehormatan dan integritas...!

talkContent: After hearing the players' oaths, I'm even more excited for this match. Since all the players are ready, I hereby declare – the official match begins!
talkContent_ma: Setelah mendengar ikrar para peserta, saya semakin teruja menantikan pertarungan ini. Oleh kerana semua peserta sudah bersedia, saya dengan ini mengisytiharkan - perlawanan rasmi bermula!
talkContent_en: After hearing the players' oaths, I'm even more excited for this match. Since all the players are ready, I hereby declare – the official match begins!
talkContent_th: หลังจากได้ฟังคำปฏิญาณของเหล่าผู้เข้าแข่งขัน ฉันยิ่งรู้สึกตื่นเต้นกับการแข่งขันครั้งนี้มากยิ่งขึ้น เพราะผู้เข้าแข่งขันทุกคนพร้อมแล้ว ฉันขอประกาศ - การแข่งขันอย่างเป็นทางการเริ่มต้นขึ้น!
talkContent_ph: Pagkatapos marinig ang panunumpa ng mga kalahok, lalo akong nasabik sa laban na ito. Dahil handa na ang lahat ng manlalaro, idinedeklara ko - opisyal nang magsisimula ang laban!
talkContent_in: Setelah mendengar sumpah para peserta, saya semakin menantikan pertandingan ini. Karena semua peserta sudah siap, saya nyatakan – pertandingan resmi dimulai!
talkContent_vn: Sau khi nghe xong lời tuyên thệ của các tuyển thủ, tôi càng thêm mong đợi trận đấu này. Vì tất cả các tuyển thủ đã sẵn sàng, tôi xin tuyên bố - trận đấu chính thức bắt đầu!

talkContent: Wow, this year's World Championship is truly incredible! Now, I am honored to invite the champion of this World Championship, the Pokémon Trainer representative – Satoshi from Pallet Town – to the stage to light the sacred torch!
talkContent_ma: Wow, Kejohanan Dunia kali ini benar-benar hebat! Seterusnya, saya dengan penuh hormat menjemput juara Kejohanan Dunia kali ini, wakil jurulatih Pokémon - Satoshi dari pekan Masara naik ke pentas untuk menyalakan obor suci!
talkContent_en: Wow, this year's World Championship is truly incredible! Now, I am honored to invite the champion of this World Championship, the Pokémon Trainer representative – Satoshi from Pallet Town – to the stage to light the sacred torch!
talkContent_th: ว้าว! การแข่งขันชิงแชมป์โลกครั้งนี้สุดยอดจริง ๆ! ต่อไปนี้ ขอเรียนเชิญแชมป์ของการแข่งขันครั้งนี้ ตัวแทนของเหล่าเทรนเนอร์โปเกมอน - ซาโตชิจากเมืองมาซาระ ขึ้นเวทีเพื่อจุดคบเพลิงศักดิ์สิทธิ์! ซาโตชิ... ชื่อของเรา!
talkContent_ph: Wow, ang World Championship ngayon ay talaga namang kamangha-mangha! Ngayon, buong galang kong inaanyayahan ang kampeon ng World Championship na ito, ang kinatawan ng mga Pokémon Trainer - si Satoshi mula sa bayan ng Masara, upang umakyat sa entablado at sindihan ang sagradong sulo!  Satoshi... ang pangalan ko!
talkContent_in: Wow, Kejuaraan Dunia kali ini benar-benar luar biasa! Selanjutnya, saya dengan hormat mengundang juara Kejuaraan Dunia ini, perwakilan pelatih Pokémon – Satoshi dari Kota Masara, untuk menyalakan obor suci!  Satoshi... Itu nama aku!
talkContent_vn: "Wow, Giải vô địch thế giới lần này thật sự quá tuyệt vời! Sau đây, tôi xin trân trọng kính mời nhà vô địch của Giải vô địch thế giới lần này, đại diện huấn luyện viên Pokemon - Satoshi đến từ thị trấn Masara lên đài thắp đuốc thánh!"Satoshi... Tên của mình!

talkContent: Satoshi... That's my name!
talkContent_ma: Satoshi... Itu nama aku!
talkContent_en: Satoshi... That's my name!
talkContent_th: ...ทาเคชิ ตื่นเร็ว! วันนี้เป็นวันแรกที่ลูกจะได้เป็นเทรนเนอร์โปเกมอนนะ!......เสียงแม่! อา! เรากำลังฝันอยู่ สายแล้ว!
talkContent_ph: ...Satoshi, bumangon ka na! Ngayon ang unang araw mong maging isang Pokémon Trainer!......Boses ni Mama, a! Nanaginip lang pala ako, huli na!
talkContent_in: ...Satoshi, bangun cepat! Hari ini adalah hari pertama kamu menjadi pelatih Pokémon!......Suara ibu, ah! Ternyata aku sedang bermimpi, sudah terlambat!

talkContent_vn: Sao lại thành ra thế này... Vậy có nghĩa là, bất kể là zombie hay không, tất cả những người đến từ thế giới khác đều là kẻ thù?!

talkContent: For those otherworldly heroes who successfully crossed over, conquering a land to rest and recover sounds perfectly reasonable, doesn’t it?
talkContent_ma: Hmm, perkara itu belum tentu lagi, mana tahu kamu kalahkan dia, kemudian dia suka kamu dan mahu kamu sertai pasukannya!
talkContent_en: For those otherworldly heroes who successfully crossed over, conquering a land to rest and recover sounds perfectly reasonable, doesn’t it?
talkContent_th: อืม... ยังไม่แน่นะ ใครจะรู้ ถ้านายชนะเธอได้ บางทีเธออาจจะชอบนายแล้วอยากชวนให้นายเข้าร่วมทีมก็ได้!
talkContent_ph: Hmm, hindi pa tiyak 'yan. Baka kapag natalo mo siya, magustuhan ka pa niya at imbitahan kang sumali sa kanyang grupo!
talkContent_in: Hmm, belum tentu, siapa tahu kamu kalahkan dia, lalu dia suka kamu dan ingin kamu masuk timnya!
talkContent_vn: Ừm, chuyện đó chưa chắc đâu, biết đâu cậu đánh bại được cô ấy, rồi người ta lại thích cậu và muốn cậu gia nhập đội thì sao!

talkContent: How did it come to this... Does this mean, zombie or not, everyone from another world is our enemy?!
talkContent_ma: Penat betul dengan makhluk kulit hijau ni, busuk pula tu!!
talkContent_en: How did it come to this... Does this mean, zombie or not, everyone from another world is our enemy?!
talkContent_th: เบื่อพวกตัวเขียวพวกนี้เต็มทีแล้ว เหม็นมาก!!
talkContent_ph: Nakakapagod na ang mga green-skinned na 'to, ang baho pa!!
talkContent_in: Capek dengan para kulit hijau ini, bau banget!!
talkContent_vn: Mệt mỏi với lũ da xanh này quá, thúi hoắc!!

talkContent: Hmm, maybe not. What if you defeat her and she ends up liking you and asks you to join her team?
talkContent_ma: Oh, lelaki kacak dari mana datang ni? Mari main dengan kakak, kalau kalahkan kakak, kakak ikut kamu selalu ya~
talkContent_en: Hmm, maybe not. What if you defeat her and she ends up liking you and asks you to join her team?
talkContent_th: อุ๊ย หนุ่มหล่อมาจากไหนจ๊ะ มาหาพี่นี่สิ ถ้าชนะพี่ได้นะ พี่จะไปกับเธอเลย~
talkContent_ph: Uy, guwapong lalaki, saan ka galing? Halika rito kay ate, talunin mo muna ako ha, saka ako sasama sa’yo~
talkContent_in: Eh, cowok ganteng dari mana nih? Main sama kakak sini, kalahkan kakak, kakak ikut kamu luôn~
talkContent_vn: Ồ, hot boy từ đâu tới vậy? Đến chơi với chị đây, đánh thắng chị thì chị theo em luôn nha~

talkContent: I'm so tired of these green-skinned things, they stink!!
talkContent_ma: Tahniah! Anda kini boleh membuka fungsi auto-pertarungan dan mempercepatkan kelajuan pertempuran!
talkContent_en: I'm so tired of these green-skinned things, they stink!!
talkContent_th: ยินดีด้วย คุณสามารถปลดล็อกระบบต่อสู้อัตโนมัติและเร่งความเร็วการต่อสู้แล้ว!
talkContent_ph: Binabati kita! Pwede mo nang i-unlock ang auto-battle at battle speed-up!
talkContent_in: Selamat! Kamu sekarang bisa membuka fitur pertempuran otomatis dan percepatan pertempuran!
talkContent_vn: Chúc mừng bạn, bạn đã có thể mở khóa tự động chiến đấu và tăng tốc chiến đấu!

talkContent: Oh~ Where did this hot guy come from? Come play with me~ If you beat me, I’ll follow you~
talkContent_ma: Klik di sini untuk mengaktifkan auto-pertarungan dan mempercepatkan pertempuran.
talkContent_en: Oh~ Where did this hot guy come from? Come play with me~ If you beat me, I’ll follow you~
talkContent_th: กดตรงนี้เพื่อเปิดการต่อสู้อัตโนมัติและเร่งความเร็วการต่อสู้
talkContent_ph: I-click ito upang paganahin ang auto-battle at dagdagan ang bilis ng labanan.
talkContent_in: Klik di sini untuk mengaktifkan pertempuran otomatis dan percepat kecepatan bertarung.
talkContent_vn: Nhấn vào đây để bật tự động chiến đấu và tăng tốc độ chiến đấu.

talkContent: Congratulations, you can now unlock auto-battle and increase battle speed!
talkContent_ma: Adakah saya berkhayal... Saya rasa mereka ini semakin kuat setiap kali bertarung...
talkContent_en: Congratulations, you can now unlock auto-battle and increase battle speed!
talkContent_th: นี่ฉันตาฝาดหรือเปล่า... รู้สึกว่าพวกนั้นแข็งแกร่งขึ้นเรื่อย ๆ เลยแฮะ...
talkContent_ph: Guni-guni ko lang ba... Parang lalong lumalakas ang mga kalabang ito?
talkContent_in: Apa aku berhalusinasi... Rasanya mereka makin lama makin kuat ya...
talkContent_vn: Có phải tôi ảo giác không... Tôi cảm thấy mấy tên này càng ngày càng mạnh hơn thì phải...

talkContent: Tap here to enable auto-battle and increase battle speed.
talkContent_ma: Itu bukan khayalan! Bila para wira dari dunia asing semakin menyesuaikan diri dengan Dunia Shinobi, kekuatan mereka akan pulih dan meningkat dengan cepat!
talkContent_en: Tap here to enable auto-battle and increase battle speed.
talkContent_th: ไม่ใช่ภาพลวงตาหรอก! เมื่อฮีโร่จากต่างโลกเริ่มปรับตัวเข้ากับโลกนินจา พลังของพวกเขาจะฟื้นตัวและเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างรวดเร็ว!
talkContent_ph: Hindi 'yan guni-guni! Habang nasasanay ang mga bayani mula sa ibang mundo sa Ninja Realm, bumabalik at lumalakas ang kanilang kapangyarihan!
talkContent_in: Itu bukan halusinasi! Saat para pahlawan dari dunia lain semakin beradaptasi dengan lingkungan Dunia Ninja, kekuatan mereka akan cepat pulih dan meningkat!
talkContent_vn: Đây không phải là ảo giác đâu! Khi các anh hùng từ thế giới khác đến ngày càng thích nghi với môi trường Nhẫn Giới, sức mạnh của họ sẽ nhanh chóng hồi phục và tăng lên đó!

talkContent: Am I imagining things... or are these guys getting stronger and stronger...?
talkContent_ma: Menjengkelkan…! Kenapa berani ceroboh masuk ke dunia kita tanpa izin!
talkContent_en: Am I imagining things... or are these guys getting stronger and stronger...?
talkContent_th: น่ารังเกียจจริง ๆ! ทำไมถึงกล้าบุกรุกโลกของพวกเราเองแบบนี้!
talkContent_ph: Nakakainis…! Bakit basta-basta silang sumalakay sa mundo natin?!
talkContent_in: Menyebalkan...! Kenapa bisa seenaknya masuk ke dunia kami!
talkContent_vn: Đáng ghét…! Tại sao lại tự tiện xâm nhập vào thế giới của chúng ta!

talkContent: You're not imagining it! As the heroes from other worlds adapt more to the Ninja Realm, their powers recover and increase rapidly!
talkContent_ma: Perkara yang telah berlaku, biarlah berlalu, perkara satu-satunya yang perlu kamu lakukan sekarang là menjadi lebih kuat, hanya dengan itu barulah segala-galanya boleh diubah!
talkContent_en: You're not imagining it! As the heroes from other worlds adapt more to the Ninja Realm, their powers recover and increase rapidly!
talkContent_th: เรื่องที่เกิดไปแล้วก็ปล่อยไปเถอะ สิ่งเดียวที่คุณต้องทำตอนนี้คือแข็งแกร่งขึ้น มีแค่นั้นเท่านั้นถึงจะเปลี่ยนแปลงทุกอย่างได้!
talkContent_ph: Ang mga nangyari ay nangyari na – ang tanging magagawa mo ngayon ay maging mas malakas. Tanging sa ganung paraan mo mababago ang lahat!
talkContent_in: Hal yang sudah terjadi, lupakan saja. Hal satu-satunya yang perlu kamu lakukan sekarang adalah menjadi lebih kuat, hanya begitu kamu bisa mengubah segalanya!
talkContent_vn: Những chuyện đã xảy ra rồi thì đừng nữa, việc duy nhất bạn cần làm bây giờ là trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn, chỉ có như vậy mới có thể thay đổi mọi thứ!

talkContent: Damn it…! Why did you invade our world without permission?!
talkContent_ma: Bebal! Bebal! Bebal! Semuanya pergi mampus je lah!
talkContent_en: Damn it…! Why did you invade our world without permission?!
talkContent_th: พูดมาก! พูดมาก! พูดมาก! พวกแกไปตายให้หมดเลย!
talkContent_ph: Daldal nang daldal! Daldal pa kayo! Lahat kayo, mamatay na!
talkContent_in: Cerewet! Cerewet! Cerewet! Kalian semua mati saja!
talkContent_vn: Lảm nhảm! Lảm nhảm! Lảm nhảm! Tất cả lũ bay đi chết hết đi!

talkContent: What's done is done. The only thing you need to do now is become stronger—only then can you change anything!
talkContent_ma: Eh, nampaknya di sana ada seekor Charmander.
talkContent_en: What's done is done. The only thing you need to do now is become stronger—only then can you change anything!
talkContent_th: เฮ้ ดูเหมือนมีชาร์มานเดอร์อยู่ตรงนั้น
talkContent_ph: Uy, parang may Charmander doon.
talkContent_in: Eh, sepertinya di sana ada seekor Charmander.
talkContent_vn: Ê, hình như ở đằng kia có một con Charmander.

talkContent: Blah blah blah! Blah blah blah! Blah blah blah! All of you, just die already!
talkContent_ma: Cuba tangkap dia!
talkContent_en: Blah blah blah! Blah blah blah! Blah blah blah! All of you, just die already!
talkContent_th: รีบจับมันให้ได้นะ!
talkContent_ph: Subukan mong hulihin 'yon!
talkContent_in: Ayo usahakan tangkap dia!
talkContent_vn: Hãy cố gắng bắt lấy nó đi!

talkContent: Hey, I think there's a Charmander over there.
talkContent_ma: Guk guk!!
talkContent_en: Hey, I think there's a Charmander over there.
talkContent_th: โฮ่ง โฮ่ง!!
talkContent_ph: Aw aw!!
talkContent_in: Guk guk!!
talkContent_vn: Gâu gâu!!

talkContent: Try your best to catch it!
talkContent_ma: Akhirnya kita sampai ke tahap ini.
talkContent_en: Try your best to catch it!
talkContent_th: ในที่สุดก็มาถึงขั้นตอนนี้แล้ว
talkContent_ph: Sa wakas, umabot na rin tayo sa puntong ito.
talkContent_in: Akhirnya sampai juga ke tahap ini.
talkContent_vn: Cuối cùng cũng đến bước này rồi.

talkContent: Woof woof!!
talkContent_ma: Alan, kamu sangat kuat, jadi aku akan gunakan semua kekuatanku kali ini!
talkContent_en: Woof woof!!
talkContent_th: อาลัน นายเก่งมาก งั้นฉันจะสู้เต็มที่เลย!
talkContent_ph: Alan, ang lakas mo! Kung gano’n, gagamitin ko na ang buong lakas ko!
talkContent_in: Alan, kamu sangat kuat, jadi aku akan mengeluarkan seluruh kemampuanku!
talkContent_vn: Alan, cậu rất mạnh, vậy thì để tớ dốc toàn lực vậy!

talkContent: We've finally reached this point.
talkContent_ma: Aku sentiasa menantikan untuk bertarung denganmu di sini.
talkContent_en: We've finally reached this point.
talkContent_th: ฉันตั้งตารอที่จะได้ประลองกับนายที่นี่มาโดยตลอด
talkContent_ph: Matagal ko nang inaasam na makalaban ka rito.
talkContent_in: Aku selalu menantikan bisa melawanmu di sini.
talkContent_vn: Tôi luôn mong chờ được đối đầu với bạn ở đây.

talkContent: Gekkouga, the opponent is worthy now!
talkContent_ma: Gekkouga, lawan kali ini sudah cukup hebat!
talkContent_en: Gekkouga, the opponent is worthy now!
talkContent_th: Gekkouga ศัตรูครั้งนี้สมกับฝีมือของเราแล้ว!
talkContent_ph: Gekkouga, sapat na ang kalaban – handa na sa laban!
talkContent_in: Gekkouga, lawannya sudah sepadan!
talkContent_vn: Gekkouga, đối thủ đã đủ tầm rồi!

topTalk: I swear, we will abide by the spirit of the Pokémon League, fighting with honor...!
topTalk_ma: Saya bersumpah, kami akan mematuhi semangat Liga Pokémon, bertarung dengan kehormatan...!
topTalk_en: I swear, we will abide by the spirit of the Pokémon League, fighting with honor...!
topTalk_th: ข้าพเจ้าขอสาบานว่า เราจะปฏิบัติตามจิตวิญญาณของ Pokémon League, ต่อสู้ด้วยความซื่อสัตย์...!

talkContent_ma: Jangan risau, aku takkan kalah!
talkContent_en: Don’t worry, I won’t lose!
talkContent_th: ไม่ต้องห่วง ฉันจะไม่แพ้แน่นอน!
talkContent_ph: Don’t worry, hindi ako matatalo!
talkContent_in: Tenang saja, aku tidak akan kalah!
talkContent_vn: Yên tâm đi, tôi sẽ không thua đâu!

talkContent: Boo hoo, I lost... So frustrating!
talkContent_ma: Hu hu, kalah rồi, aduh, geram betul!
talkContent_en: Boo hoo, I lost... So frustrating!
talkContent_th: ฮือฮือ สู้ไม่ได้ แง โมโหจังเลย!
talkContent_ph: Hu hu, hindi ko siya kaya! Ayy, nakakainis talaga!
talkContent_in: Huhu, kalah deh, aduh, kesel banget!
talkContent_vn: Hu hu, đánh không lại, ái chà, tức quá đi!

talkContent: Haha, you’re kind of cute actually. Playing hero battle games is pretty easy!
talkContent_ma: Haha, tiba-tiba rasa kamu agak comel, main game gaya lawan hero memang senang!
talkContent_en: Haha, you’re kind of cute actually. Playing hero battle games is pretty easy!
talkContent_th: ฮ่า ๆ อยู่ดี ๆ ก็รู้สึกว่านายดูน่ารักแฮะ เกมแนวต่อสู้นี่มันง่ายจริง ๆ!
talkContent_ph: Haha, parang naging cute ka bigla. Madali lang talaga ang ganitong labanan sa strategy game!
talkContent_in: Haha, tiba-tiba kamu terlihat imut juga, main game auto-battle kayak gini gampang banget!
talkContent_vn: Haha, tự nhiên thấy bạn hơi đáng yêu, chơi game kiểu đấu tướng đúng là dễ dàng!

talkContent: Alright then, Dumbhead, I’m Bai Lu. Hope we meet again someday.
talkContent_ma: Baiklah, Bodoh, saya bernama Bai Lu, semoga kita bertemu lagi.
talkContent_en: Alright then, Dumbhead, I’m Bai Lu. Hope we meet again someday.
talkContent_th: โอเคก็ได้ ไอตัวบื้อ ฉันชื่อไป๋ลู่ ไว้เจอกันใหม่นะ
talkContent_ph: Ayos lang, Daitou, ang pangalan ko ay Bai Lu — sana’y magkita tayong muli!
talkContent_in: Oke deh, Daitou, namaku Bai Lu, semoga kita berjodoh dan bisa bertemu lagi ya.
talkContent_vn: Ừ thôi được rồi, Đ呆头, tôi tên là Bạch Lộ, có duyên gặp lại nhé.

talkContent: There’s a high energy reading up ahead!
talkContent_ma: Reaksi tenaga tinggi di depan!
talkContent_en: There’s a high energy reading up ahead!
talkContent_th: ด้านหน้ามีพลังงานสูง!
talkContent_ph: May mataas na energy reading sa harapan!
talkContent_in: Ada reaksi energi tinggi di depan!
talkContent_vn: Phản ứng năng lượng cao phía trước!

talkContent: What’s going on?
talkContent_ma: Apa tu?
talkContent_en: What’s going on?
talkContent_th: เกิดอะไรขึ้นน่ะ?
talkContent_ph: Anong nangyayari?!
talkContent_in: Apa itu?
talkContent_vn: Chuyện gì vậy?

talkContent: Looks like it’s a wild Hero Lord, Loto.
talkContent_ma: Nampaknya itu adalah Panglima Wira Liar Loto.
talkContent_en: Looks like it’s a wild Hero Lord, Loto.
talkContent_th: เหมือนว่าจะเป็นจอมทัพฮีโร่ป่า Loto
talkContent_ph: Mukhang si Loto, ang Panginoon ng mga wild hero.
talkContent_in: Sepertinya itu adalah Raja Pahlawan Liar, Loto.
talkContent_vn: Có vẻ như là Lãnh chúa anh hùng hoang dã Loto.

talkContent: Hmph, let’s see what this so-called legendary Hero Lord is made of!
talkContent_ma: Hmph, biar aku tengok si panglima wira lagenda ni jenis macam mana!
talkContent_en: Hmph, let’s see what this so-called legendary Hero Lord is made of!
talkContent_th: หึ ให้ฉันดูหน่อยสิว่าไอ้จอมทัพฮีโร่ในตำนานนี่มันแค่ไหนกันเชียว!
talkContent_ph: Hmm, tingnan natin kung anong klaseng tao ang sinasabing Panginoon ng mga bayani sa alamat!
talkContent_in: Hmph, biar kulihat si Raja Pahlawan dari legenda ini seperti apa orangnya!
talkContent_vn: Hừ, để ta xem thử cái tên lãnh chúa anh hùng trong truyền thuyết này là hạng người gì!

talkContent: Seems like we’ve arrived at a mysterious tribe that’s not even on the map—Lac Thac.
talkContent_ma: Nampaknya kita sampai ke satu puak misteri yang tak ada dalam peta, Lak Thac.
talkContent_en: Seems like we’ve arrived at a mysterious tribe that’s not even on the map—Lac Thac.
talkContent_th: เหมือนเรามาถึงเผ่าลึกลับที่ไม่มีในแผนที่แล้วแหละ ลั่วถัว
talkContent_ph: Mukhang napunta tayo sa isang misteryosong tribo na wala sa mapa, ang Lac Thac.
talkContent_in: Sepertinya kita sampai di suku misterius yang tidak ada di peta, Lak Thac.
talkContent_vn: Dường như đã đến một bộ lạc bí ẩn không có trên bản đồ, Lạc Thác.

talkContent: Hey, can you even be trusted? You’re our guide and yet we got lost?
talkContent_ma: Eh, kau ni boleh percaya ke tak, tunjuk jalan tapi boleh sesatkan aku pula?
talkContent_en: Hey, can you even be trusted? You’re our guide and yet we got lost?
talkContent_th: เฮ้ นายไว้ใจได้หรือเปล่า พามาแล้วยังหลงอีกเนี่ย?
talkContent_ph: Uy, mapagkakatiwalaan ka ba talaga? Nagtuturo ka ng daan pero naligaw tayo!
talkContent_in: Eh, kamu bisa dipercaya nggak sih, bawa jalan malah bikin aku nyasar?
talkContent_vn: Ê, mày có đáng tin không đấy, dẫn đường mà còn dẫn tao lạc đường được hả?

talkContent: Either way, you’re planning to explore everywhere, right? This place looks interesting, so let’s just wander around for now, Loto.
talkContent_ma: Kau pun memang nak merantau dan cabar macam-macam tempat kan, tempat ni nampak menarik juga, jalan-jalan dulu tengok macam mana, Loto.
talkContent_en: Either way, you’re planning to explore everywhere, right? This place looks interesting, so let’s just wander around for now, Loto.
talkContent_th: ยังไงนายก็จะออกผจญภัยอยู่แล้ว ที่นี่ก็ดูน่าสนใจเหมือนกัน เดินวนดูก่อนเถอะ Loto
talkContent_ph: Tutal gusto mo rin namang mag-eksplor at humarap sa hamon, mukhang interesting naman dito — ikutin muna natin, Loto.
talkContent_in: Kan kamu juga niatnya mau berpetualang ke mana-mana, tempat ini kelihatannya menarik juga, coba keliling dulu aja, Loto.
talkContent_vn: Đằng nào cậu cũng định đi khắp nơi mạo hiểm thử thách mà, chỗ này trông cũng thú vị đấy, cứ đi loanh quanh xem sao đã, Loto.

talkContent: Careful, looks like the wild beast ahead is very angry, Loto.
talkContent_ma: Hati-hati, nampaknya raksasa liar di depan tengah marah sangat, Loto.
talkContent_en: Careful, looks like the wild beast ahead is very angry, Loto.
talkContent_th: ระวังหน่อยนะ ดูเหมือนสัตว์ประหลาดป่าด้านหน้าจะโมโหอยู่นะ Loto
talkContent_ph: Mag-ingat ka, mukhang galit na galit ang halimaw sa unahan, Loto.
talkContent_in: Hati-hati, sepertinya monster liar di depan sedang sangat marah, Loto.
talkContent_vn: Cẩn thận, có vẻ như con quái vật hoang dã phía trước đang rất tức giận, Loto à.

talkContent: No big deal, I’ll handle them.
talkContent_ma: Benda kecil je tu, biar aku uruskan.
talkContent_en: No big deal, I’ll handle them.
talkContent_th: เรื่องเล็ก ปล่อยให้ฉันจัดการเอง
talkContent_ph: Walang problema, ako na bahala diyan.
talkContent_in: Tenang aja, biar aku yang urus mereka.
talkContent_vn: Chuyện nhỏ thôi, để tôi xử lý chúng cho.

talkContent: That was close—I didn’t expect such a hot-headed hero to still be around.
talkContent_ma: Tadi terkejut betul, tak sangka masih ada wira panas baran macam tu.
talkContent_en: That was close—I didn’t expect such a hot-headed hero to still be around.
talkContent_th: เมื่อกี้ตกใจหมดเลย ไม่คิดว่าจะยังมีฮีโร่หัวร้อนแบบนี้อยู่
talkContent_ph: Grabe, muntik na! Di ko akalaing may bayani pa rin na mainitin ang ulo.
talkContent_in: Barusan kaget banget, nggak nyangka masih ada pahlawan yang tempramental begitu.
talkContent_vn: Vừa rồi hú hồn, không ngờ vẫn còn anh hùng nóng tính như vậy.

talkContent: Good thing I’m strong.
talkContent_ma: Nasib baik aku kuat.
talkContent_en: Good thing I’m strong.
talkContent_th: โชคดีที่ฉันแข็งแกร่งพอ
talkContent_ph: Buti na lang at malakas ako.
talkContent_in: Untung aku kuat.
talkContent_vn: Cũng may là tôi mạnh.

talkContent: Woof woof!
talkContent_ma: Guk guk!
talkContent_en: Woof woof!
talkContent_th: โฮ่งโฮ่ง
talkContent_ph: Aw aw!
talkContent_in: Guk guk.
talkContent_vn: Gâu gâu

talkContent: Whoa! That startled me!
talkContent_ma: Hoi, terkejut aku!
talkContent_en: Whoa! That startled me!
talkContent_th: ว้าย ตกใจหมด!
talkContent_ph: Aba! Nagulat ako!
talkContent_in: Aduh, kaget banget!
talkContent_vn: Ối, giật cả mình!

talkContent: Stop panicking all the time—you’re making me jumpy too. Let me take care of him.
talkContent_ma: Jangan asyik terkejut macam tu, buat aku pun terkejut sekali, biar aku susun dia.
talkContent_en: Stop panicking all the time—you’re making me jumpy too. Let me take care of him.
talkContent_th: อย่าตกใจตลอดแบบนั้นสิ ฉันตกใจตามไปด้วยเลย เดี๋ยวฉันจัดการให้เขาเอง
talkContent_ph: Huwag ka ngang laging nagugulat nang ganyan, pati ako nadadamay — hayaan mo, ako na ang bahala sa kanya.
talkContent_in: Jangan panik terus gitu dong, bikin aku ikut kaget juga, biar aku bantu atur dia.
talkContent_vn: Đừng có lúc nào cũng hốt hoảng lên như thế, làm tôi cũng bị giật mình theo đấy, để tôi sắp xếp cho anh ta.

talkContent: Oh, are you here to join the Battle Festival too?
talkContent_ma: Oh, kamu pun datang untuk Festival Pertarungan ke?
talkContent_en: Oh, are you here to join the Battle Festival too?
talkContent_th: โอ้ คุณก็มาร่วมงานเทศกาลต่อสู้เหมือนกันเหรอ?
talkContent_ph: Uy, dumalo ka rin ba sa Festival ng Labanan?
talkContent_in: Oh, kamu juga datang untuk ikut Festival Duel ya?
talkContent_vn: Ồ, bạn cũng đến tham gia Lễ hội Đối kháng à?

talkContent: What’s that?
talkContent_ma: Apa tu?
talkContent_en: What’s that?
talkContent_th: เทศกาลอะไรเหรอ?
talkContent_ph: Ano ‘yon?
talkContent_in: Itu apa?
talkContent_vn: Cái đó là cái gì?

talkContent: What?! How can you be here without knowing anything about it?
talkContent_ma: Hah! Macam mana kamu boleh datang sini tapi tak tahu apa-apa?
talkContent_en: What?! How can you be here without knowing anything about it?
talkContent_th: หา! คุณไม่รู้อะไรเลยแล้วมาที่นี่ได้ไง?
talkContent_ph: Ha?! Di mo alam pero nandito ka?!
talkContent_in: Hah! Kok kamu nggak tahu sih, tapi malah datang ke sini?
talkContent_vn: Hả! Sao cậu không biết gì mà cũng đến đây vậy?

talkContent: It’s a traditional event of this tribe. It’s about to begin. I came to join and collect information. Do you mind battling me?
talkContent_ma: Itu acara tradisi puak ni, kebetulan nak mula sekarang, aku datang untuk sertai dan ambil data, kamu tak kisah lawan aku satu pusingan kan?
talkContent_en: It’s a traditional event of this tribe. It’s about to begin. I came to join and collect information. Do you mind battling me?
talkContent_th: นั่นคือกิจกรรมดั้งเดิมของเผ่านี้ พอดีว่ากำลังจะเริ่ม ฉันมาเข้าร่วมและเก็บข้อมูล คุณไม่รังเกียจจะประลองกับฉันสักหน่อยใช่ไหม?
talkContent_ph: Tradisyon ‘yan ng tribong ‘to — tamang-tama, magsisimula na. Pumunta ako rito para sumali at kumuha ng impormasyon. Ayos lang ba na maglaban tayo?
talkContent_in: Itu kegiatan tradisional suku ini, pas banget baru mulai, aku datang buat ikut dan ambil dokumentasi, kamu nggak keberatan duel denganku kan?
talkContent_vn: Đó là hoạt động truyền thống của bộ lạc này, vừa hay lúc này sắp bắt đầu, tôi đến để tham gia và lấy tư liệu, bạn không ngại đấu với tôi một trận chứ?

talkContent: As long as it’s a fight, anyone can play!
talkContent_ma: Asalkan lawan, sesiapa pun boleh main!
talkContent_en: As long as it’s a fight, anyone can play!
talkContent_th: แค่เป็นการต่อสู้ ใครมาก็เล่นได้!
talkContent_ph: Basta laban, kahit sino puwede sumali!
talkContent_in: Kalau soal pertarungan, siapa pun boleh ikut!
talkContent_vn: Chỉ cần là đối chiến, ai đến cũng chơi!

talkContent: Didn’t expect someone so young to fight so well.
talkContent_ma: Tak sangka kamu muda tapi hebat berlawan.
talkContent_en: Didn’t expect someone so young to fight so well.
talkContent_th: ไม่อยากเชื่อว่าคุณยังเด็กแต่ฝีมือดีขนาดนี้
talkContent_ph: Di ko akalain na bata ka pa pero galing mong lumaban!
talkContent_in: Nggak nyangka kamu masih muda tapi jago bertarung juga.
talkContent_vn: Không ngờ bạn còn trẻ mà chiến đấu giỏi thật đấy.

talkContent: Of course!
talkContent_ma: Dah tentu!
talkContent_en: Of course!
talkContent_th: ไม่ต้องพูดก็รู้
talkContent_ph: Natural lang ‘yan.
talkContent_in: Tentu saja dong.
talkContent_vn: Còn phải nói sao.

talkContent: Looks like you’ve got a bright future ahead. Can I get your autograph in advance?
talkContent_ma: Nampaknya masa depan kamu sangat cerah, boleh tak saya minta tandatangan sekarang?
talkContent_en: Looks like you’ve got a bright future ahead. Can I get your autograph in advance?
talkContent_th: ดูเหมือนอนาคตคุณจะสดใสนะ ขอเซ็นชื่อไว้ก่อนได้ไหม?
talkContent_ph: Mukhang maliwanag ang kinabukasan mo — puwede ba akong humingi ng autograph?
talkContent_in: Sepertinya masa depanmu akan sangat cerah, boleh aku minta tanda tangan dulu nggak?
talkContent_vn: Có vẻ như tương lai của bạn sẽ rất tươi sáng, tôi có thể xin chữ ký trước được không?

talkContent: (Takes out pen and paper) Sure, here you go! When I win the championship, come interview me!
talkContent_ma: (Pegang kertas dan pen) Ya, ambil ni, nanti bila aku menang kejuaraan, datang temu ramah aku ya.
talkContent_en: (Takes out pen and paper) Sure, here you go! When I win the championship, come interview me!
talkContent_th: (ยื่นกระดาษกับปากกา) ได้เลย รับไว้สิ วันหลังตอนฉันได้แชมป์ก็มาสัมภาษณ์ฉันได้นะ
talkContent_ph: (Hawak papel at bolpen) Sige, heto, sa susunod na manalo ako sa championship, i-interviewhin mo ako ha!
talkContent_in: (Ambil kertas dan pena) Ya, ambil saja, nanti kalau aku menang kejuaraan, datang wawancara aku ya.
talkContent_vn: (Cầm lấy giấy bút) Vâng, cầm lấy đi, sau này khi tôi thắng giải vô địch thì đến phỏng vấn tôi nhé.

talkContent: Wow, big ambition! Deal!
talkContent_ma: Wah, cita-cita tinggi tu, baiklah, setuju!
talkContent_en: Wow, big ambition! Deal!
talkContent_th: โอ้ เป้าหมายยิ่งใหญ่นะ งั้นตกลงตามนี้เลย!
talkContent_ph: Astig! Sige, deal tayo diyan!
talkContent_in: Wah, cita-citanya tinggi, kalau begitu kita sepakat ya!
talkContent_vn: Chà, chí hướng cao đấy, vậy thì nhất trí nhé!

talkContent: Hello there, new Trainer. At your current level, you’re not strong enough to join the festival yet.
talkContent_ma: Hai kawan, jurulatih baru sampai. Dengan tahap sekarang ni, kamu belum layak masuk festival ni.
talkContent_en: Hello there, new Trainer. At your current level, you’re not strong enough to join the festival yet.
talkContent_th: สวัสดี เทรนเนอร์หน้าใหม่ จากฝีมือแบบนี้คุณยังไม่พร้อมเข้าร่วมเทศกาลหรอกนะ
talkContent_ph: Hi! Ikaw ang bagong trainer, ‘di ba? Sa totoo lang, hindi ka pa handa sumali sa festival.
talkContent_in: Halo, pelatih baru. Dengan kemampuanmu sekarang, kamu belum cukup kuat untuk ikut festival.
talkContent_vn: Chào bạn, huấn luyện viên mới đến. Với trình độ này thì bạn chưa đủ sức tham gia lễ hội đâu.

talkContent: Hey pretty lady, I think I’ve fallen for you. Stick with me later, okay?
talkContent_ma: Cantiknya kamu, aku dah jatuh hati, nanti ikut abang ya!
talkContent_en: Hey pretty lady, I think I’ve fallen for you. Stick with me later, okay?
talkContent_th: สาวสวยจังเลย พี่ชอบน้องแล้วล่ะ เดี๋ยวไปกับพี่นะ!
talkContent_ph: Uy ganda, gusto na kita! Mamaya sumama ka na sa akin ha~
talkContent_in: Cantik, aku suka kamu deh, nanti ikut aku ya!
talkContent_vn: Em đẹp ơi, anh thích em rồi đó, lát nữa đi theo anh nha!

talkContent: Kids these days sure talk big. Let me see what you’re really made of.
talkContent_ma: Budak zaman sekarang ni bercakap besar betul, mari, biar aku tengok kekuatan kamu.
talkContent_en: Kids these days sure talk big. Let me see what you’re really made of.
talkContent_th: เดี๋ยวนี้วัยรุ่นพูดกันแรงจริง งั้นฉันมาดูหน่อยว่าฝีมือนายถึงแค่ไหน
talkContent_ph: Ang yabang ng mga kabataan ngayon — halika, subukan nga natin ang lakas mo!
talkContent_in: Anak muda zaman sekarang omongannya besar juga, ayo, biar aku lihat kemampuanmu sejauh mana.
talkContent_vn: Đám thanh niên bây giờ khẩu khí thật lớn, nào, để tôi xem thử thực lực của cậu đến đâu.

talkContent: Let’s see who my final opponent is!
talkContent_ma: Biar aku tengok siapa lawan terakhir aku!
talkContent_en: Let’s see who my final opponent is!
talkContent_th: มาดูว่าคู่ต่อสู้สุดท้ายของฉันเป็นใครกันแน่!
talkContent_ph: Tingnan ko nga kung sino ang magiging huli kong kalaban!
talkContent_in: Biar aku lihat siapa lawan terakhirku kali ini!
talkContent_vn: Để tôi xem đối thủ cuối cùng của tôi là ai nào!

talkContent: Hey!
talkContent_ma: Eh!
talkContent_en: Hey!
talkContent_th: เฮ้!
talkContent_ph: Uy!
talkContent_in: Eh!
talkContent_vn: Ê!

talkContent: Hey!
talkContent_ma: Eh!
talkContent_en: Hey!
talkContent_th: เฮ้!
talkContent_ph: Uy!
talkContent_in: Eh!
talkContent_vn: Ê!

talkContent: I didn’t expect to see you here. It’s been a while, hasn’t it?
talkContent_ma: Tak sangka boleh jumpa kamu di sini. Lama tak jumpa ya.
talkContent_en: I didn’t expect to see you here. It’s been a while, hasn’t it?
talkContent_th: ไม่นึกว่าจะเจอนายที่นี่ ไม่เจอกันนานเลยนะ
talkContent_ph: Uy, di ko akalain na makikita kita rito. Matagal na rin ‘no?
talkContent_in: Nggak nyangka ketemu kamu di sini. Lama nggak jumpa ya.
talkContent_vn: Không ngờ lại gặp cậu ở đây. Lâu rồi không gặp nhỉ.

talkContent: I’ve gotten stronger too, come test me, and you’d better go all out.
talkContent_ma: Aku pun dah jadi lebih kuat, mari cuba uji kekuatan, kamu kena guna sepenuh tenaga tau.
talkContent_en: I’ve gotten stronger too, come test me, and you’d better go all out.
talkContent_th: ฉันก็แข็งแกร่งขึ้นแล้ว มาลองสู้ดูสิ นายต้องเอาจริงนะ!
talkContent_ph: Mas lumakas na rin ako ngayon — tara, sparring tayo, kailangan mong seryosohin to ha!
talkContent_in: Aku juga sudah jadi lebih kuat, ayo tanding, kamu harus serius ya.
talkContent_vn: Tôi cũng mạnh hơn rồi đó, đến thử tài đi, cậu phải dùng hết sức đấy nhé.

talkContent: Of course!

talkContent_en: Of course!

talkContent_ph: Siyempre naman!
talkContent_in: Tentu saja!
talkContent_vn: Đương nhiên rồi!

talkContent: Oops, slipped up. You’ve gotten a lot stronger.

talkContent_en: Oops, slipped up. You’ve gotten a lot stronger.
talkContent_th: โอ๊ะ เล่นพลาดไปหน่อย นายแข็งแกร่งขึ้นเยอะเลยนะ

talkContent_in: Aduh, nggak sengaja. Kamu sudah jadi lebih kuat ya.
talkContent_vn: Ối chà chà, lỡ tay rồi. Ngươi mạnh lên nhiều đấy.

talkContent: You too. This battle taught me a lot.

talkContent_en: You too. This battle taught me a lot.
talkContent_th: นายก็เหมือนกัน การต่อสู้ครั้งนี้ช่วยให้ฉันได้เรียนรู้อะไรเยอะเลย
talkContent_ph: Ikaw rin, marami akong natutunan sa laban na ‘to.
talkContent_in: Kamu juga, pertarungan kali ini membuat aku belajar banyak.
talkContent_vn: Bạn cũng vậy, trận đấu lần này giúp tôi học hỏi được rất nhiều.

talkContent: No need to be modest. You’ve won, so cheer up. Let’s battle again next time.

talkContent_en: No need to be modest. You’ve won, so cheer up. Let’s battle again next time.
talkContent_th: อย่าเกรงใจเลย นายชนะแล้วก็ยิ้มหน่อยนะ ไว้คราวหน้ามาสู้กันอีก
talkContent_ph: Wag ka nang mahiya — nanalo ka naman! Magsaya ka, sa susunod laban ulit tayo!
talkContent_in: Jangan terlalu sopan, kamu yang menang, jadi bersenang-senanglah, lain kali kita bertarung lagi ya.
talkContent_vn: Bạn cũng đừng khách sáo nữa, vì bạn đã thắng rồi thì cứ vui vẻ lên, sau này lại đấu nữa nhé.

talkContent: Let’s fight again.

talkContent: This eerie feeling… hope there are no ghosts, Loto.

talkContent_en: This eerie feeling… hope there are no ghosts, Loto.

talkContent_ph: Ang creepy ng lugar na ‘to… sana walang multo, Loto.
talkContent_in: Perasaan gelap ini... semoga bukan hantu ya, Loto.
talkContent_vn: Cảm giác âm u này, chắc không có ma đâu nhỉ, Loto.

talkContent: Stop scaring yourself. It’s probably just a wild hero, watch this.

talkContent_en: Stop scaring yourself. It’s probably just a wild hero, watch this.

talkContent_in: Jangan takut sendiri, mungkin cuma pahlawan liar saja, lihat ini.
talkContent_vn: Đừng tự hù mình nữa, chắc lại anh hùng hoang dã thôi, xem đây.

talkContent: Hey, that voice… no way, it’s Mew!

talkContent_en: Hey, that voice… no way, it’s Mew!

talkContent_ph: Uy, ‘yung boses na ‘yon — di ako makapaniwala — si Mộng Huyễn ‘yon!
talkContent_in: Eh, suara ini... nggak salah lagi, itu Mimpi!
talkContent_vn: Ê, cái giọng này, không thể tin được, lại là Mộng Huyễn đó!

talkContent_in: Itu saja kamu nggak tahu? Itu pahlawan legendaris, seumur hidup mungkin belum tentu bisa lihat sekali!

talkContent_en: What’s going on? You scared me.

talkContent_in: Apa itu, bikin kaget saja.

talkContent_en: Whoa, that’s actually Mewtwo!

talkContent_ph: Uy, si Mewtwo pala ‘yon!
talkContent_in: Wah, ternyata itu Mewtwo!
talkContent_vn: Ồ, vậy mà là Mewtwo đó!

talkContent: Ah! Ah! Who am I! Where is this!!! Who are you????

talkContent_en: Ah! Ah! Who am I! Where is this!!! Who are you????

talkContent_ph: Aaaaahhh! Sino ako?! Nasaan ako?! Sino ka?!?!
talkContent_in: A! A! Aku siapa! Ini di mana!!! Kamu siapa????
talkContent_vn: Á! Á! Tôi là ai! Đây là đâu!!! Bạn là ai????

talkContent: Whoa, this hero can talk like a human.
talkContent_ma: Eh, hero ni pandai cakap bahasa manusia lah.
talkContent_en: Whoa, this hero can talk like a human.

talkContent_ph: Uy, ang hero na ‘to marunong magsalita ng wika ng tao?!
talkContent_in: Eh, pahlawan ini ternyata bisa bicara bahasa manusia.
talkContent_vn: Ê, tướng này vậy mà biết nói tiếng người kìa.

talkContent: An extremely rare hero, Loto.
talkContent_ma: Seorang wira yang sangat-sangat jarang ditemui, Loto.
talkContent_en: An extremely rare hero, Loto.

talkContent_in: Seorang pahlawan yang sangat langka, Loto.
talkContent_vn: Một anh hùng cực kỳ hiếm có, Loto.

talkContent: Humans! Humans!!! All humans must be destroyed!
talkContent_ma: Manusia! Manusia!!! Semua manusia patut dimusnahkan!
talkContent_en: Humans! Humans!!! All humans must be destroyed!

talkContent_ph: Mga tao! Mga tao!!! Dapat nang lipulin lahat ng tao!
talkContent_in: Manusia! Manusia!!! Semua manusia harus dimusnahkan!
talkContent_vn: Loài người! Loài người!!! Tất cả loài người nên bị tiêu diệt!

talkContent: Why is this happening?!
talkContent_ma: Kenapa jadi macam ni?!
talkContent_en: Why is this happening?!
talkContent_th: ทำไมถึงเป็นแบบนี้?!
talkContent_ph: Bakit ganun?!
talkContent_in: Kenapa bisa begitu?!
talkContent_vn: Tại sao lại như vậy?!

talkContent: Accept your destruction, humans!
talkContent_ma: Terimalah kehancuranmu, manusia!
talkContent_en: Accept your destruction, humans!
talkContent_th: ยอมรับชะตากรรมของพวกเจ้าซะ มนุษย์!
talkContent_ph: Tanggapin n’yo na ang pagkawasak, sangkatauhan!
talkContent_in: Terimalah kehancuranmu, manusia!
talkContent_vn: Hãy chấp nhận sự diệt vong đi, loài người!

talkContent: Seems like my power hasn’t fully recovered. Humans, we’ll meet again! I won’t spare you next time!
talkContent_ma: Nampaknya kuasa aku masih belum pulih sepenuhnya. Manusia, kita jumpa lagi nanti! Kali depan, aku takkan biarkan kau hidup!
talkContent_en: Seems like my power hasn’t fully recovered. Humans, we’ll meet again! I won’t spare you next time!
talkContent_th: ดูเหมือนพลังของฉันยังฟื้นคืนไม่เต็มที่ มนุษย์ เอาไว้เจอกันใหม่! คราวหน้าฉันจะไม่ไว้ชีวิตเจ้าอีกแน่!
talkContent_ph: Mukhang hindi pa rin lubos na bumalik ang lakas ko. Tao, magkikita tayong muli! Sa susunod, hindi na kita palalagpasin!
talkContent_in: Sepertinya kekuatanku belum sepenuhnya pulih. Manusia, sampai jumpa lagi! Kali berikutnya aku tidak akan mengampunimu!
talkContent_vn: Xem ra năng lực của ta vẫn chưa hồi phục. Loài người, hẹn gặp lại sau! Lần tới gặp mặt ta sẽ không tha cho ngươi đâu!

talkContent: Hey, wait, slow down, what’s going on?!
talkContent_ma: Eh, tunggu dulu, perlahan sikit, apa yang sedang berlaku ni?
talkContent_en: Hey, wait, slow down, what’s going on?!
talkContent_th: เฮ้ เดี๋ยวสิ ใจเย็นก่อน เกิดอะไรขึ้นกันแน่?
talkContent_ph: Uy, sandali lang, anong nangyayari?
talkContent_in: Eh, tunggu, pelan-pelan, ada apa ini?
talkContent_vn: Ê, khoan đã, từ từ, chuyện gì vậy?

talkContent: He flew away, Loto.
talkContent_ma: Dah terbang pergi, Loto.
talkContent_en: He flew away, Loto.
talkContent_th: บินไปแล้ว Loto
talkContent_ph: Lumipad na siya, Loto.
talkContent_in: Sudah terbang pergi, Loto.
talkContent_vn: Bay đi rồi, Loto.

talkContent: Seems like he’s been through something terrible.
talkContent_ma: Nampaknya dia dah lalui sesuatu yang tak baik.
talkContent_en: Seems like he’s been through something terrible.
talkContent_th: เหมือนว่าเขา/เธอ/มัน/ท่าน ผ่านอะไรมาน่ากลัวแน่เลย

talkContent_in: Sepertinya dia telah mengalami sesuatu yang buruk.
talkContent_vn: Hình như anh ấy/cậu ấy/ông ấy/bà ấy đã trải qua chuyện gì đó không hay.

talkContent: Let’s hope nothing bad happens.

talkContent_en: Let’s hope nothing bad happens.

talkContent_in: Semoga tidak terjadi apa-apa.

talkContent_en: Didn’t expect we’d get a chance to come to such a paradise resort, Loto.

talkContent_ph: Di ko inakala na makakarating tayo sa mga paraisong resort na ganito! Loto.
talkContent_in: Nggak nyangka kita lại punya kesempatan ke tempat liburan surga seperti ini! Loto.
talkContent_vn: Không ngờ chúng ta lại có cơ hội đến những khu nghỉ dưỡng thiên đường thế này! Loto.

talkContent: I’m still a bit worried about what happened with Mewtwo.

talkContent_en: I’m still a bit worried about what happened with Mewtwo.

talkContent_ph: Sa totoo lang, medyo iniisip ko pa rin si Mewtwo.
talkContent_in: Aku ternyata masih sedikit kepikiran soal Mewtwo.
talkContent_vn: Tôi quả nhiên vẫn còn hơi để ý đến chuyện Mewtwo.

talkContent: Don’t overthink it—when the time comes, it’ll all work out.

talkContent_en: Don’t overthink it—when the time comes, it’ll all work out.

talkContent_in: Jangan terlalu dipikirkan, perahu sampai jembatan pasti lurus jalannya.
talkContent_vn: Đừng nghĩ nhiều quá, thuyền đến đầu cầu ắt sẽ thẳng thôi mà.

talkContent: Yeah, true. Let me deal with these small fry first.
talkContent_ma: Hmm, betul juga, biar aku selesaikan budak-budak ni dulu.
talkContent_en: Yeah, true. Let me deal with these small fry first.

talkContent_ph: Tama ka rin, ayusin ko muna ang mga kalaban na ito.
talkContent_in: Hmm, benar juga, biar aku urus dulu gerombolan kecil ini.
talkContent_vn: Ừm, cũng đúng, để tôi xử lý đám tép riu này trước đã.

talkContent: Oh, you slowpoke—I didn’t expect to run into you here.

talkContent_en: Oh, you slowpoke—I didn’t expect to run into you here.

talkContent_in: Wah, si lamban, nggak nyangka ketemu kamu di sini.
talkContent_vn: Ồ, cái đồ chậm chạp, ai ngờ lại gặp cậu ở đây đấy.

talkContent: I didn’t expect to see you either. You look stronger now.
talkContent_ma: Aku pun tak sangka boleh jumpa kamu, nampaknya kamu dah makin hebat.
talkContent_en: I didn’t expect to see you either. You look stronger now.
talkContent_th: ฉันเองก็ไม่คิดว่าจะเจอนาย นายดูแข็งแกร่งขึ้นนะ

talkContent_in: Aku juga nggak nyangka ketemu kamu, kamu kelihatan lebih kuat sekarang.
talkContent_vn: Tôi cũng không ngờ lại gặp bạn ở đây, trông bạn mạnh mẽ hơn đấy.

talkContent: Of course. Let me show you the new power I’ve gained! Come out, Firebird!
talkContent_ma: Sudah tentu, biar aku tunjukkan kekuatan baru yang aku perolehi! Keluar, Burung Api!
talkContent_en: Of course. Let me show you the new power I’ve gained! Come out, Firebird!
talkContent_th: แน่นอนอยู่แล้ว! ให้แกได้เห็นพลังใหม่ของฉันเอง! ออกมา Firebird!

talkContent_in: Tentu saja, biar kamu tahu kekuatan baruku! Muncullah, Burung Api!
talkContent_vn: Đương nhiên rồi, để ngươi mở mang kiến thức sức mạnh mới có được của ta đi! Ra đây, Hoả Diễm Điểu!

talkContent: Firebird? You managed to tame such a powerful hero?! But I won’t lose either! Come, my hero!
talkContent_ma: Burung Api? Kamu berjaya tangkap wira kuat macam tu?! Tapi aku pun takkan kalah, mari, wira aku!
talkContent_en: Firebird? You managed to tame such a powerful hero?! But I won’t lose either! Come, my hero!
talkContent_th: Firebird? แกสามารถจับฮีโร่ที่แข็งแกร่งแบบนั้นได้ด้วยเหรอ! แต่ฉันก็จะไม่แพ้เหมือนกัน มาเลย ฮีโร่ของฉัน!
talkContent_ph: Moltres?! Nakontrol mo ang isang malakas na bayani ng ganitong kalibre?! Pero hindi rin ako magpapatalo, tara na, bayani ko!
talkContent_in: Burung Api? Kamu bisa menaklukkan pahlawan sekuat itu ya! Tapi aku juga tidak akan kalah, ayo, pahlawanku!
talkContent_vn: Hỏa Diệm Điểu? Ngươi thu phục được anh hùng mạnh mẽ như vậy cơ à! Nhưng ta cũng sẽ không thua đâu, nào, anh hùng của ta!

talkContent: Kid, there’s a powerful mythical beast ahead. For your safety, you’d better not go that way.

talkContent_en: Kid, there’s a powerful mythical beast ahead. For your safety, you’d better not go that way.

talkContent_ph: Uy bata, may isang napakalakas na diyos-hayop sa unahan — mas mabuting huwag ka nang dumaan doon kung ayaw mong mapahamak.

talkContent: Whoa (drooling...) Beautiful lady, can you teach me how to play hero battle games?

talkContent_en: Whoa (drooling...) Beautiful lady, can you teach me how to play hero battle games?
talkContent_th: โอ้โห (น้ำลายไหล...) พี่สาวคนสวยครับ สอนผมเล่นเกมฮีโร่ได้ไหมครับ?
talkContent_ph: Wow~ (tumutulo laway) Ate ganda, puwede po ba akong magpaturo kung paano makipaglaban sa mga bayani?

talkContent: Aw, such a sweet talker. I’ll gladly teach you a few moves.

talkContent_en: Aw, such a sweet talker. I’ll gladly teach you a few moves.
talkContent_th: ปากหวานจัง งั้นพี่สาวจะสอนให้สักสองสามท่าก็แล้วกัน

talkContent_in: Wah, manis banget mulutnya, kakak senang dan akan ajarin kamu beberapa trik.
talkContent_vn: Ồ, miệng nhỏ thật ngọt, tỷ tỷ vui vẻ sẽ dạy cho em vài chiêu.

talkContent: Hehe, then here I come.

talkContent_in: He he, kalau begitu aku datang nih.
talkContent_vn: He he, vậy thì tôi đến đây.

talkContent: Look, look! It’s the Phoenix, Lak Thac.

talkContent_en: Look, look! It’s the Phoenix, Lak Thac.
talkContent_th: ดูสิ ดูสิ นั่นมันฟีนิกซ์นี่นา ลั่วถัว

talkContent: (Looks like it wants to fight)

topTalk: I have hundreds of ways to roast you all, better just obediently get tied up!
