topTalk_in: Selama saya ada di sini, Houndoom tidak akan mati!
topTalk_vn: Chỉ cần có tôi ở đây, Houndoom sẽ không chết!

topTalk: As long as I live, the Dragon clan will not perish!
topTalk_ma: Selagi saya masih hidup, suku Naga tidak akan musnah!
topTalk_en: As long as I live, the Dragon clan will not perish!
topTalk_th: ตราบใดที่ฉันยังมีชีวิตอยู่ เผ่ามังกรจะไม่สูญพันธุ์!
topTalk_ph: Hangga't buhay pa ako, hindi mawawala ang lahi ng Dragon!
topTalk_in: Selama saya masih hidup, suku Naga tidak akan punah!
topTalk_vn: Chỉ cần ta còn sống, Long tộc sẽ không diệt vong!

topTalk: Collapse! Reality, collapse! Spirit.
topTalk_ma: Jatuhlah! Realiti, jatuhlah! Semangat!
topTalk_en: Collapse! Reality, collapse! Spirit.
topTalk_th: จงพังทลายไป! ความจริง จงพังทลายไป! จิตวิญญาณ
topTalk_ph: Gumuho ka! Katotohanan, gumuho ka! Espiritu.
topTalk_in: Runtuhlah! Realitas, runtuhlah! Semangat!
topTalk_vn: Hãy sụp đổ đi! Hiện thực, hãy sụp đổ đi! Tinh thần.

topTalk: All troops, attack!
topTalk_ma: Pasukan, serang!
topTalk_en: All troops, attack!
topTalk_th: กองทัพทั้งหมด จู่โจม!
topTalk_ph: Lahat ng tropa, umatake!
topTalk_in: Pasukan, serbu!
topTalk_vn: Toàn quân xuất kích!

topTalk: All troops, attack!
topTalk_ma: Pasukan, serang!
topTalk_en: All troops, attack!
topTalk_th: กองทัพทั้งหมด จู่โจม!
topTalk_ph: Lahat ng tropa, umatake!
topTalk_in: Pasukan, serbu!
topTalk_vn: Toàn quân xuất kích!

topTalk: Start fighting each other!
topTalk_ma: Mula bertarung!
topTalk_en: Start fighting each other!
topTalk_th: เริ่มต่อสู้กันเถอะ!
topTalk_ph: Simulan na ang away!
topTalk_in: Mulai bertarung!
topTalk_vn: Bắt đầu đấu đá nhau đi!

topTalk: As long as my descendants exist, no one can stop me!
topTalk_ma: Selagi keturunan saya masih ada, tiada siapa yang boleh menghentikan saya!
topTalk_en: As long as my descendants exist, no one can stop me!
topTalk_th: ตราบใดที่ลูกหลานของฉันยังอยู่ ไม่มีใครหยุดฉันได้!
topTalk_ph: Hangga't nandiyan ang mga inapo ko, walang makakahadlang sa akin!
topTalk_in: Selama keturunan saya masih ada, tidak ada yang bisa menghentikan saya!
topTalk_vn: Khi con cháu ta còn đó, không ai có thể ngăn cản ta!

topTalk: As long as I’m here, my elders will always be strong like this!
topTalk_ma: Selagi saya ada di sini, para pendahulu saya akan tetap kuat!
topTalk_en: As long as I’m here, my elders will always be strong like this!
topTalk_th: ตราบใดที่ฉันอยู่ที่นี่ ผู้ใหญ่ของฉันจะยังคงแข็งแกร่งแบบนี้เสมอ!
topTalk_ph: Hangga't nandito ako, palaging malakas ang mga nakakatanda ko!
topTalk_in: Selama saya masih di sini, para pendahulu saya akan selalu kuat!
topTalk_vn: Chỉ cần tôi còn ở đây, các bậc tiền bối của tôi sẽ luôn mạnh mẽ như vậy!

topTalk: Whoever bullies the weak will face my wrath!
topTalk_ma: Siapa yang menindas yang lemah, akan merasai kemarahan saya!
topTalk_en: Whoever bullies the weak will face my wrath!
topTalk_th: ใครที่กลั่นแกล้งคนอ่อนแอ จะต้องเผชิญกับความโกรธของฉัน!
topTalk_ph: Sinumang nang-aapi sa mahina ay haharap sa aking galit!
topTalk_in: Siapa yang menindas yang lemah, akan merasakan amarah saya!
topTalk_vn: Kẻ nào ức hiếp kẻ yếu, sẽ phải hứng chịu cơn thịnh nộ của ta!

topTalk: If you want to fight our boss, you must defeat us first!
topTalk_ma: Ingin mengalahkan bos kami, perlu mengalahkan kami dahulu!
topTalk_en: If you want to fight our boss, you must defeat us first!
topTalk_th: ถ้าอยากสู้กับหัวหน้าของพวกเรา ต้องชนะพวกเราก่อน!
topTalk_ph: Kung gusto mong labanan ang boss namin, talunin mo muna kami!
topTalk_in: Ingin mengalahkan bos kami, harus mengalahkan kami dulu!
topTalk_vn: Muốn đánh ông trùm của bọn tao, phải đánh bại bọn tao trước đã!

topTalk: Who dares say I don’t know how to fly?
topTalk_ma: Siapa yang berani mengatakan saya tidak boleh terbang?
topTalk_en: Who dares say I don’t know how to fly?
topTalk_th: ใครกล้าบอกว่าฉันบินไม่ได้?
topTalk_ph: Sino ang may tapang sabihin na hindi ako marunong lumipad?
topTalk_in: Siapa yang berani mengatakan saya tidak bisa terbang?
topTalk_vn: Ai dám nói tôi không biết bay?

talkContent: In the botanical garden, there are countless strange plants, with thick foliage blocking the sunlight. Following a small path, you arrive at a clearing where the road splits into two, leading into a dense forest...
talkContent_ma: Di taman botani, terdapat pelbagai tumbuhan pelik dengan daun yang lebat menutupi cahaya matahari. Mengikuti laluan kecil, kamu tiba di satu kawasan lapang di mana jalan terbahagi kepada dua dan menuju ke hutan tebal...
talkContent_en: In the botanical garden, there are countless strange plants, with thick foliage blocking the sunlight. Following a small path, you arrive at a clearing where the road splits into two, leading into a dense forest...
talkContent_th: ในสวนพฤกษชาติมีต้นไม้แปลกประหลาดนานาชนิด กิ่งใบหนาทึบบดบังแสงแดด เมื่อเดินตามทางเล็ก ๆ ในสวน คุณจะไปถึงลานกว้างซึ่งมีทางแยกสองทางนำเข้าสู่ป่าทึบ
talkContent_ph: Sa botanical garden, napakaraming kakaibang halaman at punong matitibay, at ang mga dahon ay tumatakip sa sinag ng araw. Sa paglakad sa makitid na daan, narating ninyo ang isang clearing kung saan ang daan ay nahahati sa dalawa, patungo sa makapal na gubat...
talkContent_in: Di kebun botani, terdapat banyak sekali tanaman aneh, dengan dedaunan lebat yang menutupi sinar matahari. Mengikuti jalan kecil di kebun, kalian tiba di sebuah tanah lapang, di mana jalan bercabang menjadi dua dan menuju ke hutan lebat...
talkContent_vn: Trong vườn bách thảo có vô số loài cây kỳ lạ, cành lá xum xuê che khuất ánh mặt trời, men theo con đường nhỏ trong vườn, các bạn đến một khoảng đất trống, con đường ở đây chia làm hai, kéo dài vào khu rừng rậm...

talkContent: There are two paths here, which one should we take?
talkContent_ma: Di sini ada dua jalan, kita patut pilih yang mana satu?
talkContent_en: There are two paths here, which one should we take?
talkContent_th: ที่นี่มีสองทาง เราควรไปทางไหนดี?
talkContent_ph: Dalawa ang daan dito, alin ang dapat nating tahakin?
talkContent_in: Di sini ada dua jalan, kita harus pilih yang mana?
talkContent_vn: Ở đây có hai con đường, chúng ta nên đi đường nào?

talkContent: The explorer's notebook indicates the clue should be to the south...
talkContent_ma: Menurut buku nota penjelajah, petunjuk terletak di arah selatan...
talkContent_en: The explorer's notebook indicates the clue should be to the south...
talkContent_th: สมุดบันทึกการผจญภัยระบุว่าร่องรอยน่าจะอยู่ทางทิศใต้...
talkContent_ph: Sabi sa exploration notebook, ang susi ay nasa timog...
talkContent_in: Buku catatan petualangan menunjukkan bahwa petunjuk seharusnya ada di arah selatan...
talkContent_vn: Sổ tay thám hiểm chỉ ra rằng manh mối nên ở phía nam...

talkContent: There's a tree stump here, maybe we can use its growth rings to determine direction, everyone come take a look!
talkContent_ma: Ada tunggul pokok di sini, mungkin kita boleh guna cincin usia pokok untuk tentukan arah, mari lihat!
talkContent_en: There's a tree stump here, maybe we can use its growth rings to determine direction, everyone come take a look!
talkContent_th: ที่นี่มีตอไม้ต้นหนึ่ง บางทีเราสามารถใช้วงปีไม้เพื่อกำหนดทิศทาง มาดูกันเถอะ!
talkContent_ph: May tuod dito, baka maaari nating gamitin ang singsing ng puno para tukuyin ang direksyon, halika’t tingnan!
talkContent_in: Di sini ada sebuah tunggul pohon, mungkin kita bisa menggunakan lingkar tahun untuk menentukan arah, ayo lihat!
talkContent_vn: Ở đây có một gốc cây, có lẽ chúng ta có thể dựa vào vòng năm để xác định phương hướng, mọi người mau đến xem!

talkContent: The tree rings on the left are dense and on the right are sparse, so we should...
talkContent_ma: Cincin pokok di kiri rapat, di kanan jarang, jadi kita harus...
talkContent_en: The tree rings on the left are dense and on the right are sparse, so we should...
talkContent_th: วงปีไม้ทางซ้ายหนา ส่วนทางขวาบาง ดังนั้นเราควรจะ...
talkContent_ph: Makapal ang singsing sa kaliwa at manipis sa kanan, kaya dapat...
talkContent_in: Lingkar tahun di kiri padat, di kanan jarang, jadi kita sebaiknya...
talkContent_vn: Vòng năm của gốc cây bên trái dày bên phải thưa, vậy nên chúng ta nên...

talkContent: Taking the left path, you step into a trap set by Pokémon, and vines wrap tightly around your legs! (In the next battle, you will be bound for one round)
talkContent_ma: Jika kamu ambil jalan kiri, kamu terpijak perangkap Pokémon dan kaki kamu diikat oleh sulur! (Dalam pertempuran seterusnya, kamu akan terikat selama satu pusingan)
talkContent_en: Taking the left path, you step into a trap set by Pokémon, and vines wrap tightly around your legs! (In the next battle, you will be bound for one round)
talkContent_th: เมื่อเดินตามทางซ้าย คุณเหยียบกับดักที่โปเกมอนวางไว้ เถาวัลย์รัดขาคุณไว้! (การต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไปจะถูกพันธนาการ 1 เทิร์น)
talkContent_ph: Kung kakanan, makakatakas ka. Kung kakaliwa, naapakan mo ang patibong ng Pokémon at binalutan ng mga baging ang iyong mga paa! (Sa susunod na laban, kayo ay magiging immobilized ng isang turn)
talkContent_in: Mengambil jalan kiri, kalian menginjak jebakan yang dipasang oleh Pokémon, dan kaki kalian terikat oleh sulur! (Pertempuran berikutnya akan dibatasi selama satu giliran)
talkContent_vn: Đi theo con đường nhỏ bên trái, các bạn đã dẫm phải bẫy do Pokémon đặt ra, chân của các bạn bị dây leo trói chặt! (Trận chiến tiếp theo sẽ bị trói một hiệp)

talkContent: Taking the right path, you successfully reach the first challenge location.
talkContent_ma: Ambil jalan kanan dan kamu sampai ke lokasi cabaran pertama dengan lancar.
talkContent_en: Taking the right path, you successfully reach the first challenge location.
talkContent_th: เมื่อเดินตามทางขวา คุณไปถึงสถานที่ทดสอบแห่งแรกได้อย่างราบรื่น
talkContent_ph: Matagumpay na narating ang unang challenge kung kakanan ka.
talkContent_in: Mengambil jalan kanan, kalian berhasil mencapai lokasi tantangan pertama dengan lancar.
talkContent_vn: Đi theo con đường nhỏ bên phải, các bạn đã đến được địa điểm thử thách đầu tiên một cách thuận lợi.

talkContent: After successfully defeating Shaymin, it gifts you a green tablet with a Cottonee symbol, saying it's a clue to the final treasure.
talkContent_ma: Selepas mengalahkan Shaymin, dia memberi kamu sekeping batu hijau bergambar Cottonee dan mengatakan itu adalah petunjuk ke harta terakhir.
talkContent_en: After successfully defeating Shaymin, it gifts you a green tablet with a Cottonee symbol, saying it's a clue to the final treasure.
talkContent_th: เมื่อเอาชนะเชย์มินได้สำเร็จ เชย์มินมอบแผ่นหินสีเขียวที่มีรูปคอตโทนีให้คุณ บอกว่านี่คือเบาะแสไปยังสมบัติสุดท้าย
talkContent_ph: Matapos talunin si Shaymin, binigyan ka niya ng berdeng tablet na may larawan ni Cottonee—isang palatandaan patungo sa huling kayamanan.
talkContent_in: Setelah berhasil mengalahkan Shaymin, Shaymin memberikan tablet hijau bergambar Cottonee dan berkata itu adalah petunjuk menuju harta terakhir.
talkContent_vn: Sau khi đánh bại Shaymin thành công, Shaymin đã tặng bạn một phiến đá màu xanh lá cây có hình Cottonee và nói rằng đó là manh mối dẫn đến kho báu cuối cùng.

talkContent: You arrive at the second island. According to the exploration guide, another clue lies within the Ice House at the center of Snow Ice Island. Surrounded by white snow, thick ice blocks your vision. Xiao Ha accidentally triggers an ice trap laid by Weavile...
talkContent_ma: Kamu tiba di pulau kedua. Menurut panduan penjelajah, satu lagi petunjuk ada di Rumah Ais di tengah Pulau Salji. Sekeliling diliputi salji putih dan ais tebal yang menghalang penglihatan. Xiao Ha secara tidak sengaja terpijak perangkap ais Weavile...
talkContent_en: You arrive at the second island. According to the exploration guide, another clue lies within the Ice House at the center of Snow Ice Island. Surrounded by white snow, thick ice blocks your vision. Xiao Ha accidentally triggers an ice trap laid by Weavile...
talkContent_th: คุณไปถึงเกาะที่สอง ตามคู่มือสำรวจ เบาะแสถัดไปอยู่ในบ้านน้ำแข็งกลางเกาะน้ำแข็ง รอบ ๆ เต็มไปด้วยหิมะหนา ทัศนวิสัยต่ำ เซียวฮาเผลอเหยียบกับดักน้ำแข็งของวีไวล์...
talkContent_ph: Narating ninyo ang pangalawang isla. Ayon sa gabay, may isa pang palatandaan sa Ice House sa gitna ng Snow Island. Makapal ang yelo at hirap kayong makakita. Si Xiao Ha ay nadulas at naapakan ang trap ni Weavile...
talkContent_in: Kalian tiba di pulau kedua. Menurut panduan eksplorasi, petunjuk lain berada di rumah es di tengah Pulau Es Salju. Sekitar penuh salju putih dan es tebal menghalangi pandangan. Xiao Ha secara tidak sengaja menginjak perangkap es dari Weavile...
talkContent_vn: Các bạn đến hòn đảo thứ hai, theo sách hướng dẫn thám hiểm, một manh mối khác nằm trong ngôi nhà băng ở trung tâm Đảo Băng Tuyết, xung quanh là một màu trắng xóa, băng tuyết dày đặc cản trở tầm nhìn của các bạn, Tiểu Hà bất cẩn dẫm phải bẫy băng giá do Weavile giăng ra...

talkContent: Ah! Help, my legs are frozen!
talkContent_ma: Ah! Tolong, kaki saya beku!
talkContent_en: Ah! Help, my legs are frozen!
talkContent_th: อ๊า! ช่วยด้วย ขาฉันถูกแช่แข็งแล้ว!
talkContent_ph: Aah! Tulungan ninyo ako, nagyelo ang mga paa ko!
talkContent_in: Aah! Tolong, kakiku membeku!
talkContent_vn: Á! Cứu mạng, chân tôi bị đóng băng rồi!

talkContent: Don’t worry, I’ll help you defrost.
talkContent_ma: Jangan risau, saya akan bantu cairkan.
talkContent_en: Don’t worry, I’ll help you defrost.
talkContent_th: ไม่ต้องกลัว ฉันจะช่วยละลายให้เอง
talkContent_ph: Huwag kang matakot, tutulungan kitang tunawin ito.
talkContent_in: Jangan takut, aku akan membantumu mencairkannya.
talkContent_vn: Đừng sợ, tôi đến giúp bạn rã đông đây.

talkContent: The fast-flowing water quickly melts the ice.
talkContent_ma: Air yang mengalir deras mencairkan ais dengan cepat.
talkContent_en: The fast-flowing water quickly melts the ice.
talkContent_th: กระแสน้ำที่ไหลแรงละลายน้ำแข็งอย่างรวดเร็ว
talkContent_ph: Mabilis na tinunaw ng dumadaloy na tubig ang yelo.
talkContent_in: Aliran air deras cepat mencairkan es.
talkContent_vn: Nước chảy xiết nhanh chóng làm tan băng.

talkContent: Charmander’s flame thaws the ice but also burns Xiao Ha’s legs. (In the next battle, all heroes lose 20% HP)
talkContent_ma: Api Charmander mencairkan ais, tetapi juga menyebabkan kaki Xiao Ha melecur. (Dalam pertempuran seterusnya, semua hero kehilangan 20% HP)
talkContent_en: Charmander’s flame thaws the ice but also burns Xiao Ha’s legs. (In the next battle, all heroes lose 20% HP)
talkContent_th: ไฟของชาร์มานเดอร์แม้จะช่วยละลายน้ำแข็ง แต่ก็ทำให้เซียวฮาโดนลวกที่ขา (การต่อสู้ครั้งต่อไปฮีโร่ทุกตัวจะเสีย HP 20%)
talkContent_ph: Ngunit ang apoy ni Charmander ay nagtunaw nga ng yelo, pero napaso rin si Xiao Ha. (Sa susunod na laban, -20% HP ang lahat ng hero)
talkContent_in: Api Charmander mencairkan es, tetapi juga membakar kaki Xiao Ha. (Dalam pertempuran berikutnya, semua hero kehilangan 20% HP)
talkContent_vn: Ngọn lửa của Tiểu Hỏa Long tuy giải trừ đóng băng, nhưng cũng làm Tiểu Hà bị bỏng chân. (Trận chiến tiếp theo tất cả anh hùng mất 20% máu)

talkContent: After overcoming the challenge, you receive a blue tablet with a starfish pattern.
talkContent_ma: Selepas cabaran itu, kamu menerima batu biru bergambar tapak sulaiman.
talkContent_en: After overcoming the challenge, you receive a blue tablet with a starfish pattern.
talkContent_th: หลังผ่านบททดสอบ คุณได้รับแผ่นหินสีฟ้ามีรูปดาวทะเล
talkContent_ph: Matapos ang pagsubok, nakakuha kayo ng asul na tablet na may larawan ng starfish.
talkContent_in: Setelah menyelesaikan tantangan, kalian mendapat tablet biru bergambar bintang laut.
talkContent_vn: Sau khi vượt qua thử thách, các bạn nhận được một phiến đá màu xanh lam có hình vẽ ngôi sao biển.

talkContent: The third island is full of a high-tech vibe, with strange buildings and devices everywhere. A mirror wall catches your attention—it reflects your image but performs different actions...
talkContent_ma: Pulau ketiga penuh dengan suasana teknologi, dengan bangunan dan alat pelik. Sebuah dinding cermin menarik perhatian—ia memantulkan bayang kamu tetapi membuat pergerakan berbeza...
talkContent_en: The third island is full of a high-tech vibe, with strange buildings and devices everywhere. A mirror wall catches your attention—it reflects your image but performs different actions...
talkContent_th: เกาะที่สามเต็มไปด้วยกลิ่นอายแห่งเทคโนโลยี เต็มไปด้วยสิ่งปลูกสร้างและอุปกรณ์ล้ำสมัย กำแพงกระจกหนึ่งบานดึงดูดความสนใจ มันสะท้อนภาพคุณ แต่ท่าทางไม่เหมือนกัน...
talkContent_ph: Sa ikatlong isla, makikita ang napakaraming teknolohikal na istruktura. Isang salaming-pader ang kumukuha ng pansin—nagpapakita ito ng repleksyon ninyo, ngunit iba ang galaw...
talkContent_in: Pulau ketiga dipenuhi dengan nuansa teknologi, dengan banyak bangunan dan perangkat aneh. Ada dinding cermin yang menarik perhatian, mencerminkan bayangan kalian tetapi bergerak berbeda...
talkContent_vn: Hòn đảo thứ ba tràn ngập cảm giác công nghệ, đâu đâu cũng là những kiến trúc và thiết bị mới lạ, trong đó có một bức tường gương thu hút sự chú ý của các bạn, gương phản chiếu hình dáng của các bạn nhưng lại thực hiện những động tác khác với các bạn...

talkContent: (Holding your sleeve in fear) Ah! Look, the reflection is moving!
talkContent_ma: (Pegang lengan kerana takut) Ah! Lihat, pantulan itu bergerak!
talkContent_en: (Holding your sleeve in fear) Ah! Look, the reflection is moving!
talkContent_th: (กอดแขนเพราะกลัว) อ๊า! ทุกคนดูสิ เงาในกระจกขยับได้!
talkContent_ph: (Hawak ang damit sa kaba) Ay! Tumingin kayo, gumagalaw ang repleksyon!
talkContent_in: (Memegang lenganmu karena takut) Aah! Lihat, bayangan dalam cermin itu bergerak!
talkContent_vn: (Nắm chặt áo bạn vì sợ hãi) A! Mọi người nhìn kìa, người trong gương hình như đang cử động!

talkContent: Maybe it’s not a mirror, but a clear glass wall, and on the other side is a Ditto transforming.
talkContent_ma: Mungkin itu bukan cermin, tetapi dinding kaca lutsinar, dan di sebelah sana ialah Ditto yang sedang meniru.
talkContent_en: Maybe it’s not a mirror, but a clear glass wall, and on the other side is a Ditto transforming.
talkContent_th: บางทีมันอาจไม่ใช่กระจก แต่เป็นกระจกใส ฝั่งตรงข้ามมีกลุ่มดิตโตที่กำลังแปลงร่าง
talkContent_ph: Marahil hindi ito salamin kundi malinaw na salamin lang, at sa kabila ay may Ditto na nag-aanyong ibang nilalang.
talkContent_in: Mungkin itu bukan cermin, melainkan dinding kaca transparan, di baliknya ada Ditto yang sedang berubah bentuk.
talkContent_vn: Có lẽ đây không phải là gương, mà là một bức tường kính trong suốt, phía bên kia bức tường hẳn là một con Ditto đang biến hình.

talkContent: Ditto transforms back to its original form after being discovered, and you realize you're surrounded by Ditto in various hero forms—who is your real hero?
talkContent_ma: Apabila diketahui, Ditto kembali ke bentuk asal, dan kamu dapati dikelilingi oleh Ditto yang menyerupai hero—mana satu yang sebenar?
talkContent_en: Ditto transforms back to its original form after being discovered, and you realize you're surrounded by Ditto in various hero forms—who is your real hero?
talkContent_th: เมื่อถูกจับได้ ดิตโตกลับสู่ร่างเดิม แล้วคุณก็พบว่าถูกล้อมด้วยพวกมันที่แปลงร่างเป็นฮีโร่ต่าง ๆ ใครกันคือฮีโร่ตัวจริงของคุณ...
talkContent_ph: Nang mabisto, bumalik si Ditto sa orihinal na anyo, at nakita ninyo na napalibutan kayo ng mga Ditto na nakaanyong heroes—alin ang totoo?
talkContent_in: Ditto kembali ke bentuk aslinya setelah ketahuan, dan kalian menyadari telah dikepung oleh Ditto yang meniru bentuk berbagai hero—siapa yang asli?
talkContent_vn: Con Ditto bị phát hiện biến hình trở lại nguyên dạng, lúc này các bạn mới nhận ra mình đã bị bao vây bởi những Ditto biến thành hình dạng các anh hùng khác nhau, ai mới là anh hùng thật sự của các bạn đây...

talkContent: After passing Ditto's challenge, you receive a white tablet with a Caterpie design.
talkContent_ma: Selepas cabaran Ditto, kamu menerima batu putih bergambar Caterpie.
talkContent_en: After passing Ditto's challenge, you receive a white tablet with a Caterpie design.
talkContent_th: เมื่อผ่านบททดสอบของดิตโต คุณได้รับแผ่นหินสีขาวที่มีรูปแคทเทอร์พี
talkContent_ph: Matapos ang pagsubok ni Ditto, nakuha ninyo ang puting tablet na may larawan ni Caterpie.
talkContent_in: Setelah menyelesaikan tantangan Ditto, kalian mendapatkan tablet putih bergambar Caterpie.
talkContent_vn: Sau khi vượt qua thử thách của Ditto, các bạn nhận được một phiến đá trắng có vẽ hình Caterpie.

talkContent: After many trials, you reach the fourth island. As you approach, heat radiates from a volcanic mountain in the center, spewing dark red lava and black smoke. Charizard flies overhead, seemingly welcoming your arrival...
talkContent_ma: Setelah melalui pelbagai rintangan, kamu tiba di pulau keempat. Apabila hampir sampai, kamu rasa haba dari gunung berapi yang memuntahkan lava merah pekat dan asap hitam. Charizard terbang di atas, seolah-olah menyambut kedatangan kamu...
talkContent_en: After many trials, you reach the fourth island. As you approach, heat radiates from a volcanic mountain in the center, spewing dark red lava and black smoke. Charizard flies overhead, seemingly welcoming your arrival...
talkContent_th: หลังผ่านอุปสรรคมากมาย คุณมาถึงเกาะที่สี่ พอเข้าใกล้ก็สัมผัสได้ถึงความร้อนจากภูเขาไฟที่พ่นลาวาแดงฉาน พร้อมควันดำหนาทึบ ชาร์ซาร์ดโบยบินอยู่เบื้องบน ดูเหมือนกำลังต้อนรับคุณ...
talkContent_ph: Sa wakas, nakarating na kayo sa ikaapat na isla. Ang init mula sa bulkan ay dama mula sa malayo, at sa itaas ay lumilipad si Charizard na tila sumasalubong sa inyo...
talkContent_in: Setelah melalui banyak tantangan, kalian tiba di pulau keempat. Saat mendekat, hawa panas dari gunung berapi di tengah pulau terasa membara, memuntahkan lava merah gelap dan asap hitam. Charizard terbang di udara, seolah menyambut kalian...
talkContent_vn: Sau bao gian truân, các bạn tiến đến hòn đảo thứ tư. Khi vừa đến gần đảo, hơi nóng đã phả vào người. Từ xa nhìn lại, ngọn núi lửa ở trung tâm đảo phun trào dung nham đỏ sẫm, cuộn theo khói đen nghi ngút. Charizard lượn lờ trên không trung, dường như đang chào đón sự xuất hiện của các bạn...

talkContent: After overcoming Charizard’s challenge, you receive a red tablet with an Oddish symbol.
talkContent_ma: Selepas mengalahkan Charizard, kamu menerima batu merah bergambar Oddish.
talkContent_en: After overcoming Charizard’s challenge, you receive a red tablet with an Oddish symbol.
talkContent_th: หลังเอาชนะชาร์ซาร์ดได้ คุณได้รับแผ่นหินสีแดงมีรูปอ็อดดิช
talkContent_ph: Matapos ang pagsubok ni Charizard, nakuha ninyo ang pulang tablet na may Oddish na imahe.
talkContent_in: Setelah menyelesaikan tantangan Charizard, kalian mendapatkan tablet merah bergambar Oddish.
talkContent_vn: Sau khi vượt qua thử thách Charizard, các bạn nhận được một phiến đá đỏ có hình Oddish.

talkContent: Leaving the scorching Flame Island, you head to the next clue location. According to the explorer’s notebook, this Phantom Island is a psychic illusion created by Alakazam. Only one is the true guardian, while the rest are Alakazam’s illusions. To pass the challenge, you must identify the real one quickly.
talkContent_ma: Tinggalkan Pulau Api, kamu tiba di Pulau Ilusi. Menurut buku nota, pulau ini ialah ilusi mental yang dicipta oleh Alakazam. Hanya seorang penjaga sebenar, yang lain adalah bayangan. Kamu mesti cepat mencari yang sebenar.
talkContent_en: Leaving the scorching Flame Island, you head to the next clue location. According to the explorer’s notebook, this Phantom Island is a psychic illusion created by Alakazam. Only one is the true guardian, while the rest are Alakazam’s illusions. To pass the challenge, you must identify the real one quickly.
talkContent_th: จากเกาะไฟ คุณเดินทางไปยังเกาะมายา ตามคำอธิบายในสมุดบันทึก เกาะนี้เป็นภาพลวงตาที่สร้างโดยอลาแคแซม มีเพียงตัวจริงหนึ่งเดียว ส่วนที่เหลือเป็นร่างแยก ต้องหาตัวจริงให้ได้
talkContent_ph: Pagkatapos umalis mula sa mainit na Flame Island, narating ninyo ang Phantom Island. Ayon sa tala, ito ay ilusyon ng isip na nilikha ni Alakazam. Isa lang ang tunay, ang iba ay ilusyon. Kailangan ninyong tukuyin agad ang totoo.
talkContent_in: Meninggalkan Pulau Api yang panas, kalian tiba di lokasi petunjuk berikutnya. Menurut buku catatan, Pulau Ilusi ini adalah ilusi psikis yang diciptakan oleh Alakazam. Hanya satu yang asli, sisanya adalah bayangan. Kalian harus cepat menemukan yang asli.
talkContent_vn: Rời khỏi Hỏa Diệm Đảo nóng bỏng, các bạn đã đến địa điểm manh mối tiếp theo. Theo mô tả trong sổ tay thám hiểm, Huyễn Cảnh Đảo này thực chất là ảo ảnh tinh thần do Alakazam tạo ra. Trên đảo thực tế chỉ có một người là người bảo vệ thật sự, những người còn lại đều là phân thân ảo ảnh của Alakazam. Muốn vượt qua thử thách, phải nhanh chóng tìm ra chân thân của nó.

talkContent: After passing Alakazam’s trial, you receive a purple tablet with a Machamp image.
talkContent_ma: Selepas melepasi cabaran Alakazam, kamu mendapat batu ungu bergambar Machamp.
talkContent_en: After passing Alakazam’s trial, you receive a purple tablet with a Machamp image.
talkContent_th: หลังผ่านบททดสอบของอลาแคแซม คุณได้รับแผ่นหินสีม่วงมีรูปมาชัมพ์
talkContent_ph: Pagkatapos ng pagsubok, nakuha ninyo ang lilang tablet na may larawan ni Machamp.
talkContent_in: Setelah melewati tantangan Alakazam, kalian mendapat tablet ungu bergambar Machamp.
talkContent_vn: Sau khi vượt qua thử thách của Alakazam, các bạn đã nhận được một tấm phiến đá màu tím có vẽ hình Machamp.

talkContent: Having solved the illusion puzzle, you rush to continue exploring. Ahead is a giant Ferris wheel. The clue is hidden in one of the cabins, and the only one who knows the exact location is the mischievous Hoopa, who often lies. Be careful not to be tricked...
talkContent_ma: Selepas menyelesaikan teka-teki, kamu bergerak pantas. Di depan ialah roda ferris gergasi. Petunjuk disembunyikan dalam salah satu kabin, tetapi hanya Hoopa nakal yang tahu—dan dia suka menipu! Hati-hati jangan tertipu...
talkContent_en: Having solved the illusion puzzle, you rush to continue exploring. Ahead is a giant Ferris wheel. The clue is hidden in one of the cabins, and the only one who knows the exact location is the mischievous Hoopa, who often lies. Be careful not to be tricked...
talkContent_th: หลังแก้ปริศนาได้ คุณเข้าสู่ด่านต่อไป ข้างหน้าคือชิงช้าสวรรค์ยักษ์ ตามสมุดเบาะแสถูกซ่อนไว้ในกระเช้าหนึ่งใบ และมีเพียงฮูป้าจอมเจ้าเล่ห์ที่รู้ตำแหน่ง ต้องแยกแยะคำพูดให้ดี อย่าถูกหลอก!
talkContent_ph: Pagkatapos lutasin ang ilusyon, dumating kayo sa Ferris wheel. Nakatago ang palatandaan sa isa sa mga cabin, ngunit tanging si Hoopa ang may alam—at mahilig siyang magsinungaling! Huwag magpalinlang...
talkContent_in: Setelah memecahkan teka-teki ilusi, kalian bergegas ke petunjuk selanjutnya. Di depan adalah roda ferris raksasa. Petunjuk tersembunyi di salah satu kabin, dan satu-satunya yang tahu lokasinya adalah Hoopa yang suka berbohong. Hati-hati jangan tertipu...
talkContent_vn: Cuối cùng cũng giải được câu đố về phân thân của Alakazam, thấy thời gian thám hiểm đã quá nửa, các bạn tăng tốc. Trước mắt các bạn là một vòng đu quay khổng lồ, sổ tay thám hiểm cho biết manh mối được giấu trong một cabin của vòng đu quay, nhưng người duy nhất biết vị trí cụ thể của manh mối lại là Hoopa tinh nghịch hay nói dối, phải cẩn thận phân biệt lời hắn nói, đừng để bị hắn lừa...

talkContent: After passing the challenge, you receive a yellow tablet with a Horned Goldfish image.
talkContent_ma: Selepas cabaran, kamu menerima batu kuning bergambar ikan emas bertanduk.
talkContent_en: After passing the challenge, you receive a yellow tablet with a Horned Goldfish image.
talkContent_th: เมื่อผ่านการทดสอบ คุณได้รับแผ่นหินสีเหลืองมีรูปปลาทองเขา
talkContent_ph: Matapos malampasan ang pagsubok, nakuha ninyo ang dilaw na tablet na may larawan ng goldfish na may sungay.
talkContent_in: Setelah menyelesaikan tantangan, kalian mendapatkan tablet kuning bergambar ikan mas bertanduk.
talkContent_vn: Vượt qua thử thách, các bạn đã nhận được một phiến đá màu vàng có vẽ hình cá vàng sừng.

topTalk: One of my neighbors did not lie.
topTalk_ma: Salah seorang jiran saya tidak berbohong.
topTalk_en: One of my neighbors did not lie.
topTalk_th: หนึ่งในเพื่อนบ้านของฉันไม่ได้โกหก
topTalk_ph: Isa sa mga kapitbahay ko ay hindi nagsisinungaling.
topTalk_in: Salah satu tetangga saya tidak berbohong.
topTalk_vn: Một trong những người hàng xóm của tôi đã không nói dối.

topTalk: Among us, two people did not lie.
topTalk_ma: Di antara kita, ada dua orang yang tidak berbohong.
topTalk_en: Among us, two people did not lie.
topTalk_th: ในพวกเรามีสองคนที่ไม่ได้โกหก
topTalk_ph: Dalawa sa amin ang hindi nagsisinungaling.
topTalk_in: Di antara kita, ada dua orang yang tidak berbohong.
topTalk_vn: Trong chúng ta có hai người không nói dối.

topTalk: Everyone in this row of mine is lying.
topTalk_ma: Semua orang dalam barisan saya ini sedang berbohong.
topTalk_en: Everyone in this row of mine is lying.
topTalk_th: ทุกคนในแถวนี้ของฉันกำลังโกหก
topTalk_ph: Lahat ng tao sa hilera kong ito ay nagsisinungaling.
topTalk_in: Semua orang di barisan saya ini sedang berbohong.
topTalk_vn: Tất cả mọi người trên hàng này của tôi đều đang nói dối.

topTalk: Everyone in my row is lying.
topTalk_ma: Semua orang dalam barisan saya berbohong.
topTalk_en: Everyone in my row is lying.
topTalk_th: ทุกคนในแถวของฉันกำลังโกหก
topTalk_ph: Lahat ng tao sa hilera ko ay nagsisinungaling.
topTalk_in: Semua orang di barisan saya sedang berbohong.
topTalk_vn: Tất cả mọi người ở hàng của tôi đều đang nói dối.

topTalk: My neighbors are all lying.
topTalk_ma: Semua jiran saya berbohong.
topTalk_en: My neighbors are all lying.
topTalk_th: เพื่อนบ้านของฉันทั้งหมดโกหก
topTalk_ph: Lahat ng mga kapitbahay ko ay nagsisinungaling.
topTalk_in: Semua tetangga saya sedang berbohong.
topTalk_vn: Những người hàng xóm của tôi đều nói dối.

topTalk: One of us is not lying.
topTalk_ma: Salah seorang daripada kita tidak berbohong.
topTalk_en: One of us is not lying.
topTalk_th: หนึ่งในพวกเราไม่ได้โกหก
topTalk_ph: Isa sa amin ang hindi nagsisinungaling.
topTalk_in: Salah satu dari kita tidak berbohong.
topTalk_vn: Một trong số chúng ta không nói dối.

talkContent: The guidance in the exploration handbook ends at the ferris wheel. After overcoming the challenge at the ferris wheel, you don’t know where to go next.
talkContent_ma: Panduan dalam buku panduan pengembaraan berakhir di roda Ferris, selepas melepasi cabaran di roda Ferris, kalian tidak tahu ke mana untuk pergi seterusnya.
talkContent_en: The guidance in the exploration handbook ends at the ferris wheel. After overcoming the challenge at the ferris wheel, you don’t know where to go next.
talkContent_th: คำแนะนำในสมุดบันทึกการผจญภัยสิ้นสุดที่ชิงช้าสวรรค์ หลังจากผ่านความท้าทายที่ชิงช้าสวรรค์แล้ว พวกคุณไม่รู้ว่าจะไปที่ไหนต่อ
talkContent_ph: Nagtapos ang gabay sa exploration handbook sa bahagi ng ferris wheel. Pagkatapos ninyong malampasan ang hamon ở ferris wheel, hindi ninyo alam kung saan pupunta sunod.
talkContent_in: Panduan dalam buku petualangan berakhir di wahana bianglala, setelah berhasil melewati tantangan di sana, kalian tidak tahu harus ke mana selanjutnya.
talkContent_vn: Hướng dẫn trong sổ tay thám hiểm kết thúc ở vòng đu quay, sau khi vượt qua thử thách ở vòng đu quay, các bạn không biết nên đi đâu tiếp theo.

talkContent: You piece together the six stone tablets you collected and discover that the back reveals a map. This map is more detailed than the one in the handbook and shows the location of a key to a temple beneath the lake.
talkContent_ma: Kalian menyatukan enam batu yang telah dikumpulkan dan mendapati di belakangnya terdapat sebuah peta. Peta ini lebih terperinci daripada peta dalam buku panduan pengembaraan dan menunjukkan lokasi kunci kuil bawah tasik.
talkContent_en: You piece together the six stone tablets you collected and discover that the back reveals a map. This map is more detailed than the one in the handbook and shows the location of a key to a temple beneath the lake.
talkContent_th: พวกคุณประกอบหินทั้งหกก้อนที่เก็บมาได้เข้าด้วยกัน และพบว่า ด้านหลังมีภาพแผนที่ แผนที่นี้มีรายละเอียดมากกว่าในสมุดบันทึก และแสดงตำแหน่งกุญแจของวิหารใต้น้ำ
talkContent_ph: Pinagdikit ninyo ang anim na tipak ng bato na nakuha at natuklasan sa likod nito ang isang mapa. Mas detalyado ang mapang ito kaysa nasa exploration handbook at ipinapakita nito ang lokasyon ng susi ng templo sa ilalim ng lawa.
talkContent_in: Kalian menggabungkan enam batu yang telah dikumpulkan, dan menemukan bahwa di bagian belakangnya terdapat gambar sebuah peta. Peta ini lebih rinci dibandingkan peta di buku petualangan dan menunjukkan lokasi kunci kuil di bawah danau.
talkContent_vn: Các bạn ghép sáu phiến đá đã thu thập được lại với nhau và phát hiện ra mặt sau có vẽ một bản đồ. Bản đồ này chi tiết hơn bản đồ trong sổ tay thám hiểm và chỉ ra vị trí chìa khóa của ngôi đền dưới hồ.

talkContent: You put away the stone tablets and head to the location marked on the map. On the way, you pass through a water park and spot some delinquent teens kicking something on the shore.
talkContent_ma: Kalian menyimpan batu-batu tersebut, menuju ke lokasi kunci yang ditunjukkan di peta, dan dalam perjalanan melalui sebuah taman air, kalian mendapati beberapa remaja nakal sedang menendang sesuatu di pantai.
talkContent_en: You put away the stone tablets and head to the location marked on the map. On the way, you pass through a water park and spot some delinquent teens kicking something on the shore.
talkContent_th: พวกคุณเก็บหินไว้แล้วเดินทางไปยังตำแหน่งของกุญแจตามแผนที่ ระหว่างทางที่ผ่านสวนน้ำ พวกคุณพบกลุ่มเด็กเกเรกำลังเตะบางอย่างอยู่ริมฝั่ง
talkContent_ph: Itinago ninyo ang mga tipak ng bato at tumungo sa lokasyon ng susi na itinuro sa mapa. Sa daan, nadaanan ninyo ang isang water park at napansin ang ilang pasaway na kabataan na tila tinatapakan o tinatadyakan ang isang bagay sa dalampasigan.
talkContent_in: Kalian menyimpan batu-batu itu dan menuju ke lokasi kunci yang ditunjukkan di peta. Dalam perjalanan melewati taman air, kalian melihat beberapa remaja nakal sedang menendang sesuatu di tepi pantai.
talkContent_vn: Các bạn cất phiến đá đi, đến địa điểm chìa khóa được chỉ trên bản đồ, trên đường đi qua một công viên nước, các bạn phát hiện vài thiếu niên hư đang đá thứ gì đó trên bờ.

talkContent: How could there be such an ugly Pokémon? Keep running if you dare!
talkContent_ma: Kenapa ada Pokémon hodoh seperti ini, kau lari saja.
talkContent_en: How could there be such an ugly Pokémon? Keep running if you dare!
talkContent_th: ทำไมโปเกมอนถึงได้ดูน่าเกลียดแบบนี้นะ หนีไปอีกสิ
talkContent_ph: Anong klaseng pangit na Pokémon ‘to? Takbo ka pa, sige!
talkContent_in: Pokémon jelek macam apa ini sih, coba lari lagi xem!
talkContent_vn: Sao lại có Pokémon xấu xí đến vậy chứ, ngươi chạy nữa đi.

talkContent: Bloop bloop… (awkwardly bouncing on the ground)
talkContent_ma: Ugh ugh... (terlompat-lompat di atas tanah)
talkContent_en: Bloop bloop… (awkwardly bouncing on the ground)
talkContent_th: อุ อุ… (กระเด้งกระดอนบนพื้นดินอย่างเงอะงะ)
talkContent_ph: Uuuu... (pasuray-suray na tumatalbog sa lupa)
talkContent_in: Bloop bloop... (terhuyung-huyung terpantul ke tanah)
talkContent_vn: Ụ Ụ… (lóng ngóng nảy lên trên mặt đất)

talkContent: Stop it right now!
talkContent_ma: Berhenti segera!
talkContent_en: Stop it right now!
talkContent_th: หยุดเดี๋ยวนี้!
talkContent_ph: Tumigil na kayo!
talkContent_in: Berhenti sekarang juga!
talkContent_vn: Dừng lại ngay!

talkContent: What are you doing!
talkContent_ma: Kalian sebenarnya sedang buat apa ni!
talkContent_en: What are you doing!
talkContent_th: พวกเธอกำลังทำอะไรกันแน่!
talkContent_ph: Ano bang ginagawa n’yo sa kanya?!
talkContent_in: Apa yang kalian lakukan?!
talkContent_vn: Các bạn rốt cuộc đang làm cái gì vậy!

talkContent: Yeah, why are you bullying it!
talkContent_ma: Betul, kenapa nak buli dia!
talkContent_en: Yeah, why are you bullying it!
talkContent_th: ใช่ ทำไมถึงต้องรังแกมันด้วย!
talkContent_ph: Tama ‘yan, bakit n’yo siya inaapi?!
talkContent_in: Benar! Kenapa kalian membully dia?!
talkContent_vn: Đúng vậy, tại sao lại bắt nạt nó!

talkContent: Who are you guys, such nosy people! Looks like we need to teach you a lesson!
talkContent_ma: Kalian siapa, banyak cakap, nampaknya kena ajar kalian satu pengajaran!
talkContent_en: Who are you guys, such nosy people! Looks like we need to teach you a lesson!
talkContent_th: พวกแกเป็นใครกัน แส่เรื่องชาวบ้านนักนะ เห็นทีต้องสั่งสอนให้รู้สำนึก
talkContent_ph: Sino ba kayo, mga usisero! Mukhang kailangan kayong turuan ng leksyon!
talkContent_in: Siapa kalian ini, sok ikut campur, sepertinya harus diajar pelajaran dulu!
talkContent_vn: Các người là ai vậy, lũ nhiều chuyện, xem ra phải dạy cho các người một bài học mới được.

talkContent: You healed Feebas's wounds, but your indifference made the delinquent teens furious. (The enemies receive a damage buff)
talkContent_ma: Kalian telah menyembuhkan luka Feebas, tetapi ketidakpedulian kalian telah membuat para remaja nakal marah. (Pihak lawan menerima buff kerusakan)
talkContent_en: You healed Feebas's wounds, but your indifference made the delinquent teens furious. (The enemies receive a damage buff)
talkContent_th: พวกคุณรักษาบาดแผลให้กับ Feebas แล้ว แต่ความเพิกเฉยของพวกคุณทำให้กลุ่มเด็กเกเรโกรธ (ฝ่ายตรงข้ามได้รับบัฟเพิ่มพลังโจมตี)
talkContent_ph: Pinagaling ninyo ang mga sugat ni Feebas, ngunit ang kawalang-pakialam ninyo kanina ay lalong nagpagalit sa mga pasaway na kabataan. (Nakakuha sila ng damage buff)
talkContent_in: Kalian telah menyembuhkan luka Feebas, namun sikap acuh kalian membuat para remaja nakal marah. (Lawan menerima buff serangan)
talkContent_vn: Các bạn đã chữa lành vết thương cho Feebas, nhưng sự thờ ơ của các bạn đã khiến đám thiếu niên hư hỏng tức giận. (Đối phương nhận được buff sát thương)

talkContent: You decide to drive away the thugs first, and then take care of the injured, ugly Feebas. (Feebas will start the battle in critical condition)
talkContent_ma: Kalian memutuskan untuk mengusir para preman terlebih dahulu, baru setelah itu merawat Feebas yang jelek dan terluka (Feebas akan memulai pertarungan dalam kondisi terluka parah).
talkContent_en: You decide to drive away the thugs first, and then take care of the injured, ugly Feebas. (Feebas will start the battle in critical condition)
talkContent_th: พวกคุณตัดสินใจไล่พวกเด็กเกเรไปก่อน แล้วค่อยดูแล Feebas ที่บาดเจ็บ (Feebas จะเริ่มการต่อสู้ในสภาพบาดเจ็บสาหัส)
talkContent_ph: Nagdesisyon kayong paalisin muna ang mga pasaway bago asikasuhin ang sugatang si Feebas. (Si Feebas ay magsisimula ng laban na may malubhang pinsala)
talkContent_in: Kalian memutuskan untuk mengusir para berandalan itu dulu, lalu baru merawat Feebas yang jelek dan terluka. (Feebas akan memulai pertarungan dalam kondisi terluka parah)
talkContent_vn: Các bạn quyết định đuổi đám du côn trước, rồi sau đó mới chăm sóc con Feebas xấu xí bị thương (Feebas sẽ bắt đầu trận đấu trong tình trạng trọng thương).

talkContent: After successfully chasing away the delinquent teens and treating Feebas’s wounds, it becomes very grateful to you. So you decide to capture it in a Hero Ball first and plan to treat it further after the expedition ends.  The short story of rescuing Feebas temporarily concludes. You pack your gear and continue toward the treasure marked on the stone tablet...
talkContent_ma: Setelah berhasil mengusir para pemuda nakal dan merawat luka-luka Feebas, ia sangat berterima kasih kepada kalian. Oleh karena itu, kalian memutuskan untuk menangkapnya dengan Hero Ball terlebih dahulu, dan setelah perjalanan petualangan selesai, kalian akan melakukan perawatan lebih lanjut. Cerita kecil penyelamatan Feebas pun berakhir sementara, kalian merapikan perlengkapan dan melanjutkan perjalanan menuju harta karun yang ditandai pada batu prasasti...
talkContent_en: After successfully chasing away the delinquent teens and treating Feebas’s wounds, it becomes very grateful to you. So you decide to capture it in a Hero Ball first and plan to treat it further after the expedition ends.  The short story of rescuing Feebas temporarily concludes. You pack your gear and continue toward the treasure marked on the stone tablet...
talkContent_th: หลังจากไล่กลุ่มเด็กเกเรออกไปและรักษาอาการบาดเจ็บของ Feebas ได้สำเร็จ มันรู้สึกขอบคุณพวกคุณอย่างมาก ดังนั้นคุณจึงตัดสินใจจับมันด้วย Hero Ball และรอให้จบการผจญภัยก่อนแล้วค่อยรักษาต่อ เรื่องราวเล็ก ๆ ของการช่วย Feebas สิ้นสุดลง พวกคุณเก็บสัมภาระและมุ่งหน้าไปยังสมบัติที่ถูกระบุไว้บนหิน
talkContent_ph: Matapos matagumpay na paalisin ang mga pasaway at pagalingin ang mga sugat ni Feebas, labis siyang nagpasalamat sa inyo. Kaya't nagdesisyon kayong gamitin ang Hero Ball para pansamantalang isama siya, at gamutin pa siya pagkatapos ng adventure. Pansamantalang nagtatapos ang kwento ng pagsagip kay Feebas, inayos ninyo ang mga gamit at nagpatuloy sa lokasyon ng kayamanang nakamarka sa mga tipak ng bato...
talkContent_in: Setelah berhasil mengusir para remaja nakal dan menstabilkan luka Feebas, dia sangat berterima kasih kepada kalian. Maka, kalian memutuskan menangkapnya ke dalam Hero Ball, menunggu setelah petualangan selesai baru akan diobati lebih lanjut. Kisah penyelamatan Feebas sementara berakhir, kalian bersiap kembali dan melanjutkan menuju harta karun yang ditandai di batu...
talkContent_vn: Sau khi thành công đuổi đám thiếu niên bất lương và ổn định vết thương cho Feebas, nó vô cùng biết ơn các bạn. Vì vậy, bạn quyết định thu phục nó vào Hero Ball trước, đợi kết thúc chuyến thám hiểm sẽ tiến hành điều trị thêm. Câu chuyện nhỏ giải cứu Feebas tạm khép lại, các bạn chỉnh đốn hành trang và tiếp tục tiến về kho báu được đánh dấu trên phiến đá...

talkContent: You finally reach the location marked on the tablet, but the entire area is surrounded by desert, with no signs of any structures.  Strangely, in the center of the desert stand six towering pillars, each in a different color.  These colors feel oddly familiar to you, as if you’ve seen them somewhere before...
talkContent_ma: Akhirnya, kalian tiba di lokasi yang ditandai pada batu prasasti, namun di sekitar tempat ini hanya ada padang pasir, sama sekali tidak ada struktur apapun. Hal yang aneh adalah, di tengah padang pasir terdapat enam tiang dengan warna yang berbeda. Warna-warna ini membuat kalian merasa familiar dengan cara yang aneh, seolah-olah kalian pernah melihatnya di suatu tempat...
talkContent_en: You finally reach the location marked on the tablet, but the entire area is surrounded by desert, with no signs of any structures.  Strangely, in the center of the desert stand six towering pillars, each in a different color.  These colors feel oddly familiar to you, as if you’ve seen them somewhere before...
talkContent_th: ในที่สุดพวกคุณก็มาถึงจุดที่ถูกทำเครื่องหมายบนหิน แต่บริเวณโดยรอบเป็นทะเลทราย ไม่มีสิ่งก่อสร้างใด ๆ ให้เห็น สิ่งที่แปลกคือมีเสาหินหกต้นตั้งตระหง่านอยู่กลางทะเลทราย โดยแต่ละต้นมีสีแตกต่างกัน สีเหล่านี้ทำให้พวกคุณรู้สึกคุ้นเคยราวกับเคยเห็นที่ไหนมาก่อน...
talkContent_ph: Sa wakas, narating ninyo ang lokasyong itinuro sa mga bato, ngunit puro disyerto lang ang paligid, at walang anumang palatandaan ng mga gusali. Sa gitna ng disyerto, may anim na haliging magkakaibang kulay. Ang mga kulay na ito ay parang pamilyar — parang nakita na ninyo dati...
talkContent_in: Akhirnya kalian sampai di lokasi yang ditunjukkan oleh batu, namun tempat ini dikelilingi oleh gurun, sama sekali tidak terlihat seperti ada bangunan. Anehnya, di tengah gurun berdiri enam pilar dengan warna berbeda. Warna-warna ini terasa sangat familiar, seolah-olah kalian pernah melihatnya di suatu tempat...
talkContent_vn: Các bạn cuối cùng cũng đến được địa điểm được đánh dấu trên phiến đá, nhưng nơi này xung quanh toàn là hoang mạc, hoàn toàn không giống như có kiến trúc. Điều kỳ lạ là ở trung tâm hoang mạc lại sừng sững sáu cây cột với màu sắc khác nhau. Những màu sắc này khiến các bạn cảm thấy quen thuộc một cách khó hiểu, cứ như đã từng thấy ở đâu đó...

talkContent: After successfully deciphering the mystery of the stone puzzle, the ground begins to rumble loudly, and something slowly rises from the dust. Soon, a small stone shrine appears before you, with an intricately crafted statue of Milotic placed inside. Something on the statue seems to be shimmering with colors under the sunlight...
talkContent_ma: Setelah berhasil memecahkan misteri batu tersebut, tanah mulai bergetar keras, dan sesuatu mulai muncul dari debu pasir. Tak lama kemudian, sebuah kuil batu kecil muncul di depan kalian, di dalamnya terletak sebuah patung Milotic yang sangat indah, di patung itu tampaknya ada sesuatu yang berkilau dengan warna-warna cerah di bawah sinar matahari...
talkContent_en: After successfully deciphering the mystery of the stone puzzle, the ground begins to rumble loudly, and something slowly rises from the dust. Soon, a small stone shrine appears before you, with an intricately crafted statue of Milotic placed inside. Something on the statue seems to be shimmering with colors under the sunlight...
talkContent_th: หลังจากถอดรหัสความลับของเสาหินได้สำเร็จ พื้นดินก็เริ่มสั่นสะเทือนและมีบางอย่างค่อย ๆ โผล่ขึ้นมาจากผืนทราย ไม่นานนักแท่นบูชาหินขนาดเล็กก็ปรากฏขึ้นต่อหน้าพวกคุณ ข้างในมีรูปปั้น Milotic ที่สลักไว้อย่างประณีต และดูเหมือนว่ามีบางอย่างบนรูปปั้นเปล่งประกายภายใต้แสงแดด...
talkContent_ph: Matapos ninyong malutas ang misteryo ng mga bato, biglang lumindol ang lupa, at unti-unting lumitaw mula sa buhangin ang isang maliit na dambanang bato. Sa loob nito ay may napaka-gandang rebulto ni Milotic, na tila may kumikislap na bagay sa ibabaw nito sa ilalim ng araw...
talkContent_in: Setelah berhasil memecahkan misteri batu, tanah mulai bergetar hebat, sesuatu perlahan muncul dari pasir. Tidak lama kemudian, muncul sebuah altar batu kecil, di dalamnya terdapat patung Milotic yang indah, dan tampaknya ada sesuatu yang berkilauan di atas patung itu di bawah cahaya matahari...
talkContent_vn: Sau khi giải mã thành công bí ẩn của trận đá, mặt đất bắt đầu rung chuyển ầm ầm, một thứ gì đó dần trồi lên từ cát bụi. Chẳng mấy chốc, một khám thờ bằng đá thấp bé xuất hiện trước mặt các bạn, bên trong đặt một bức tượng Milotic tinh xảo, trên tượng dường như có thứ gì đó đang lấp lánh sắc màu dưới ánh mặt trời...

talkContent: Just as you are about to take the statue, a shadow falls over you, as if something has blocked out the sunlight. Looking up, you see a giant spaceship. While you're still looking up, a robotic arm swiftly grabs the Milotic statue from the stone cavity and quickly pulls it into the ship.
talkContent_ma: Saat kalian bersiap untuk mengambil patung tersebut, sebuah bayangan gelap menyelimuti kalian, seolah-olah sinar matahari tertutup oleh sesuatu. Ketika kalian menengadah ke langit, kalian melihat sebuah pesawat luar angkasa raksasa. Sementara kalian menatap langit, sebuah lengan mekanik dengan cepat mengambil patung Milotic dari celah batu dan dengan cepat membawanya ke dalam pesawat luar angkasa.
talkContent_en: Just as you are about to take the statue, a shadow falls over you, as if something has blocked out the sunlight. Looking up, you see a giant spaceship. While you're still looking up, a robotic arm swiftly grabs the Milotic statue from the stone cavity and quickly pulls it into the ship.
talkContent_th: ทันทีที่พวกคุณกำลังจะหยิบรูปปั้นนั้น เงาดำก็ปกคลุมพวกคุณ ราวกับแสงอาทิตย์ถูกบดบัง เมื่อเงยหน้าขึ้น พวกคุณก็เห็นยานลำใหญ่ลอยอยู่เหนือหัว ขณะพวกคุณกำลังมองขึ้นไปบนฟ้า แขนกลก็ได้คว้ารูปปั้น Milotic จากโพรงหินและเก็บเข้าไปในยานอย่างรวดเร็ว
talkContent_ph: Nang handa na kayong kunin ang rebulto, biglang bumalot ang anino sa paligid. Tila natakpan ng kung anong bagay ang araw. Pagtingala ninyo, nakita ninyong may isang higanteng spaceship sa taas. Habang nakatitig pa kayo sa langit, isang mechanical arm ang mabilis na humablot sa rebultong Milotic at agad itong iniakyat sa barko.
talkContent_in: Saat kalian bersiap mengambil patung itu, bayangan gelap menutupi kalian, seolah cahaya matahari tertutup oleh sesuatu. Saat kalian menengadah, tampak sebuah kapal luar angkasa raksasa. Ketika kalian masih menatap langit, sebuah tangan mesin dengan cepat mengambil patung Milotic dari lubang batu dan membawanya ke kapal.
talkContent_vn: Ngay khi các bạn chuẩn bị lấy bức tượng, một bóng đen bao trùm lấy các bạn, như thể ánh nắng bị thứ gì đó che khuất. Ngước mắt lên, các bạn thấy một chiếc phi thuyền khổng lồ. Trong lúc các bạn ngước nhìn lên trời, một cánh tay máy đã nhanh tay lấy bức tượng Milotic từ hốc đá và nhanh chóng thu vào phi thuyền.

talkContent_en: Got it, meow!

talkContent_in: Tim Rocket!

talkContent_en: I have asked with sincerity for you!

talkContent_en: Therefore, I will speak with great compassion and tell you this!

talkContent_ma: Untuk mencegah dunia ini hancur!
talkContent_en: To prevent the world from being destroyed!

talkContent_in: Untuk mencegah kehancuran dunia!

talkContent_en: For world peace!

talkContent_ph: Para sa kapayapaan sa buong daigdig!

talkContent_ph: Isasagawa namin ang kasamaan gamit ang pag-ibig at katotohanan!
talkContent_in: Melaksanakan kejahatan dengan cinta dan kebenaran!

talkContent_en: A villain who is both cute and charming!

talkContent_in: Penjahat yang imut dan menawan!

talkContent_en: White hole, a bright future awaits us!

talkContent_ph: White hole, ang maliwanag na kinabukasan ay naghihintay!
talkContent_in: Lubang putih, masa depan yang cerah menanti kami!

talkContent_ma: Begitulah, meow!
talkContent_en: That's all, meow!

talkContent_ph: Ganoon lang ‘yon, meow!
talkContent_in: Begitu saja, meong!

talkContent: Sure enough, just following you guys makes it so easy to find the final treasure without any effort at all!
talkContent_ma: Ternyata, mengikuti kalian bisa dengan mudah menemukan harta karun terakhir tanpa usaha sedikit pun!
talkContent_en: Sure enough, just following you guys makes it so easy to find the final treasure without any effort at all!
talkContent_th: ว่าแล้วเชียว แค่ตามพวกเธอมาก็เจอสมบัติสุดท้ายได้โดยไม่ต้องออกแรงเลย!
talkContent_ph: Tama nga talaga, kapag sumunod lang ako sa inyo, madali ko nang makuha ang huling kayamanan nang hindi man lang pinapawisan!
talkContent_in: Ternyata cukup ikuti kalian, harta terakhir bisa ditemukan dengan mudah tanpa usaha!
talkContent_vn: Quả nhiên cứ đi theo các cậu là có thể dễ dàng tìm thấy kho báu cuối cùng mà không tốn chút sức lực nào!

talkContent: We’ll take all of Milotic and the treasure, ha ha ha ha ha!
talkContent_ma: Kami akan mengambil Milotic dan harta karun ini, hahaha!
talkContent_en: We’ll take all of Milotic and the treasure, ha ha ha ha ha!
talkContent_th: พวกเราขอรับไปทั้ง Milotic และสมบัตินะ ฮ่า ๆ ๆ ๆ!
talkContent_ph: Akin na si Milotic at ang kayamanan, ha ha ha ha ha!
talkContent_in: Kami akan mengambil semua Milotic dan harta karun ini, hahaha!
talkContent_vn: Chúng ta xin nhận hết Milotic và kho báu nhé, ha ha ha ha ha!

talkContent: Go ahead, Pikachu! Get our Milotic statue back!
talkContent_ma: Ayo, Pikachu! Ambil kembali patung Milotic yang seharusnya menjadi milik kita!
talkContent_en: Go ahead, Pikachu! Get our Milotic statue back!
talkContent_th: ไปเลย พิคาชู! เอารูปปั้น Milotic กลับมาที่เป็นของพวกเรา!
talkContent_ph: Sumugod ka, Pikachu! Bawiin natin ang rebultong Milotic na para sa atin!
talkContent_in: Majulah, Pikachu! Ambil kembali patung Milotic yang menjadi milik kita!
talkContent_vn: Tiến lên đi, Pikachu! Lấy lại tượng Milotic thuộc về chúng ta!

talkContent: After a while of fighting, the Milotic statue suddenly flies out of the spaceship, and you reach out to grab it, but accidentally fall off the spaceship...
talkContent_ma: Setelah beberapa saat bertarung, patung Milotic tiba-tiba terbang keluar dari pesawat luar angkasa, kalian mengulurkan tangan untuk menangkap patung tersebut, tetapi tanpa sengaja jatuh dari pesawat luar angkasa...
talkContent_en: After a while of fighting, the Milotic statue suddenly flies out of the spaceship, and you reach out to grab it, but accidentally fall off the spaceship...
talkContent_th: หลังจากการต่อสู้อย่างดุเดือด รูปปั้น Milotic ลอยออกมาจากยาน พวกคุณเอื้อมมือไปคว้ามัน แต่ดันเผลอตกลงมาจากยานด้วย...
talkContent_ph: Matapos ang matinding laban, biglang lumipad palabas ng spaceship ang rebulto ni Milotic. Inabot mo ito pero hindi inaasahang nahulog ka rin mula sa barko...
talkContent_in: Setelah pertarungan sengit, patung Milotic tiba-tiba terbang keluar dari kapal luar angkasa, kamu伸 tangan mencoba meraihnya, namun tanpa sengaja juga jatuh dari kapal...
talkContent_vn: Sau một hồi chiến đấu, tượng Milotic bất ngờ bay ra khỏi phi thuyền, bạn vươn tay muốn chộp lấy tượng, nhưng cũng vô tình rơi khỏi phi thuyền...

talkContent: The accident happens so suddenly, and your friends on the spaceship hurriedly send Pokémon to help, but due to the great height difference, they see you about to fall into the lake...
talkContent_ma: Kecelakaan itu terjadi begitu mendadak, teman-teman di pesawat luar angkasa buru-buru mengirim Pokémon untuk membantu, namun karena perbedaan ketinggian yang sangat besar, mereka melihat kalian hampir jatuh ke danau...
talkContent_en: The accident happens so suddenly, and your friends on the spaceship hurriedly send Pokémon to help, but due to the great height difference, they see you about to fall into the lake...
talkContent_th: เหตุการณ์เกิดขึ้นอย่างกะทันหัน เพื่อน ๆ บนยานรีบส่งโปเกมอนไปช่วย แต่เพราะความสูงห่างกันมาก พวกเขาเห็นว่าคุณกำลังจะตกลงไปในทะเลสาบ...
talkContent_ph: Napakabilis ng insidente, kaya’t agad na nagpadala ng Pokémon ang mga kaibigan mo sa spaceship para tumulong. Ngunit masyado nang mataas ang agwat — at mukhang mahuhulog ka na sa lawa...
talkContent_in: Kecelakaan terjadi terlalu tiba-tiba, teman-teman di atas kapal segera mengirim Pokémon untuk membantu, tapi karena perbedaan ketinggian terlalu besar, kamu sắp rơi xuống danau...
talkContent_vn: Tai nạn xảy ra quá bất ngờ, những người bạn trên tàu vũ trụ vội vàng phái Pokémon giúp đỡ, nhưng vì độ cao chênh lệch quá lớn, thấy bạn sắp rơi xuống hồ...

talkContent: At that moment, Feebas suddenly jumps out of its Poké Ball by itself, touches the part of the statue reflecting the bright light, and immediately, a burst of white light flashes, and you feel like something is lifting you up...
talkContent_ma: Pada saat itu, Feebas tiba-tiba melompat keluar dari Poké Ball, menyentuh bagian patung yang memantulkan cahaya terang, dan segera, sebuah cahaya putih berkilau, kalian merasa seperti diangkat oleh sesuatu...
talkContent_en: At that moment, Feebas suddenly jumps out of its Poké Ball by itself, touches the part of the statue reflecting the bright light, and immediately, a burst of white light flashes, and you feel like something is lifting you up...
talkContent_th: ในตอนนั้นเอง Feebas ก็จู่ ๆ กระโดดออกจากโปเกบอลของตัวเอง ไปแตะที่ส่วนของรูปปั้นที่สะท้อนแสงเจิดจ้า ทันใดนั้น แสงสีขาวจ้าก็ส่องวาบขึ้น คุณรู้สึกเหมือนมีอะไรบางอย่างยกตัวคุณขึ้นมา...
talkContent_ph: Sa sandaling iyon, biglang tumalon palabas ng Poké Ball si Feebas, tinamaan ang bahagi ng rebulto na kumikislap sa liwanag ng araw. Biglang may puting liwanag na sumiklab, at pakiramdam mo may kung anong pumigil sa pagbagsak mo...
talkContent_in: Saat itu, Feebas tiba-tiba melompat sendiri keluar dari Poké Ball, menyentuh bagian patung batu yang memantulkan cahaya terang, seketika itu juga, cahaya putih menyilaukan menyala, kamu merasa seolah sedang diangkat oleh sesuatu...
talkContent_vn: Ngay lúc đó, Feebas đột nhiên tự mình nhảy ra khỏi Poké Ball, chạm vào phần tượng đá đang phản chiếu ánh sáng rực rỡ, lập tức, một luồng ánh sáng trắng lóe lên, bạn cảm thấy như bị thứ gì đó nâng lên...

talkContent: It's Menas!
talkContent_ma: Itu Menas!
talkContent_en: It's Menas!
talkContent_th: เป็น Menas!
talkContent_ph: Si Menas!
talkContent_in: Itu Menas!
talkContent_vn: Là Menas!

talkContent: Oh, Feebas evolved into Milotic!
talkContent_ma: Oh, Feebas berevolusi menjadi Milotic!
talkContent_en: Oh, Feebas evolved into Milotic!
talkContent_th: ว้าว Feebas วิวัฒนาการเป็น Milotic แล้ว!
talkContent_ph: Wow, si Feebas ay nag-evolve na naging Milotic!
talkContent_in: Wow, Feebas berevolusi menjadi Milotic!
talkContent_vn: Ồ, Feebas tiến hóa thành Milotic rồi!

talkContent: Phew, safe now, thanks, ugly... oh no, Milotic!
talkContent_ma: Whew, selamat, terima kasih ya, jelek-jelek... eh, maksudku, Milotic!
talkContent_en: Phew, safe now, thanks, ugly... oh no, Milotic!
talkContent_th: เฮ้อ รอดแล้ว ขอบใจนะ เจ้าเจ้าขี้เหร่... เอ้ย ไม่ใช่สิ Milotic!
talkContent_ph: Haaay, ligtas na ako, salamat ha, pangit-pangit na—ay, este, Milotic!
talkContent_in: Huft, selamat! Terima kasih ya, si jelek... eh, maksudnya Milotic!
talkContent_vn: Phù, thoát rồi, cảm ơn nhé, xấu xấu xí xí... à không, Milotic!

talkContent: (You gently nuzzle your head against their neck)
talkContent_ma: (Milotic menyentuh kepala kalian dengan lembut)
talkContent_en: (You gently nuzzle your head against their neck)
talkContent_th: (ถูหัวอบอุ่นเข้าที่คอของคุณ)
talkContent_ph: (Milotic ay mainit na idinantay ang ulo niya sa leeg mo)
talkContent_in: (Milotic menggosokkan kepala hangat ke lehermu)
talkContent_vn: (Ấm áp dụi đầu vào cổ bạn)

talkContent: Oh my gosh! It’s Milotic!
talkContent_ma: Wow! Milotic cantik sekali!
talkContent_en: Oh my gosh! It’s Milotic!
talkContent_th: โอ้โห! Milotic นั่นนา!
talkContent_ph: Grabe! Milotic ‘yon ah!
talkContent_in: Astaga! Itu Milotic!
talkContent_vn: Trời ơi! Milotic kìa!

talkContent: Wow, Milotic is so beautiful, let’s go! I must capture it!
talkContent_ma: Wah, Milotic sangat indah, ayo kita pergi! Saya pasti harus menangkapnya!
talkContent_en: Wow, Milotic is so beautiful, let’s go! I must capture it!
talkContent_th: ว้าว Milotic สวยมาก ไปกันเถอะ! ฉันจะจับมันให้ได้!
talkContent_ph: Wow, sobrang ganda ni Milotic! Tara na! Kailangan ko siyang makuha!
talkContent_in: Wow, Milotic sangat cantik, ayo tangkap dia! Aku harus menangkapnya!
talkContent_vn: Wow, Milotic đẹp quá, lên thôi! Tôi nhất định phải thu phục nó!

talkContent: (Milotic gently places you on the shore, raising its head proudly to greet Team Rocket)
talkContent_ma: (Milotic dengan lembut meletakkan kalian di tepi pantai, menatap dengan bangga menyambut Tim Roket)
talkContent_en: (Milotic gently places you on the shore, raising its head proudly to greet Team Rocket)
talkContent_th: (Milotic ค่อย ๆ วางคุณลงที่ริมฝั่ง แล้วเชิดหน้าท้าทายกลุ่มร็อคเก็ต)
talkContent_ph: (Milotic ay marahang inilapag ka sa pampang, saka buong tapang humarap sa Team Rocket)
talkContent_in: (Milotic dengan lembut menurunkanmu ke darat, lalu menegakkan kepala menghadapi Tim Rocket)
talkContent_vn: (Milotic nhẹ nhàng đặt bạn lên bờ, ngẩng cao đầu nghênh đón nhóm Rocket)

talkContent: Let’s fight together! Milotic!
talkContent_ma: Ayo bertarung bersama! Milotic!
talkContent_en: Let’s fight together! Milotic!
talkContent_th: สู้ด้วยกันนะ Milotic!
talkContent_ph: Laban tayo, Milotic!
talkContent_in: Bertarung bersama ya, Milotic!
talkContent_vn: Cùng nhau chiến đấu nhé! Milotic!

talkContent: With the help of Menas, you easily defeat Team Rocket and enter the Temple of the Lake. You are the first team to reach the goal and win the final victory in this expedition...
talkContent_ma: Berkat bantuan Menas, kalian dengan mudah mengalahkan Tim Roket dan masuk ke Kuil Danau. Kalian adalah tim pertama yang mencapai tujuan dan meraih kemenangan terakhir dalam petualangan ini...
talkContent_en: With the help of Menas, you easily defeat Team Rocket and enter the Temple of the Lake. You are the first team to reach the goal and win the final victory in this expedition...
talkContent_th: ด้วยความช่วยเหลือจาก Menas พวกคุณสามารถเอาชนะทีมร็อคเก็ตได้อย่างง่ายดาย และเข้าสู่วิหารใต้ทะเลสาบ พวกคุณเป็นทีมแรกที่ไปถึงเส้นชัยและคว้าชัยชนะสุดท้ายในการผจญภัยครั้งนี้...
talkContent_ph: Sa tulong ni Menas, madaling natalo ninyo ang Team Rocket at nakapasok sa Templo ng Lawa. Kayo ang unang nakarating sa dulo at naging panalo sa buong adventure na ito...
talkContent_in: Berkat bantuan Menas, kalian berhasil mengalahkan Tim Rocket dengan mudah dan memasuki Kuil Danau. Kalian menjadi tim pertama yang mencapai garis akhir dan memenangkan ekspedisi kali ini...
talkContent_vn: Nhờ sự giúp đỡ của Menas, các bạn đã dễ dàng đánh bại nhóm Rocket và tiến vào Đền Thờ Hồ. Các bạn là đội đầu tiên đến đích và giành chiến thắng cuối cùng trong cuộc thám hiểm này...
