talkContent: The Snow Festival is coming soon, and everyone is making cakes to welcome the festival.
talkContent_ma: Festival salji dan ais sudah semakin dekat, mari kita buat kek untuk menyambut festival salji dan ais bersama-sama.
talkContent_en: The Snow Festival is coming soon, and everyone is making cakes to welcome the festival.
talkContent_th: เทศกาลหิมะกำลังจะมาถึงแล้ว ทุกคนมาช่วยกันทำเค้กเพื่อต้อนรับเทศกาลหิมะกันเถอะ
talkContent_ph: Malapit na ang Snow Festival, halina’t gumawa tayo ng mga matatamis na cake para salubungin ang Snow Festival!
talkContent_in: Festival salju akan segera tiba, ayo semuanya bersama-sama membuat kue untuk menyambut festival salju.
talkContent_vn: Lễ hội băng tuyết sắp đến rồi, mọi người cùng nhau làm bánh ngọt để chào đón lễ hội băng tuyết nhé.

talkContent: Yeah, yeah, let’s all work hard together!
talkContent_ma: Ya, ya, mari kita semua berusaha bersama-sama.
talkContent_en: Yeah, yeah, let’s all work hard together!
talkContent_th: ใช่ ๆ ทุกคนสู้ ๆ นะ
talkContent_ph: Oo oo, magtulungan tayong lahat!
talkContent_in: Iya iya, ayo semua semangat ya.
talkContent_vn: Ừ ừ, mọi người cùng cố gắng nhé.

talkContent: Oh, thank you all for your effort, the cake is finally done. Let’s call the kids to come eat the cake!
talkContent_ma: Oh, terima kasih semua atas usaha kalian, akhirnya kek sudah siap. Ayo cepat panggil adik-adik untuk datang makan kek.
talkContent_en: Oh, thank you all for your effort, the cake is finally done. Let’s call the kids to come eat the cake!
talkContent_th: โอ้ ขอบคุณทุกคนที่ช่วยกัน เค้กก้อนสุดท้ายก็เสร็จแล้ว ไปเรียกพวกเด็ก ๆ มากินเค้กกันเถอะ
talkContent_ph: Wow, salamat sa pagsisikap ninyong lahat, natapos din ang huling cake. Halina’t tawagin ang mga bata para kumain ng cake!
talkContent_in: Wah, terima kasih atas kerja keras semuanya, akhirnya kue tart sudah selesai. Ayo cepat panggil anak-anak untuk makan kue.
talkContent_vn: Ồ, cảm ơn mọi người đã nỗ lực, bánh kem cuối cùng cũng xong rồi. Mau đi gọi các bạn nhỏ đến ăn bánh kem thôi nào.

talkContent: The great king told me to patrol the mountains ♪... Hmm? What’s that smell, let’s go check it out.
talkContent_ma: Raja besar menyuruh saya pergi ronda di gunung ♪... Hmmm? Bau apa ni, mari saya lihat.
talkContent_en: The great king told me to patrol the mountains ♪... Hmm? What’s that smell, let’s go check it out.
talkContent_th: ราชาสั่งให้ข้าเดินตรวจภูเขา ♪... อืม? กลิ่นอะไรหอม ๆ นะ ไปดูหน่อยสิ
talkContent_ph: Inutusan ako ng Hari na magronda sa bundok ♪... Hmm? Anong mabangong amoy ‘yon, silipin ko nga.
talkContent_in: Raja menyuruhku patroli gunung ♪... Hmm? Apa aroma harum ini, coba aku lihat.
talkContent_vn: Đại vương bảo ta đi tuần núi ♪... Ừm? Cái gì thơm thế nhỉ, đi xem thử.

talkContent: Help, someone is stealing the cake!
talkContent_ma: Tolong, ada orang yang mencuri kek!
talkContent_en: Help, someone is stealing the cake!
talkContent_th: ช่วยด้วย! มีคนขโมยเค้ก!
talkContent_ph: Saklolo! May nagnanakaw ng cake!
talkContent_in: Tolong! Ada yang mencuri kue tart!
talkContent_vn: Cứu với, có người cướp bánh kem!

talkContent: This is the cake everyone worked hard to make, hurry and chase off the Weasels, don’t let them steal the cake!
talkContent_ma: Ini adalah kek yang kalian buat dengan susah payah, cepat halau Weasel-weasel itu, jangan biarkan mereka mencuri kek kita.
talkContent_en: This is the cake everyone worked hard to make, hurry and chase off the Weasels, don’t let them steal the cake!
talkContent_th: นี่คือเค้กที่ทุกคนช่วยกันทำอย่างยากลำบาก รีบไล่เจ้าพวก Weasel ไป อย่าให้พวกมันขโมยเค้กได้
talkContent_ph: Ito ang cake na pinaghirapan ng lahat, bilis habulin ang mga Weasel! Huwag hayaang maagaw ang cake!
talkContent_in: Ini kue tart yang sudah kita buat dengan susah payah, cepat kejar Weasel, jangan biarkan mereka mencuri kue!
talkContent_vn: Đây là chiếc bánh kem mọi người đã vất vả làm đó, mau đuổi lũ Weasel đi, đừng để chúng cướp bánh mất.

talkContent: Hmph! You’re bullying us just because you have the numbers. Wait, I’ll go call my big brother, you’re dead for sure!
talkContent_ma: Hmph! Kalian hanya berani mengganggu orang lain sebab ramai, tunggu saya panggil ketua datang, kalian habis!
talkContent_en: Hmph! You’re bullying us just because you have the numbers. Wait, I’ll go call my big brother, you’re dead for sure!
talkContent_th: หึ! พวกเจ้าอาศัยคนเยอะมารังแกกันเหรอ เดี๋ยวข้าจะไปเรียกพี่ใหญ่มา พวกเจ้าตายแน่!
talkContent_ph: Hmp! Inaapi n’yo ako dahil mas marami kayo ha! Hintayin n’yo, tatawagin ko si boss! Patay kayo sa kanya!
talkContent_in: Hmph! Kalian menang jumlah lalu berani menindas orang lain, tunggu saja, aku akan panggil kakakku, kalian mati pasti!
talkContent_vn: Hừ! Các người dựa vào đông người mà bắt nạt người khác, chờ đó tôi đi gọi đại ca đến, các người chết chắc!

talkContent: This is bad, the weasel and its gang are coming back with reinforcements.
talkContent_ma: Tidak baik, musang salji dan kawan-kawannya telah membawa tentera bantuan kembali.
talkContent_en: This is bad, the weasel and its gang are coming back with reinforcements.
talkContent_th: แย่แล้ว เจ้าพวกตัวเฟอเร็ตกับพวกมันกลับมาพร้อมกำลังเสริมแล้ว
talkContent_ph: Naku! Binalikan tayo ng weasel at mga kasamahan niya kasama ang mga reinforcements!
talkContent_in: Gawat, musang salju dan komplotannya bawa bala bantuan kembali.
talkContent_vn: Không hay rồi, con chồn sương và đồng bọn của nó dẫn quân tiếp viện quay lại rồi.

talkContent: Big Brother, we just wanted to try the cake, but they... they beat us up like this, huhuhu~
talkContent_ma: Ketua, kami hanya mahu rasa kek manis ni, tapi mereka... mereka pukul kami sampai jadi macam ni, huhuhu~
talkContent_en: Big Brother, we just wanted to try the cake, but they... they beat us up like this, huhuhu~
talkContent_th: พี่ใหญ่ พวกเราก็แค่อยากชิมเค้กเอง แต่พวกมัน... พวกมันรุมเราจนเป็นแบบนี้ ฮือ ๆ ๆ
talkContent_ph: Boss, gusto lang naman naming tikman ang cake, pero sila... sila ang nanakit sa amin, huhuhu~
talkContent_in: Kakak, kami hanya ingin mencicipi kue saja, tapi mereka... mereka memukuli kami begini, huhuhu~
talkContent_vn: Đại ca, tụi em chỉ muốn ăn thử bánh ngọt thôi, mà bọn họ... bọn họ đánh tụi em ra nông nỗi này, huhuhu~

talkContent: Hmph, how dare you hurt my underlings, you think I’m Weavile or Hello Kitty?! Underlings, watch closely, I’m going to take them all down in five rounds and get revenge for you.
talkContent_ma: Hmph, berani lukakan anak buah saya, kalau saya tak ajar mereka, ingat saya Weavile ni Hello Kitty ke? Anak buah tengok sini, tengok saya jatuhkan mereka semua dalam lima pusingan, balas dendam untuk kalian semua.
talkContent_en: Hmph, how dare you hurt my underlings, you think I’m Weavile or Hello Kitty?! Underlings, watch closely, I’m going to take them all down in five rounds and get revenge for you.
talkContent_th: หึ กล้าทำร้ายน้องชายข้า ไม่สั่งสอนหน่อยนึกว่าข้า Weavile เป็น Hello Kitty หรือไง! ดูให้ดีนะพวกเอ็ง ดูข้าจัดการพวกมันให้จบในห้ายก แก้แค้นให้พวกเอ็งเอง
talkContent_ph: Hmp! Nasaktan ang mga alagad ko? Akala n’yo siguro si Weavile ay Hello Kitty?! Mga bata, panoorin n’yo ‘ko, babanatan ko sila sa loob ng limang tira para ipaghiganti kayo!
talkContent_in: Hmph, berani melukai adik-adikku, kalau aku nggak kasih pelajaran, kalian kira aku Weavile ini Hello Kitty ya! Adik-adik, perhatikan baik-baik, lihat aku kalahkan mereka dalam lima ronde, balas dendam buat kalian.
talkContent_vn: Hừ, dám làm bị thương đàn em của tao, không cho chúng một bài học thì tưởng tao Weavile là Hello Kitty chắc! Đàn em nhìn cho kỹ đây, xem tao hạ gục hết bọn chúng trong năm hiệp, báo thù cho tụi bây.

talkContent: Big Brother, so mighty!
talkContent_ma: Ketua sangat hebat!
talkContent_en: Big Brother, so mighty!
talkContent_th: พี่ใหญ่สุดยอด!
talkContent_ph: Astig si boss!
talkContent_in: Kakak hebat banget!
talkContent_vn: Đại ca uy vũ!

talkContent: It’s time, little brother has some business today, underlings, retreat!
talkContent_ma: Sudah tiba masanya, tuan kecil ada sedikit urusan hari ini, anak buah, tarik diri!
talkContent_en: It’s time, little brother has some business today, underlings, retreat!
talkContent_th: ถึงเวลาแล้ว วันนี้ข้ามีธุระ ไปก่อนนะ พวกเรา ถอย!
talkContent_ph: Tama na ‘to, may lakad ako ngayon. Mga bata, umatras!
talkContent_in: Sudah waktunya, si kecil hari ini ada urusan, adik-adik, mundur!
talkContent_vn: Đến giờ rồi, tiểu gia hôm nay có chút việc, đàn em, rút!

talkContent: (Smiling mischievously) Hehehe, yeah, we’ve got some business, we’ll deal with you next time.
talkContent_ma: (Tersenyum nakal) Hehehe, betul, kami ada sedikit kerja, lain kali kami akan serang kamu lagi.
talkContent_en: (Smiling mischievously) Hehehe, yeah, we’ve got some business, we’ll deal with you next time.
talkContent_th: (หัวเราะหึ ๆ) ฮิ ๆ ใช่ ๆ พวกเรามีธุระ ไว้คราวหน้าค่อยสู้ใหม่
talkContent_ph: (Halakhak) Hihi hihi, oo nga oo nga, may lakad kami. Next time na ulit namin kayo babanatan.
talkContent_in: (tertawa cengar-cengir) Hehehe, iya iya, kami ada urusan, lain kali baru kita gebukin lagi.
talkContent_vn: (Cười tủm tỉm) Hì hì hì hì, đúng đúng, bọn tao có chút việc, lần sau lại đánh chúng mày.

talkContent: Oh no, we’ve fallen into their trap, while everything was in chaos, they kidnapped the Diamond Princess!
talkContent_ma: Aduh, kami dah terperangkap, tadi mereka memanfaatkan kekeliruan untuk menculik Puteri Berlian.
talkContent_en: Oh no, we’ve fallen into their trap, while everything was in chaos, they kidnapped the Diamond Princess!
talkContent_th: แย่แล้ว โดนหลอกแล้ว! พวกมันฉวยจังหวะช่วงชุลมุนลักพาตัวเจ้าหญิงเพชรไปแล้ว
talkContent_ph: Naku patay! Naloko tayo! Habang magulo kanina, tinangay nila si Princess Diamond!
talkContent_in: Celaka, kita masuk perangkap! Tadi mereka memanfaatkan kekacauan untuk menculik Putri Berlian!
talkContent_vn: Chết rồi, trúng kế rồi, vừa nãy bọn chúng thừa lúc hỗn loạn bắt cóc công chúa kim cương đi rồi.

talkContent: Oh no, what should we do? The Snow Festival is coming soon, we must hurry and rescue the princess.
talkContent_ma: Oh tidak, apa yang harus kita buat sekarang, festival salji dan ais akan tiba, kita mesti cepat menyelamatkan puteri.
talkContent_en: Oh no, what should we do? The Snow Festival is coming soon, we must hurry and rescue the princess.
talkContent_th: โอ้ ไม่นะ จะทำยังไงดี ใกล้ถึงเทศกาลหิมะแล้ว พวกเราต้องรีบช่วยเจ้าหญิงให้ได้
talkContent_ph: Ay hindi! Anong gagawin natin? Malapit na ang Snow Festival! Kailangan nating iligtas ang prinsesa agad-agad!
talkContent_in: Aduh tidak! Harus bagaimana sekarang, festival salju sebentar lagi, kita harus segera selamatkan sang putri!
talkContent_vn: Ôi không, phải làm sao bây giờ, sắp đến lễ hội băng tuyết rồi, chúng ta nhất định phải nhanh chóng giải cứu công chúa.

talkContent: Huhu, let’s go rescue the princess! The Snow Festival can’t be complete without the princess.
talkContent_ma: Huhu, mari kita cepat-cepat pergi menyelamatkan puteri! Festival salji dan ais tidak lengkap tanpa puteri.
talkContent_en: Huhu, let’s go rescue the princess! The Snow Festival can’t be complete without the princess.
talkContent_th: ฮือฮือ รีบไปช่วยเจ้าหญิงกันเถอะ เทศกาลหิมะจะขาดเจ้าหญิงไม่ได้
talkContent_ph: Huhu, tara na! Iligtas natin si Princess! Hindi kumpleto ang Snow Festival nang wala siya!
talkContent_in: Huhu, ayo kita cepat selamatkan putri! Festival salju tidak lengkap tanpa sang putri.
talkContent_vn: Huhu, chúng ta mau đi cứu công chúa thôi! Lễ hội băng tuyết không thể thiếu công chúa được.

talkContent: Magnezone is cunning and devious, fighting them head-on is not in our favor, plus the princess is in their hands. We’ll go ask the Ice Guardian; they’ll surely help us save the princess!
talkContent_ma: Magnezone licik dan jahat, bertempur dengan kita secara langsung tidak menguntungkan, lebih-lebih lagi puteri ada di tangan mereka, kita pergi minta bantuan dari Dewa Penjaga Salji, dia pasti boleh membantu kita menyelamatkan puteri!
talkContent_en: Magnezone is cunning and devious, fighting them head-on is not in our favor, plus the princess is in their hands. We’ll go ask the Ice Guardian; they’ll surely help us save the princess!
talkContent_th: Magnezone เจ้าเจ้าเล่ห์ ถ้าสู้ตรง ๆ ไม่ได้ผล แถมยังจับตัวเจ้าหญิงไว้ด้วย พวกเราไปขอความช่วยเหลือจากเทพพิทักษ์น้ำแข็งกันเถอะ ท่านต้องช่วยเราได้แน่
talkContent_ph: Si Magnezone ay tuso at hindi makikipaglaban nang harapan, at hawak pa nila si prinsesa. Kailangan nating humingi ng tulong sa Ice Guardian, siguradong matutulungan niya tayo.
talkContent_in: Magnezone licik dan penuh tipu daya, bertarung langsung dengannya tidak menguntungkan, apalagi sang putri ada di tangan mereka, kita pergi minta bantuan Penjaga Es, pasti beliau bisa bantu kita selamatkan putri!
talkContent_vn: Magnezone xảo quyệt gian trá, giao chiến trực diện với chúng ta không có lợi, hơn nữa công chúa còn nằm trong tay chúng, chúng ta đi hỏi Thần hộ mệnh băng giá, ngài ấy nhất định có thể giúp chúng ta cứu công chúa!

talkContent: I’ve heard of your troubles for a long time. If you want my help, you must first prove your strength.
talkContent_ma: Saya sudah mendengar cerita kalian sejak lama, kalau kalian mahu saya bantu, tunjukkan dahulu kekuatan kalian.
talkContent_en: I’ve heard of your troubles for a long time. If you want my help, you must first prove your strength.
talkContent_th: เรื่องของพวกเจ้าข้ารู้มานานแล้ว ถ้าอยากให้ข้าช่วย พวกเจ้าต้องพิสูจน์ฝีมือก่อน
talkContent_ph: Matagal ko nang narinig ang kwento n’yo. Kung gusto n’yong tumulong ako, patunayan n’yong may lakas talaga kayo.
talkContent_in: Aku sudah lama mendengar tentang masalah kalian, jika ingin aku membantu, kalian harus buktikan kekuatan kalian terlebih dahulu.
talkContent_vn: Chuyện của các người tôi đã nghe từ lâu, muốn tôi giúp thì các người phải chứng minh thực lực của mình trước đã.

talkContent: I admire your bravery, but you still have a certain gap in strength to defeat Weavile. I will grant you the power of snow and ice. When you use Ice-type skills, it will summon a snowball to attack alongside you. Now, use this power to defeat me.
talkContent_ma: Saya sangat kagum dengan keberanian kalian, tapi kekuatan kalian masih jauh untuk mengalahkan Weavile. Saya akan memberikan kalian kekuatan salji, apabila menggunakan kemahiran jenis Salji, ia akan memanggil bola salji untuk menyerang bersama kalian. Seterusnya, gunakan kekuatan salji ini untuk mengalahkan saya.
talkContent_en: I admire your bravery, but you still have a certain gap in strength to defeat Weavile. I will grant you the power of snow and ice. When you use Ice-type skills, it will summon a snowball to attack alongside you. Now, use this power to defeat me.
talkContent_th: ข้าชื่นชมความกล้าหาญของพวกเจ้านะ แต่ฝีมือของพวกเจ้ายังห่างชั้น Weavile อยู่ ข้าจะมอบพลังน้ำแข็งให้พวกเจ้า เมื่อลงมือด้วยท่าธาตุน้ำแข็ง จะสามารถเรียกลูกหิมะมาช่วยโจมตี พิสูจน์ให้ข้าเห็นด้วยพลังนี้สิ
talkContent_ph: Humahanga ako sa tapang ninyo, pero ang lakas ninyo ay medyo kulang pa para talunin si Weavile. Ipagkakaloob ko sa inyo ang kapangyarihan ng yelo. Kapag ginamit n’yo ang Ice skills, tatawagin ang snowballs para tumulong sa atake. Gamitin n’yo ito para labanan ako.
talkContent_in: Aku sangat kagum dengan keberanian kalian, tapi kekuatan kalian masih kurang untuk mengalahkan Weavile. Aku akan memberkati kalian dengan kekuatan es, saat menggunakan skill bertipe Es, bola salju akan dipanggil untuk membantu menyerang bersama kalian. Sekarang, gunakan kekuatan ini untuk mengalahkanku.
talkContent_vn: Tôi rất ngưỡng mộ sự dũng cảm của các bạn, nhưng thực lực của các bạn vẫn còn một khoảng cách nhất định để chiến thắng Weavile. Tôi sẽ ban cho các bạn sức mạnh băng tuyết, khi sử dụng kỹ năng hệ Băng sẽ triệu hồi cầu tuyết để cùng các bạn tấn công. Tiếp theo, hãy dùng sức mạnh băng tuyết này để đánh bại tôi đi.

talkContent: Very well, it seems you’ve mastered the power of snow and ice. Now, go rescue your princess.
talkContent_ma: Bagus, nampaknya kalian sudah menguasai kekuatan salji, pergi selamatkan puteri kalian.
talkContent_en: Very well, it seems you’ve mastered the power of snow and ice. Now, go rescue your princess.
talkContent_th: ดีมาก ดูเหมือนพวกเจ้าจะใช้พลังน้ำแข็งได้คล่องแล้ว ไปช่วยเจ้าหญิงของพวกเจ้าเถอะ
talkContent_ph: Magaling! Mukhang bihasa na kayo sa kapangyarihan ng yelo. Ngayon, iligtas n’yo na ang prinsesa ninyo!
talkContent_in: Bagus sekali, sepertinya kalian sudah menguasai kekuatan es, pergilah dan selamatkan sang putri kalian.
talkContent_vn: Tốt lắm, xem ra các con đã thuần thục sức mạnh băng tuyết rồi, đi cứu công chúa của các con đi.

talkContent: Hmph, I didn’t expect the ice traps on the road to not stop you... You guys, stop them, I’m going to find Big Brother!
talkContent_ma: Hmph, tidak sangka perangkap salji di jalan tidak menghalang kalian... Anak-anak, halang mereka, saya pergi cari ketua!
talkContent_en: Hmph, I didn’t expect the ice traps on the road to not stop you... You guys, stop them, I’m going to find Big Brother!
talkContent_th: หึ ไม่คิดกับดักน้ำแข็งตามทางจะหยุดพวกเจ้าไม่ได้... พวกเอ็ง จัดการพวกมัน ข้าจะไปหาพี่ใหญ่!
talkContent_ph: Hmp! Hindi ko akalaing hindi kayo napigilan ng mga ice traps... Mga bata, pigilan sila! Tatawagin ko si boss!
talkContent_in: Hmph, tak kusangka perangkap es di jalan tak bisa menghentikan kalian... Hei kalian, tahan mereka, aku akan panggil kakak!
talkContent_vn: Hừ, không ngờ bẫy băng trên đường lại không cản được các ngươi... Mấy đứa bay, chặn chúng lại cho ta, ta đi tìm đại ca!

talkContent: Looks like Weavile isn’t here. We need to rescue the princess before he comes back.
talkContent_ma: Nampaknya Weavile tidak ada di sini, kita mesti menyelamatkan puteri sebelum dia kembali.
talkContent_en: Looks like Weavile isn’t here. We need to rescue the princess before he comes back.
talkContent_th: ดูเหมือนว่า Weavile จะไม่อยู่ที่นี่ รีบช่วยเจ้าหญิงก่อนที่มันจะกลับมา
talkContent_ph: Mukhang wala si Weavile rito. Kailangan nating iligtas si prinsesa bago pa siya bumalik!
talkContent_in: Sepertinya Weavile tidak ada di sini, kita harus selamatkan putri sebelum dia kembali.
talkContent_vn: Có vẻ như Weavile không có ở đây, chúng ta phải giải cứu công chúa trước khi hắn quay lại.

talkContent: Huhu, you guys be careful, don’t accidentally hurt the princess.
talkContent_ma: Huhu, hati-hati, jangan sampai terluka puteri.
talkContent_en: Huhu, you guys be careful, don’t accidentally hurt the princess.
talkContent_th: ฮือฮือ ระวังหน่อยนะ อย่าพลาดไปโดนเจ้าหญิงล่ะ
talkContent_ph: Huhu, mag-ingat kayo, baka masaktan ang prinsesa.
talkContent_in: Huhu, hati-hati ya kalian, jangan sampai melukai sang putri.
talkContent_vn: Huhu, các ngươi cẩn thận đó, đừng có ngộ thương công chúa.

talkContent: Dare to hurt my brothers and steal the princess right in front of me! Waaahh~ There’s no escape now!
talkContent_ma: Berani buat anak buah saya cedera, dan menculik orang depan mata saya! Waa a a a a a~ Lari mana nak lari!
talkContent_en: Dare to hurt my brothers and steal the princess right in front of me! Waaahh~ There’s no escape now!
talkContent_th: กล้าทำร้ายพวกข้า แล้วยังกล้าชิงคนต่อหน้าข้าอีก! ว๊ากกกกก! หนีไปไหน!
talkContent_ph: Nasaktan n’yo ang mga kasama ko, at nagawa pang agawin ang tao sa harap ko?! Waaahhhh! Hindi kayo makakatakas!
talkContent_in: Berani melukai saudara-saudaraku, lalu menculik orang di depan mataku! Waaaah~ Mau lari ke mana?!
talkContent_vn: Dám làm bị thương anh em của tao, còn cướp người ngay trước mắt tao! Oa a a a a a~ Chạy đâu cho thoát!

talkContent: This is bad, Weavile caught up! Quickly use the Ice-type attack as instructed by the Ice Guardian.
talkContent_ma: Tidak baik, Weavile dah mengejar, cepat gunakan kemahiran jenis Salji dan serang seperti yang diarahkan oleh Dewa Penjaga Salji.
talkContent_en: This is bad, Weavile caught up! Quickly use the Ice-type attack as instructed by the Ice Guardian.
talkContent_th: ไม่ดีแล้ว! Weavile ไล่ตามมาแล้ว เร็ว ใช้ท่าธาตุน้ำแข็งโจมตีตามคำแนะนำของเทพพิทักษ์น้ำแข็ง!
talkContent_ph: Delikado na! Hinabol na tayo ni Weavile! Bilis! Gamitin ang Ice skill ayon sa tagubilin ng Ice Guardian!
talkContent_in: Tidak baik, Weavile mengejar kita, cepat gunakan skill bertipe Es sesuai petunjuk Penjaga Es!
talkContent_vn: Không ổn rồi, Weavile đuổi kịp rồi, nhanh chóng dùng chiêu hệ Băng tấn công theo chỉ dẫn của Thần Bảo Hộ Băng Giá.

talkContent: Hmph, even if Arceus comes today, he won’t be able to save you.
talkContent_ma: Hmph, hari ini walaupun Arceus datang pun, tidak akan dapat selamatkan kalian.
talkContent_en: Hmph, even if Arceus comes today, he won’t be able to save you.
talkContent_th: หึ วันนี้ต่อให้ Arceus มาเองก็ช่วยพวกเจ้าไม่ได้
talkContent_ph: Hmp! Kahit si Arceus pa ang dumating ngayon, hindi kayo maliligtas!
talkContent_in: Hmph, hari ini sekalipun Arceus datang juga tak bisa selamatkan kalian.
talkContent_vn: Hừ, hôm nay dù Arceus có đến cũng không cứu được các ngươi.

talkContent: Here we go again, the annual International Workers' Day is here, and we’re hosting a special event to vote for the Hardest Working Pokémon. Everyone is invited to cast their precious votes for the hardest working Pokémon in their hearts!
talkContent_ma: Sampai waktunya, Hari Buruh Tahunan telah tiba, khususnya untuk menganjurkan persidangan pemilihan Pokémon paling rajin, dijemput semua untuk mengundi Pokémon paling rajin di hati anda!
talkContent_en: Here we go again, the annual International Workers' Day is here, and we’re hosting a special event to vote for the Hardest Working Pokémon. Everyone is invited to cast their precious votes for the hardest working Pokémon in their hearts!
talkContent_th: ถึงเวลานัดอีกครั้ง วันแรงงานสากลประจำปีกำลังจะมาถึง จัดกิจกรรมโหวตเลือกโปเกมอนขยันที่สุด ขอเชิญทุกคนร่วมโหวตให้โปเกมอนขยันที่สุดในใจของคุณ!
talkContent_ph: Oras na ulit! Taunang pagdiriwang ng Araw ng Paggawa ay dumating na. Espesyal naming inihahandog ang botohan para sa pinakamasipag na Pokémon! Inaanyayahan ang lahat na bumoto sa pinaka-masipag sa puso ninyo!

talkContent_th: นี่ ๆ หยุดมือกันเดี๋ยวนี้ พวกเยอะไปรังแกคนเดียว มันเกินไปแล้วนะ!
talkContent_ph: Hoy kayo! Tama na ‘yan! Ang dami-dami n’yo tapos inaapi n’yo ang isa lang? Sobra na kayo!
talkContent_in: Hei hei, hentikan! Ramai-ramai seperti ini menindas satu orang, itu terlalu keterlaluan!
talkContent_vn: Này này, dừng tay lại đi, đông người như vậy mà bắt nạt một người, quá đáng lắm rồi!

talkContent: Win Condition: Protect Chimchar and defeat the other heroes!
talkContent_ma: Keadaan menang: Lindungi Chimchar, kalahkan para pahlawan lain!
talkContent_en: Win Condition: Protect Chimchar and defeat the other heroes!
talkContent_th: เงื่อนไขชนะ: ปกป้อง Chimchar เอาชนะพวกฮีโร่!
talkContent_ph: Kondisyon ng Panalo: Protektahan si Chimchar, talunin ang ibang bayani!
talkContent_in: Syarat kemenangan: Lindungi Chimchar, kalahkan para pahlawan lainnya!
talkContent_vn: Điều kiện thắng: Bảo vệ Chimchar, đánh bại các anh hùng khác!

talkContent: Phew... We managed to drive them off for now.
talkContent_ma: Huf... Sementara ini berjaya menangkis mereka.
talkContent_en: Phew... We managed to drive them off for now.
talkContent_th: เฮ้อ... ตอนนี้ไล่พวกนั้นไปได้ชั่วคราวแล้ว
talkContent_ph: Haaah... Napalayas natin sila pansamantala.
talkContent_in: Fiu... Untuk sementara berhasil memukul mundur mereka.
talkContent_vn: Phù... Tạm thời đánh lui được chúng rồi.

talkContent: Are you okay, Little Fire Monkey?
talkContent_ma: Apa yang terjadi, Si Kera Api?
talkContent_en: Are you okay, Little Fire Monkey?
talkContent_th: ไม่เป็นไรนะ เจ้า Chimchar
talkContent_ph: Ayos ka lang ba, Chimchar?
talkContent_in: Kau tidak apa-apa kan, Si Kera Api Kecil?
talkContent_vn: Bạn không sao chứ, Tiểu Hỏa Hầu!

talkContent: Oh no, I accidentally hurt Little Chimchar.
talkContent_ma: Oh tidak, saya telah terluka Tiểu Hỏa Hầu.
talkContent_en: Oh no, I accidentally hurt Little Chimchar.
talkContent_th: โอ้ ไม่นะ พลาดทำเจ้า Chimchar บาดเจ็บแล้ว
talkContent_ph: Ay naku, baka nasaktan ko siya...
talkContent_in: Aduh, tak sengaja melukai Si Kera Api Kecil rồi.
talkContent_vn: Ôi trời, lỡ làm bị thương Tiểu Hỏa Hầu rồi.

talkContent: Sob... (in pain) Ugh... aaaaah!!!
talkContent_ma: Huh... (sakit) Khak... a a a a!!!
talkContent_en: Sob... (in pain) Ugh... aaaaah!!!
talkContent_th: ฮึก... (เจ็บปวด) แฮ่ก... อ๊ากกกก!!!
talkContent_ph: Huhu... (nasasaktan) Khak... aaaahhh!!!
talkContent_in: Hiks... (kesakitan) Khak... a a a a!!!
talkContent_vn: Hức... (đau đớn) Khặc... á á á á!!!

talkContent: What’s wrong, Little Chimchar?
talkContent_ma: Apa yang berlaku, Si Kera Api?
talkContent_en: What’s wrong, Little Chimchar?
talkContent_th: เกิดอะไรขึ้น Chimchar?
talkContent_ph: Anong nangyayari sa ‘yo, Chimchar?!
talkContent_in: Apa yang terjadi, Si Kera Api?
talkContent_vn: Có chuyện gì vậy, Tiểu Hỏa Hầu?

talkContent: The little flame on Chimchar’s tail suddenly erupts into a wild fire that burns everything around it, with its tail spitting out flame columns that twist like fiery snakes.
talkContent_ma: Api kecil yang lemah dari Si Kera Api tiba-tiba meletus menjadi api yang hebat, membakar sekeliling, ekornya memancarkan tiang api yang berliku-liku seperti ular api.
talkContent_en: The little flame on Chimchar’s tail suddenly erupts into a wild fire that burns everything around it, with its tail spitting out flame columns that twist like fiery snakes.
talkContent_th: เปลวไฟเล็ก ๆ บนตัว Chimchar ระเบิดกลายเป็นเปลวไฟรุนแรงลุกโชนรอบตัว หางของมันพ่นเปลวไฟราวกับงูไฟ
talkContent_ph: Ang mahinang apoy ng buntot ni Chimchar biglang naging napakalakas at nagsimulang sunugin ang paligid. Ang buntot niya ay nagpapalabas ng apoy na tila sumasayaw na mga ahas.
talkContent_in: Api kecil yang lemah dari Chimchar tiba-tiba meledak menjadi kobaran api dahsyat yang membakar sekeliling, ekornya menyemburkan tiang-tiang api seperti ular api.
talkContent_vn: Ngọn lửa nhỏ yếu ớt của Hỏa Hầu bỗng bùng nổ thành ngọn lửa dữ dội thiêu đốt xung quanh, đuôi nó phun ra những cột lửa uốn lượn như rắn lửa.

talkContent: The fire’s so strong...
talkContent_ma: Api yang kuat sekali...
talkContent_en: The fire’s so strong...
talkContent_th: ไฟแรงมาก...
talkContent_ph: Grabe ang lakas ng apoy...
talkContent_in: Apinya sangat kuat...
talkContent_vn: Ngọn lửa mạnh mẽ quá...

talkContent: Suddenly, Little Chimchar’s body emits a dazzling white light.
talkContent_ma: Tiba-tiba, tubuh Si Kera Api mengeluarkan satu aliran cahaya putih yang terang.
talkContent_en: Suddenly, Little Chimchar’s body emits a dazzling white light.
talkContent_th: ทันใดนั้น ร่าง Chimchar เปล่งแสงสีขาวเจิดจ้า
talkContent_ph: Biglang lumiwanag ang buong katawan ni Chimchar sa puting liwanag!
talkContent_in: Tiba-tiba, tubuh Si Kera Api memancarkan cahaya putih menyilaukan.
talkContent_vn: Đột nhiên, cơ thể Tiểu Hỏa Hầu phát ra một luồng ánh sáng trắng chói lọi.

talkContent: Could this be—evolution!?
talkContent_ma: Adakah ini—evolusi!?
talkContent_en: Could this be—evolution!?
talkContent_th: นี่มัน—วิวัฒนาการ!?
talkContent_ph: Ito ba ay—Ebolusyon!?
talkContent_in: Jangan-jangan ini—evolusi!?
talkContent_vn: Đây chẳng lẽ là—tiến hóa!?

talkContent: Hey ka ~ hey ka a a!! (Chimchar evolves, eyes red, continuously spitting fire around)
talkContent_ma: Hây ka ~ hây ka a a!! (Khỉ Đầu Lửa berubah dengan mata merah terus mengeluarkan api ke sekeliling)
talkContent_en: Hey ka ~ hey ka a a!! (Chimchar evolves, eyes red, continuously spitting fire around)
talkContent_th: ฮ่าก้า~ฮ่าก้าอ๊ากก!! (Monferno แดงก่ำ พ่นไฟรอบตัวไม่หยุด)
talkContent_ph: Hyaaah ka~ hyaaah kaaa!! (Si Monferno ay nag-evolve at sobrang galit, nagsimulang magbuga ng apoy sa paligid)
talkContent_in: Hya ka ~ hya ka a a!! (Monferno berevolusi dengan mata merah, menyemburkan api terus-menerus ke sekitarnya)
talkContent_vn: Hây ka ~ hây ka a a!! (Khỉ Đầu Lửa tiến hóa đỏ mắt liên tục phun lửa ra xung quanh)

talkContent: This is bad, Monferno seems to have lost control and gone berserk!
talkContent_ma: Tak baik, Monferno nampaknya kehilangan kawalan dan menjadi marah!
talkContent_en: This is bad, Monferno seems to have lost control and gone berserk!
talkContent_th: แย่แล้ว Monferno ดูเหมือนจะควบคุมตัวเองไม่ได้แล้ว!
talkContent_ph: Hindi maganda ‘to! Mukhang nawalan ng kontrol si Monferno!
talkContent_in: Gawat, Monferno tampaknya kehilangan kendali dan mengamuk!
talkContent_vn: Không hay rồi, Monferno có vẻ mất kiểm soát và nổi điên lên!

talkContent: Calm down, Monferno!
talkContent_ma: Tenanglah, Monferno!
talkContent_en: Calm down, Monferno!
talkContent_th: ใจเย็นก่อน Monferno!
talkContent_ph: Magpakalma ka, Monferno!
talkContent_in: Sadarlah, Monferno!
talkContent_vn: Tỉnh táo lại đi, Monferno!

talkContent: Win Condition: Control the out-of-control Mankey.
talkContent_ma: Keadaan menang: Kawal Mankey yang sedang marah dan hilang kawalan.
talkContent_en: Win Condition: Control the out-of-control Mankey.
talkContent_th: เงื่อนไขชนะ: ควบคุมลิง Monferno ที่กำลังบ้าคลั่งให้ได้
talkContent_ph: Kondisyon ng Panalo: Pigilan si Monferno na nawawala sa kontrol.
talkContent_in: Syarat kemenangan: Hentikan Monferno yang sedang mengamuk tak terkendali.
talkContent_vn: Điều kiện chiến thắng: Khống chế được khỉ Mankey đang phát cuồng mất kiểm soát.

talkContent: Mighty Fire Monkey, are you okay?
talkContent_ma: Mãnh Hỏa Hầu, kamu tak apa-apa, kan?
talkContent_en: Mighty Fire Monkey, are you okay?
talkContent_th: Infernape นายไม่เป็นไรนะ?
talkContent_ph: Monferno, ayos ka lang?!
talkContent_in: Infernape, kau tak apa-apa kan?
talkContent_vn: Mãnh Hỏa Hầu, cậu không sao chứ?

talkContent: Hey!
talkContent_ma: Eh ha!
talkContent_en: Hey!
talkContent_th: เอ้ฮ่า!
talkContent_ph: Eha!
talkContent_in: E ha!
talkContent_vn: Ê ha!

talkContent: Stone blades rush toward you, and a group of cruel heroes descends from the sky.
talkContent_ma: Beberapa batu besar terbang melintas halang jalanmu, dan sekumpulan pahlawan jahat muncul dari langit.
talkContent_en: Stone blades rush toward you, and a group of cruel heroes descends from the sky.
talkContent_th: หินแหลมพุ่งเข้าขวางทางคุณ และกลุ่มฮีโร่โหดเหี้ยมอีกกลุ่มหนึ่งกระโจนลงมาจากท้องฟ้า
talkContent_ph: Biglang may mga talim ng bato na lumitaw sa daraanan mo, at isa pang grupo ng masasamang bayani ang bumagsak mula sa langit.
talkContent_in: Batu-batu tajam meluncur menghalangi jalanmu, dan sekelompok pahlawan galak lain turun dari langit.
talkContent_vn: Những lưỡi đá lao tới cản đường bạn, và một đám anh hùng hung ác khác từ trên trời giáng xuống.

talkContent: This is bad, looks like these new heroes are allies of the ones from before.
talkContent_ma: Aduh, nampaknya pahlawan-pahlawan ini adalah sekutu dengan yang tadi.
talkContent_en: This is bad, looks like these new heroes are allies of the ones from before.
talkContent_th: แย่แล้ว ดูเหมือนพวกฮีโร่กลุ่มนี้จะเป็นพวกเดียวกับเมื่อกี้
talkContent_ph: Delikado, mukhang kasabwat sila ng naunang grupo!
talkContent_in: Gawat, tampaknya mereka adalah sekutu dari para pahlawan sebelumnya.
talkContent_vn: Tệ rồi, xem ra đám anh hùng này là đồng bọn với đám lúc nãy.

talkContent: We need to quickly protect the fire monkey.
talkContent_ma: Perlulah segera melindungi si monyet api.
talkContent_en: We need to quickly protect the fire monkey.
talkContent_th: ต้องรีบปกป้อง Monferno
talkContent_ph: Kailangan nating protektahan si Monferno agad-agad!
talkContent_in: Kita harus segera lindungi Monferno.
talkContent_vn: Phải nhanh chóng bảo vệ khỉ đầu lửa.

talkContent: Win Condition: Defeat the heroes causing trouble.
talkContent_ma: Keadaan menang: Kalahkan para pahlawan yang mengganggu.
talkContent_en: Win Condition: Defeat the heroes causing trouble.
talkContent_th: เงื่อนไขชนะ: เอาชนะพวกฮีโร่ที่เข้ามาก่อกวน
talkContent_ph: Kondisyon ng Panalo: Talunin ang mga bayani na nanggugulo!
talkContent_in: Syarat kemenangan: Kalahkan para pahlawan pengacau.
talkContent_vn: Điều kiện chiến thắng: Đánh bại các anh hùng đến quấy rối.

talkContent: Pikachu, Thunderbolt!
talkContent_ma: Pikachu, sepuluh ribu volt!
talkContent_en: Pikachu, Thunderbolt!
talkContent_th: Pikachu, หนึ่งแสนโวลต์!
talkContent_ph: Pikachu, sampung libong volt!
talkContent_in: Pikachu, Serangan 100 Ribu Volt!
talkContent_vn: Pikachu, mười vạn volt!

talkContent: Pika-chu!
talkContent_ma: Pika-chu!
talkContent_en: Pika-chu!
talkContent_th: ปิก้าชู!
talkContent_ph: Pika-chuuu!
talkContent_in: Pika-chu!
talkContent_vn: Pika-chu!

talkContent: Crocô tried his best to dodge Pikachu's Thunderbolt, but the electricity hit the grass behind him, waking up Slaking, who was sleeping.
talkContent_ma: Crocô cuba mengelak serangan Sepuluh Ribu Volt dari Pikachu, aliran elektrik mengenai semak di belakangnya, mengejutkan Slaking yang sedang tidur.
talkContent_en: Crocô tried his best to dodge Pikachu's Thunderbolt, but the electricity hit the grass behind him, waking up Slaking, who was sleeping.
talkContent_th: Crocô พยายามหลบการโจมตีของ Pikachu อย่างเต็มที่ กระแสไฟฟ้าฟาดเข้าใส่พุ่มไม้ด้านหลัง ปลุกให้ Slaking ที่หลับอยู่ตื่นขึ้น
talkContent_ph: Sinikap ni Crocô hết sức upang makaiwas sa Thunderbolt ni Pikachu, pero tumama ang kuryente sa damuhan sa likod niya, na siyang gumising kay Slaking na natutulog.
talkContent_in: Crocô berusaha sekuat tenaga menghindari Serangan 100 Ribu Volt dari Pikachu, tapi arus listriknya malah menyambar semak-semak di belakangnya dan membangunkan Slaking yang sedang tidur.
talkContent_vn: Crocô đã cố gắng hết sức để né tránh chiêu Mười Vạn Volt của Pikachu, dòng điện đánh vào bụi cỏ phía sau hắn, đánh thức Slaking đang ngủ.

talkContent: Quickly, like oil on your feet.
talkContent_ma: Lari cepat macam sapu minyak!
talkContent_en: Quickly, like oil on your feet.
talkContent_th: หนีสิ หนีเร็วเหมือนทาน้ำมันไว้ที่เท้า
talkContent_ph: Takbo agad na parang may langis sa paa.
talkContent_in: Kabur secepat kilat seperti diolesi minyak.
talkContent_vn: Chuồn lẹ như bôi dầu vào chân.

talkContent: Oh, sorry, Regirock, we didn’t mean to...
talkContent_ma: Oh, maaf, Regirock, kami tak sengaja...
talkContent_en: Oh, sorry, Regirock, we didn’t mean to...
talkContent_th: โอ้ ขอโทษนะ Regirock พวกเราไม่ได้ตั้งใจ...
talkContent_ph: Ay, pasensya na, Regirock, hindi namin sinasadya...
talkContent_in: Oh, maaf, Regirock, kami tidak sengaja...
talkContent_vn: Ồ, xin lỗi, Regirock, chúng tôi không cố ý...

talkContent: Aaahhhh! (Angrily pounds its chest!)
talkContent_ma: A a a a a a a a! (Marah sambil menumbuk dada!)
talkContent_en: Aaahhhh! (Angrily pounds its chest!)
talkContent_th: อ๊ากกกกกก! (โกรธต่อยหน้าอก!)
talkContent_ph: Aaaaahhh! (Galit na galit, suntok-suntok ang dibdib!)
talkContent_in: A a a a a a a a! (Marah dan menghantam dada!)
talkContent_vn: Á á á á á á á á! (Tức giận đấm ngực!)

talkContent: I can’t stand it any longer, it’s time to face this head-on...
talkContent_ma: Tak boleh tahan lagi, hanya boleh lawan terus...
talkContent_en: I can’t stand it any longer, it’s time to face this head-on...
talkContent_th: พูดไม่รู้เรื่องแล้ว แบบนี้คงต้องสู้กันเท่านั้น...
talkContent_ph: Wala nang pakikipag-usap, kailangan na lang lumaban...
talkContent_in: Tidak bisa diajak bicara baik-baik, satu-satunya jalan adalah bertarung...
talkContent_vn: Hoàn toàn không thể nghe lọt tai, chỉ có thể nghênh chiến thôi...

talkContent: Win Condition: Defeat the enraged Slaking
talkContent_ma: Keadaan menang: Kalahkan Slaking yang marah.
talkContent_en: Win Condition: Defeat the enraged Slaking
talkContent_th: เงื่อนไขชนะ: เอาชนะ Slaking ที่โกรธจัด
talkContent_ph: Kondisyon ng Panalo: Talunin ang galit na Slaking
talkContent_in: Syarat kemenangan: Kalahkan Slaking yang sedang mengamuk
talkContent_vn: Điều kiện thắng: Đánh bại Slaking cuồng nộ

talkContent: Hmm, this Slaking has incredibly strong fighting power!
talkContent_ma: Hmm, Slaking ni kuat sangat!
talkContent_en: Hmm, this Slaking has incredibly strong fighting power!
talkContent_th: อืม เจ้า Slaking ตัวนี้แข็งแกร่งมาก!
talkContent_ph: Hmm, ang lakas makipaglaban ng Slaking na ‘to!
talkContent_in: Hmm, Slaking ini punya kekuatan tempur yang luar biasa!
talkContent_vn: Ừm, con Slaking này có sức chiến đấu mạnh mẽ quá!

talkContent: Vigoroth, in a furious rage, throws a punch with all its might, about to hit the exhausted Pikachu –
talkContent_ma: Vigoroth yang tengah marah melontar satu pukulan kuat, hampir mengenai Pikachu yang sudah keletihan –
talkContent_en: Vigoroth, in a furious rage, throws a punch with all its might, about to hit the exhausted Pikachu –
talkContent_th: Vigoroth กำลังฮึกเหิมและเหวี่ยงหมัดใส่ Pikachu ที่กำลังหมดแรงอย่างเต็มที่ –
talkContent_ph: Si Vigoroth ay galit na galit at binigwasan si Pikachu na nanghihina –
talkContent_in: Vigoroth sedang mengamuk, mengayunkan pukulan keras, hampir mengenai Pikachu yang sudah kelelahan –
talkContent_vn: Vigoroth đang hăng máu vung một đấm hết sức, sắp sửa trúng Pikachu đang kiệt sức –

talkContent: Pikachu, be careful!
talkContent_ma: Pikachu hati-hati!
talkContent_en: Pikachu, be careful!
talkContent_th: Pikachu ระวัง!
talkContent_ph: Pikachu, mag-ingat ka!
talkContent_in: Pikachu, hati-hati!
talkContent_vn: Pikachu cẩn thận!

talkContent: At this moment, a burst of fire flashes, saving Pikachu from Slaking’s punch. The Fire Spin attack stops not far away, the flames dissipating to reveal the figure of Infernape.
talkContent_ma: Pada saat itu, satu cahaya api menyala, menyelamatkan Pikachu dari pukulan Slaking, serangan Vòng Lửa berhenti tidak jauh, api itu pun padam, memperlihatkan siluet Infernape.
talkContent_en: At this moment, a burst of fire flashes, saving Pikachu from Slaking’s punch. The Fire Spin attack stops not far away, the flames dissipating to reveal the figure of Infernape.
talkContent_th: ในตอนนั้น เปลวไฟสายหนึ่งพุ่งเข้ามาช่วย Pikachu จากหมัดของ Slaking ท่าระเบิดไฟหยุดลงไม่ไกล ไฟจางลง เผยให้เห็นเงาของ Infernape
talkContent_ph: Sa oras ding ‘yon, isang apoy ang biglang sumiklab, iniligtas si Pikachu mula sa suntok ni Slaking. Tumigil ang Flame Wheel sa di kalayuan, at sa pagkalat ng apoy, lumitaw ang anyo ni Infernape.
talkContent_in: Saat itu, kilatan api muncul, menyelamatkan Pikachu dari pukulan Slaking, jurus Lingkaran Api berhenti tak jauh, api menghilang, memperlihatkan sosok Infernape.
talkContent_vn: Lúc này, một đạo lửa lóe lên, cứu Pikachu khỏi nắm đấm của Slaking, chiêu Vòng Lửa dừng lại ở không xa, ngọn lửa tan đi, hiện ra bóng dáng của Infernape.

talkContent: AmonkGo... No, Infernape?
talkContent_ma: AmonkGo... Tidak, Infernape?
talkContent_en: AmonkGo... No, Infernape?
talkContent_th: AmonkGo... ไม่ใช่สิ Infernape?
talkContent_ph: AmonkGo... Hindi, si Infernape!?
talkContent_in: AmonkGo... Tidak, itu Infernape?
talkContent_vn: AmonkGo... Không, Infernape?

talkContent: Well done, you’ve evolved into Infernape!
talkContent_ma: Bagus, kamu telah berevolusi menjadi Infernape!
talkContent_en: Well done, you’ve evolved into Infernape!
talkContent_th: สุดยอด! นายวิวัฒนาการเป็น Infernape แล้ว!
talkContent_ph: Ang galing mo! Nag-evolve ka na sa Infernape!
talkContent_in: Hebat! Kamu telah berevolusi menjadi Infernape rồi!
talkContent_vn: Giỏi quá, bạn tiến hóa thành Infernape rồi kìa!

talkContent: (Places Pikachu down, turns to face Slaking)
talkContent_ma: (Menurunkan Pikachu, berbalik untuk berhadapan dengan Slaking)
talkContent_en: (Places Pikachu down, turns to face Slaking)
talkContent_th: (วาง Pikachu ลง แล้วหันไปเผชิญหน้ากับ Slaking)
talkContent_ph: (Ibinaba si Pikachu, at hinarap si Slaking)
talkContent_in: (Menaruh Pikachu, lalu berbalik menghadap Slaking)
talkContent_vn: (Đặt Pikachu xuống, quay người đối mặt với Slaking)

talkContent: The two sides face off for a while. Slaking snorts coldly, turns around, and goes back to the grass to sleep.

talkContent: The unit on the left speaks first. You’ve seen the game pause, and a dialog box appears at the bottom. Click to immediately reveal all, click again to go to the next segment. Please note not to write too many words to avoid overflow.
talkContent_ma: Unit di sebelah kiri bercakap terlebih dahulu. Anda telah melihat permainan dihentikan, dan kotak dialog muncul di bawah. Klik untuk segera memaparkan semuanya, klik sekali lagi untuk beralih ke segmen seterusnya. Sila pastikan untuk tidak menulis terlalu banyak perkataan untuk mengelakkan melimpah.
talkContent_en: The unit on the left speaks first. You’ve seen the game pause, and a dialog box appears at the bottom. Click to immediately reveal all, click again to go to the next segment. Please note not to write too many words to avoid overflow.
talkContent_th: หน่วยทางซ้ายจะเริ่มสนทนาก่อน คุณจะเห็นว่าเกมหยุดชั่วคราวและมีหน้าต่างโต้ตอบปรากฏขึ้นด้านล่าง แตะเพื่อแสดงทั้งหมดทันที แตะอีกครั้งเพื่อไปยังฉากถัดไป โปรดระวังอย่าเขียนข้อความยาวเกินไปเพื่อหลีกเลี่ยงการล้นหน้าจอ
talkContent_ph: Ang yunit sa kaliwa ang unang nagsasalita. Makikita mong naka-pause ang laro at may lalabas na dialogue box sa ibaba. Pindutin para agad ipakita ang buong linya, at pindutin ulit para lumipat sa susunod na bahagi. Tandaan na huwag maglagay ng sobrang daming salita upang maiwasan ang pag-overflow.
talkContent_in: Unit sebelah kiri berbicara dulu. Kamu akan melihat game dijeda dan dialog box muncul di bawah. Tekan untuk langsung tampilkan semua teks, tekan lagi untuk lanjut ke bagian berikutnya. Harap tidak menulis terlalu banyak teks agar tidak meluap.
talkContent_vn: Đơn vị bên trái đối thoại trước. Bạn đã thấy game tạm dừng và một hộp thoại hiện bên dưới. Nhấn để hiển thị hết ngay lập tức, nhấn lần nữa để sang đoạn kế tiếp. Lưu ý không viết quá nhiều chữ để tránh bị tràn.

talkContent: Now the unit on the right starts speaking. Next, there will be a bubble display. The bubbles and dialogue should not be configured simultaneously in the same story segment, though combining them is not a problem.
talkContent_ma: Sekarang unit di sebelah kanan mula bercakap. Seterusnya, akan ada paparan gelembung. Gelembung dan dialog tidak seharusnya disediakan serentak dalam segmen cerita yang sama, walaupun menggabungkannya juga tidak menjadi masalah.
talkContent_en: Now the unit on the right starts speaking. Next, there will be a bubble display. The bubbles and dialogue should not be configured simultaneously in the same story segment, though combining them is not a problem.
talkContent_th: ตอนนี้หน่วยทางขวาจะเริ่มพูด ต่อไปจะเป็นฉากแสดงฟองคำพูด ฟองคำพูดและบทสนทนาไม่ควรถูกตั้งค่าให้แสดงพร้อมกันในฉากเดียวกัน แม้ว่าการรวมเข้าด้วยกันจะไม่เป็นปัญหา
talkContent_ph: Ngayon naman, ang yunit sa kanan ang magsasalita. Susunod ay isang balloon performance. Ang mga balloon at mga dialogue ay hindi dapat ipagsabay sa parehong bahagi ng kwento, pero okay lang naman kung pagsamahin.
talkContent_in: Sekarang giliran unit di sebelah kanan berbicara. Selanjutnya akan ada tampilan gelembung percakapan. Gelembung dan dialog jangan dikonfigurasi bersamaan dalam satu segmen cerita, meski menggabungkannya juga tak masalah.
talkContent_vn: Bây giờ đơn vị bên phải bắt đầu nói. Tiếp theo sẽ là một màn trình diễn bong bóng. Bong bóng và hội thoại không nên được cấu hình đồng thời trong cùng một phân đoạn cốt truyện, mặc dù việc kết hợp chúng với nhau cũng không có vấn đề gì.

talkContent: Positions 2 and 7 at the top will display the bubbles. If the target on the field corresponding to the bubble display position does not exist, no error will be reported, but the bubbles just won’t display.
talkContent_ma: Posisi 2 dan 7 di bahagian atas akan memaparkan gelembung. Jika sasaran di lapangan yang sepadan dengan kedudukan paparan gelembung tidak wujud, tiada ralat akan dilaporkan, tetapi gelembung tersebut hanya tidak akan dipaparkan.
talkContent_en: Positions 2 and 7 at the top will display the bubbles. If the target on the field corresponding to the bubble display position does not exist, no error will be reported, but the bubbles just won’t display.
talkContent_th: ตำแหน่งที่ 2 และ 7 ด้านบนจะเป็นตำแหน่งแสดงฟองคำพูด หากไม่มีเป้าหมายบนสนามที่ตรงกับตำแหน่งเหล่านั้น ฟองคำพูดจะไม่แสดงและจะไม่มีข้อความแสดงข้อผิดพลาด
talkContent_ph: Ang posisyon 2 at 7 sa itaas ang magpapakita ng balloon. Kung walang target sa field na tumutugma sa posisyon, walang magiging error—hindi lang ito ipapakita.
talkContent_in: Posisi nomor 2 dan 7 di atas akan menampilkan gelembung. Jika target di lapangan yang cocok dengan posisi gelembung tidak ada, tidak akan muncul error, hanya saja gelembung tidak tampil.
talkContent_vn: Vị trí số 2 và số 7 trên đầu sẽ hiển thị bong bóng, nếu mục tiêu trên sân tương ứng với vị trí hiển thị bong bóng không tồn tại, sẽ không báo lỗi mà chỉ là không hiển thị.

topTalk_en: Hello, position number 2 is speaking.

topTalk_in: Halo, posisi nomor 2 sedang berbicara.

topTalk: No position. This section can be considered as a segment used to control arbitrary time delay, no processing needed.
topTalk_ma: Tiada posisi. Boleh dianggap sebagai bahagian untuk mengawal kelewatan masa sesuka hati, tiada pemprosesan apa-apa.
topTalk_en: No position. This section can be considered as a segment used to control arbitrary time delay, no processing needed.
topTalk_th: ไม่มีตำแหน่ง ข้อความนี้ใช้สำหรับควบคุมการหน่วงเวลาตามใจ ไม่ต้องดำเนินการใดๆ
topTalk_ph: Walang posisyon. Maaaring ituring ang bahaging ito bilang para sa kontrol ng arbitraryong delay ng oras, walang kailangang iproseso.
topTalk_in: Tidak ada posisi. Bisa dianggap sebagai bagian yang digunakan untuk mengontrol waktu tunda sesuka hati, tidak ada pemrosesan apapun.
topTalk_vn: Không có vị trí nào. Có thể coi đoạn này như một đoạn dùng để kiểm soát độ trễ thời gian tùy ý, không xử lý gì cả.

talkContent: The conversation has ended. Please note that when configuring, you only need to set the starting ID of a story segment. The system will automatically increment to search, so if they are not part of the same story segment, you should not set consecutive IDs.
talkContent_ma: Perbualan telah tamat. Sila ambil perhatian bahawa apabila menyediakan, anda hanya perlu menetapkan ID permulaan bagi segmen cerita. Sistem akan secara automatik menaikkan untuk mencari, jadi jika mereka bukan sebahagian daripada segmen cerita yang sama, anda tidak harus menetapkan ID berturut-turut.
talkContent_en: The conversation has ended. Please note that when configuring, you only need to set the starting ID of a story segment. The system will automatically increment to search, so if they are not part of the same story segment, you should not set consecutive IDs.
talkContent_th: การสนทนาได้สิ้นสุดลงแล้ว โปรดทราบว่าเมื่อตั้งค่า เพียงกำหนดค่า ID จุดเริ่มต้นของฉากเนื้อเรื่อง ระบบจะค้นหาโดยอัตโนมัติตามลำดับ ดังนั้นหากไม่ใช่ฉากเนื้อเรื่องเดียวกัน ไม่ควรกำหนดค่า ID ให้ต่อเนื่องกัน
talkContent_ph: Tapos na ang pag-uusap. Tandaan, kapag nagse-set ng configuration, sapat na tukuyin ang panimulang ID ng isang bahagi ng kwento, at awtomatikong hahanapin ito ng sistema sa pagkakasunod-sunod. Kaya kung hindi ito kabilang sa parehong kwento, huwag mag-set ng sunud-sunod na ID.
talkContent_in: Percakapan selesai. Harap dicatat saat konfigurasi, hanya perlu atur ID awal dari satu segmen cerita, sistem akan otomatis meningkat untuk mencari. Jadi, jika bukan bagian dari segmen cerita yang sama, jangan atur ID-nya secara berurutan.
talkContent_vn: Đã kết thúc hội thoại. Lưu ý khi cấu hình, chỉ cần cấu hình ID bắt đầu của một đoạn cốt truyện, hệ thống sẽ tự động tăng dần để tìm kiếm, vì vậy nếu không phải cùng một đoạn cốt truyện thì không nên cấu hình ID liên tiếp nhau.

talkContent: I configured it like this, and the effect I saw was like this. If you configure it this way, the effect you see will also be the same. —— Jackie Chan
talkContent_ma: Saya menyediakannya seperti ini, dan kesan yang saya lihat adalah seperti ini. Jika anda menyediakannya seperti ini, kesan yang anda lihat juga akan sama. —— Jackie Chan
talkContent_en: I configured it like this, and the effect I saw was like this. If you configure it this way, the effect you see will also be the same. —— Jackie Chan
talkContent_th: ฉันตั้งค่าแบบนี้ และเอฟเฟกต์ที่ฉันเห็นก็คือแบบนี้ หากคุณตั้งค่าในลักษณะเดียวกัน เอฟเฟกต์ที่คุณเห็นก็จะเป็นแบบเดียวกัน —— เฉินหลง
talkContent_ph: Ganito ko ito na-configure, at ganito rin ang naging epekto na nakita ko. Kung i-configure mo rin ito sa ganitong paraan, magiging pareho rin ang epekto na makikita mo. —— Jackie Chan
talkContent_in: Saya sudah konfigurasi seperti ini, dan hasil efek yang saya lihat adalah seperti itu. Kalau kamu atur dengan cara ini, maka efek yang kamu lihat juga akan sama. —— Jackie Chan
talkContent_vn: Tôi đã cấu hình như thế này, và hiệu ứng tôi thấy là như thế này. Bạn cấu hình theo cách này, thì hiệu ứng bạn thấy cũng sẽ như vậy. —— Thành Long

talkContent_en: The number of times the story activation is configured after a battle ends is 99. Aaaaaaa!
